scenes.title: 自我介绍
scenes.subtitle: Self introduction
scenes.description: 和陌生人见面，用最常见的 8 句话把自己说清楚 —— 姓名、来处、做什么、多久没练英语了。不卡壳。
learn: 礼貌地把话题还给对方

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Nova.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是 Nova

sentences.en: Nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴认识你

sentences.en: I'm from Shanghai, China.
sentences.zh: 我来自中国上海

sentences.en: I work as a product designer.
sentences.zh: 我是一名产品设计师

sentences.en: I've been learning English for two years.
sentences.zh: 我学英语两年了

sentences.en: How about yourself?
sentences.zh: 你呢？

sentences.en: It's my first time visiting here.
sentences.zh: 这是我第一次来

sentences.en: Thanks for chatting with me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你和我聊天

sentences.en: Hi there!
sentences.zh: 嗨，你好

sentences.en: How's it going?
sentences.zh: 最近怎么样？

sentences.en: Pretty good, you?
sentences.zh: 还不错，你呢？

sentences.en: Catch you later!
sentences.zh: 回头见

sentences.en: I'm a student.
sentences.zh: 我是学生。

sentences.en: I love music.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢音乐。

sentences.en: I have a big family.
sentences.zh: 我家人很多。

sentences.en: I like drawing.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢画画。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Nova.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是 Nova

sentences.en: I'm studying at university.
sentences.zh: 我在上大学。

sentences.en: My major is computer science.
sentences.zh: 我的专业是计算机。

sentences.en: I live with my family.
sentences.zh: 我和家人住在一起。

sentences.en: I have a younger brother.
sentences.zh: 我有一个弟弟。

sentences.en: In my free time, I like hiking.
sentences.zh: 空闲时我喜欢徒步。

sentences.en: I'm learning to play the piano.
sentences.zh: 我在学钢琴。

sentences.en: Hi, I don't think we've met yet.
sentences.zh: 我们应该还没见过

sentences.en: I'm Nova — visiting from Shanghai.
sentences.zh: 我是 Nova，从上海过来的

sentences.en: I lead design at a small product startup.
sentences.zh: 我在一家产品初创做设计

sentences.en: I've been doing this for about five years.
sentences.zh: 这行我做了五年左右

sentences.en: What's keeping you busy these days?
sentences.zh: 你最近在忙什么？

sentences.en: Are you based here, or just visiting?
sentences.zh: 你住这边还是来出差？

sentences.en: The food scene here is amazing.
sentences.zh: 这边的吃的太棒了

sentences.en: We should grab coffee sometime.
sentences.zh: 找时间一起喝咖啡

sentences.en: Here's my card if you'd like to follow up.
sentences.zh: 这是我的名片

sentences.en: Outside of work, I'm really into photography.
sentences.zh: 工作之外，我很喜欢摄影。

sentences.en: I'm the eldest of three kids.
sentences.zh: 我是三个孩子里的老大。

sentences.en: I'm doing a part-time master's in design.
sentences.zh: 我在读设计的在职硕士。

sentences.en: My work is mostly about solving problems for users.
sentences.zh: 我的工作主要是为用户解决问题。

sentences.en: My parents live nearby, so we have dinner together often.
sentences.zh: 父母住得近，我们常一起吃饭。

sentences.en: On weekends, I usually go rock climbing.
sentences.zh: 周末我通常去攀岩。

sentences.en: Pleasure to finally put a face to the name.
sentences.zh: 终于见到本人了

sentences.en: I run product at a Series-B fintech.
sentences.zh: 我在一家 B 轮金融科技公司管产品

sentences.en: I made the jump from finance about three years ago.
sentences.zh: 三年前我从金融转过来的

sentences.en: It's been a steep learning curve, but no regrets.
sentences.zh: 学习曲线挺陡，但不后悔

sentences.en: I'm here for the summit, mostly to catch up with old colleagues.
sentences.zh: 我来开峰会，主要和老同事叙旧

sentences.en: Are you on the founder side, or more on investments?
sentences.zh: 你是创始人还是投资圈？

sentences.en: We've been heads-down on a launch, so I haven't been to many of these.
sentences.zh: 我们最近忙发布，没怎么出席

sentences.en: I'd love to compare notes before the closing keynote.
sentences.zh: 闭幕演讲前我们交流一下

sentences.en: Feel free to drop me a line — happy to chat shop anytime.
sentences.zh: 随时联系我，乐意聊业务

sentences.en: Looks like the panel's about to start, but really nice meeting you.
sentences.zh: 好像快开场了，认识你很高兴

sentences.en: Let's stay in touch — LinkedIn works.
sentences.zh: 保持联系

sentences.en: I've recently gotten into long-distance running — it's become a bit of an obsession.
sentences.zh: 最近我迷上了长跑，有点上瘾了。

sentences.en: I'm juggling a full-time role with an evening MBA.
sentences.zh: 我一边做全职工作，一边读晚间 MBA。

sentences.en: I come from a family of teachers, so education runs deep for me.
sentences.zh: 我出身教师家庭，所以对教育有很深的情结。

sentences.en: My work has shifted more toward mentoring junior designers lately.
sentences.zh: 最近我的工作更多转向带初级设计师。

sentences.en: When I'm not working, you'll usually find me experimenting in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 不工作的时候，我多半在厨房捣鼓吃的。

sentences.en: My partner and I just moved into a place closer to my parents.
sentences.zh: 我和伴侣刚搬到离我父母更近的地方。

scenes.title: 星巴克买咖啡
scenes.subtitle: Ordering at Starbucks
scenes.description: 走进星巴克，用 8 句话顺利点好喜欢的咖啡 —— 选大小、换奶、报姓名、外带。
learn: 用 Can I have... 点单
替换配料（豆奶 / 燕麦奶）

sentences.en: Can I have a grande latte, please?
sentences.zh: 一杯大杯拿铁，谢谢

sentences.en: I'll have it hot.
sentences.zh: 要热的

sentences.en: Could I get oat milk instead?
sentences.zh: 能换成燕麦奶吗？

sentences.en: It's Nova — N, O, V, A.
sentences.zh: 我叫 Nova，N-O-V-A

sentences.en: Could I get that to go?
sentences.zh: 能打包带走吗？

sentences.en: Do you have the Wi-Fi password?
sentences.zh: 有 Wi-Fi 密码吗？

sentences.en: That's all for now, thanks.
sentences.zh: 就这些，谢谢

sentences.en: Have a nice day.
sentences.zh: 祝你有美好的一天

sentences.zh: 不要糖浆，谢谢。

sentences.zh: 能加一份浓缩吗？

sentences.en: It's for here — could I get it in a mug?
sentences.zh: 在店里喝——能用马克杯装吗？

sentences.en: It's Wei — W as in Walter, E, I.
sentences.zh: 我叫 Wei——W 是 Walter 的 W，E，I。

sentences.en: Is it coming out at the other end?
sentences.zh: 是在那头取吗？

sentences.en: Hi, I placed a mobile order about ten minutes ago under Wei.
sentences.zh: 你好，我大概十分钟前用手机下的单，名字是 Wei。

sentences.en: I don't see it on the counter — could you check if it went through?
sentences.zh: 台子上没看到——能帮我查一下订单有没有成功吗？

sentences.en: It should be a grande cold brew with oat milk and no sweetener.
sentences.zh: 应该是一杯大杯冷萃，燕麦奶，不加糖。

sentences.en: Actually, this one has whole milk — I asked for oat.
sentences.zh: 这杯好像是全脂牛奶——我要的是燕麦奶。

sentences.en: I have a dairy allergy, so I can't drink this one.
sentences.zh: 我对乳制品过敏，所以这杯我不能喝。

sentences.en: Would you mind remaking it?
sentences.zh: 能麻烦重做一杯吗？

sentences.en: No rush — I can see how busy you are.
sentences.zh: 不着急——我看得出你们很忙。

sentences.en: Could you add a shot to the new one? I'm happy to pay for it.
sentences.zh: 新的那杯能加一份浓缩吗？加钱没问题。

sentences.en: Should I hand this one back, or just leave it here?
sentences.zh: 这杯我是还给你，还是就放这儿？

sentences.en: Will I still get the stars for this one?
sentences.zh: 这杯的星星我还能拿到吗？

sentences.en: Thanks for taking care of that.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你帮我处理。

sentences.en: We'll handle the gratuity in cash.
sentences.zh: 小费付现金

sentences.zh: 晚上愉快

scenes.title: 问路
scenes.subtitle: Asking for directions
scenes.description: 在陌生城市迷路，用 8 句简短问路把自己救回来 —— 距离、方向、时间、替代方案。
learn: 问走路多久 / 要不要换乘

sentences.en: Excuse me, could you help me?
sentences.zh: 打扰一下，能帮我一下吗？

sentences.en: How do I get to the train station?
sentences.zh: 去火车站怎么走？

sentences.en: Is it within walking distance?
sentences.zh: 走路能到吗？

sentences.en: Which way is it from here?
sentences.zh: 从这儿往哪边走？

sentences.en: Should I turn left or right?
sentences.zh: 左转还是右转？

sentences.en: How long does it take on foot?
sentences.zh: 走路要多久？

sentences.en: Is there a bus that goes there?
sentences.zh: 有公交能到吗？

sentences.en: Thanks so much for your help.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你的帮助

sentences.en: Where's the station?
sentences.zh: 车站在哪？

sentences.en: Is it far?

sentences.en: How long does it take on foot?
sentences.zh: 走路要多久？

sentences.en: Is there a bus that goes there?
sentences.zh: 有公交能到吗？

sentences.en: Thanks so much for your help.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你的帮助

sentences.en: Sorry to bother you — where's the nearest subway?
sentences.zh: 抱歉打扰，最近的地铁站在哪？

sentences.en: Am I going the right way?
sentences.zh: 我走的方向对吗？

sentences.en: Is it easier to walk or take a bus?
sentences.zh: 走路方便还是坐公交方便？

sentences.en: Could you show me on the map?
sentences.zh: 能在地图上指给我看吗？

sentences.en: So I go straight and then turn left?
sentences.zh: 那我直走然后左转？

sentences.en: Is there a landmark I should look for?
sentences.zh: 有什么地标我可以找吗？

sentences.en: How far is it, roughly?
sentences.zh: 大概有多远？

sentences.en: I think I'm a little lost.
sentences.zh: 我好像有点迷路了。

sentences.en: I'm trying to find the art museum, but I think I've been walking in circles.
sentences.zh: 我想找美术馆，但好像一直在绕圈子。

sentences.en: Would it be quicker to cut through the park?
sentences.zh: 穿过公园会不会快一点？

sentences.en: Is this within walking distance, or should I grab a cab?
sentences.zh: 走得到吗，还是我该打个车？

sentences.en: I'm not familiar with this area at all.
sentences.zh: 我对这一带完全不熟。

sentences.en: Could you point me toward the main road?
sentences.zh: 能给我指一下大路的方向吗？

sentences.en: Does this street eventually lead downtown?
sentences.zh: 这条街最后能通到市中心吗？

sentences.en: I'll just follow the signs from there.
sentences.zh: 从那儿我就跟着路牌走。

sentences.en: You've been really helpful — thanks a lot.
sentences.zh: 你帮了大忙，非常感谢。

sentences.en: I should be able to find it now.
sentences.zh: 现在我应该能找到了。

scenes.title: 打车去目的地

sentences.en: Sorry, could you spell that for me?
sentences.zh: 抱歉，能帮我拼一下吗？

sentences.en: Let me grab a pen — go ahead.
sentences.zh: 我拿支笔——你说吧。

sentences.en: So just to confirm, it'll arrive by Friday?
sentences.zh: 所以我确认一下，周五之前会到，对吗？

sentences.en: If we get disconnected, could you call me back at this number?
sentences.zh: 万一断线了，能打这个号码回拨给我吗？

sentences.en: Could you email me a confirmation?
sentences.zh: 能给我发一封确认邮件吗？

sentences.en: What should I do if it still hasn't arrived by Friday?
sentences.zh: 如果周五还没到，我该怎么办？

sentences.en: Hi, I've been on hold for about twenty minutes — I hope you can help me figure this out.
sentences.zh: 你好，我已经等了大概二十分钟——希望你能帮我把这事弄清楚。

sentences.en: I've called twice about this already, so I'd rather not start from scratch.
sentences.zh: 这件事我已经打过两次电话了，所以我不想再从头讲一遍。

sentences.en: Could you pull up the notes from my previous call?
sentences.zh: 能调出我上次来电的记录吗？

sentences.en: I was told it would be resolved within three business days, and it's now been eight.
sentences.zh: 当时说三个工作日内解决，现在已经八天了。

sentences.en: I understand it's not your fault — I just need to know what happens next.
sentences.zh: 我理解这不是你的问题——我只是想知道接下来会怎么处理。

sentences.en: Is there a supervisor I could speak with about this?
sentences.zh: 这件事我能跟主管谈谈吗？

sentences.en: Before you transfer me, could you stay on the line until someone picks up?
sentences.zh: 转接之前，能麻烦你别挂，等有人接了再走吗？

sentences.en: Could you add a note to my account so I don't have to explain this again?
sentences.zh: 能在我的账户里加个备注吗？这样我下次就不用再解释一遍了。

sentences.en: So the refund will be back on my card in five to seven days. Is that right?
sentences.zh: 所以退款五到七天会回到我卡上。对吗？

sentences.en: Could you send that to my email so I have it in writing?
sentences.zh: 能把这个发到我邮箱吗？我好有个书面记录。

sentences.en: I appreciate you staying on this with me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你一直帮我跟进这件事。

scenes.title: 预约时间
scenes.subtitle: Booking an appointment
scenes.description: 预约牙医 / 理发 / 美甲等服务，定时间、改时间。

sentences.en: I'd like to book an appointment.
sentences.zh: 我想预约一个时间

sentences.en: Do you have anything next week?
sentences.zh: 下周有空档吗？

sentences.en: Monday afternoon works for me.
sentences.zh: 周一下午可以

sentences.en: Around 3 PM if possible.
sentences.zh: 下午 3 点左右

sentences.en: Could I reschedule that to Friday?
sentences.zh: 能改到周五吗？

sentences.en: Is there a cancellation fee?
sentences.zh: 取消有费用吗？

sentences.en: Thank you, see you then.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，到时见

sentences.en: I need an appointment.
sentences.zh: 我需要预约。

sentences.en: Could you text me the address?
sentences.zh: 能把地址发短信给我吗？

sentences.en: Do I need to bring my insurance card?
sentences.zh: 我需要带保险卡吗？

sentences.en: Great, I'll take it.
sentences.zh: 好的，我就订这个。

sentences.en: I'd like to book an appointment.
sentences.zh: 我想预约一个时间

sentences.en: Do you have anything next week?
sentences.zh: 下周有空档吗？

sentences.en: Monday afternoon works for me.
sentences.zh: 周一下午可以

sentences.en: Around 3 PM if possible.
sentences.zh: 下午 3 点左右

sentences.en: Could I reschedule that to Friday?
sentences.zh: 能改到周五吗？

sentences.en: Is there a cancellation fee?
sentences.zh: 取消有费用吗？

sentences.en: Thank you, see you then.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，到时见

sentences.en: Hi, I'd like to schedule a cleaning with Dr. Lee if she's available.
sentences.zh: 你好，如果 Lee 医生有空，我想约个洗牙。

sentences.en: Do you validate parking, and which garage should I use?
sentences.zh: 你们能给停车盖章吗？我该停哪个停车楼？

sentences.en: Does my dental plan cover a routine cleaning, and will I owe anything out of pocket?
sentences.zh: 我的牙科保险涵盖常规洗牙吗？我需要自付多少？

sentences.en: Anything after three works, since I pick up my kid at two-thirty.
sentences.zh: 三点以后都行，因为我两点半要去接孩子。

sentences.en: Could you put me on the waitlist if something opens up sooner?
sentences.zh: 如果有更早的空位，能把我放进候补名单吗？

sentences.en: Do I need to fill out any forms before I come in?
sentences.zh: 来之前我需要填什么表格吗？

sentences.en: How early should I get there for my first visit?
sentences.zh: 第一次去我该提前多久到？

sentences.en: I'll need a Mandarin interpreter for the appointment. Could you arrange one?
sentences.zh: 这次就诊我需要普通话翻译。能帮我安排一位吗？

sentences.en: Perfect — see you on the fourteenth.
sentences.zh: 太好了——十四号见。

sentences.en: Hi, I have an appointment on Thursday that I need to move.
sentences.zh: 你好，我周四有个预约需要改期。

sentences.en: Something came up at work, so I can't make that time anymore.
sentences.zh: 工作上有事，那个时间我去不了了。

sentences.en: I'm calling the moment I found out, but I realize this is less than twenty-four hours' notice.
sentences.zh: 我是一知道就打来的，但我明白这已经不到二十四小时了。

sentences.en: Is there any way to waive the fee, since this is my first time rescheduling?
sentences.zh: 考虑到这是我第一次改期，有办法免掉费用吗？

sentences.en: What's the next opening you have with the same doctor?
sentences.zh: 同一位医生下一个空位是什么时候？

sentences.en: I'd rather wait for her than see someone else, if that's not too far out.
sentences.zh: 如果不用等太久，我宁愿等她，也不换别人。

sentences.en: Could you double-check that my insurance is still active on your end?
sentences.zh: 能帮我再确认一下，你们那边我的保险还是有效的吗？

sentences.en: Last time there was a mix-up with my referral — has that been cleared up?
sentences.zh: 上次我的转诊单出过差错——那件事解决了吗？

sentences.en: If the referral expires before the new appointment, will I need a new one?
sentences.zh: 如果转诊单在新预约之前过期了，我需要重新开吗？

sentences.en: Could you confirm the new time by email so I have it in writing?
sentences.zh: 能把新时间用邮件确认一下吗，我好有个书面记录。

sentences.en: Thanks for working with me on that.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你帮我协调这件事。

sentences.zh: 打扰一下，这个多少钱？

sentences.en: Is it on sale?
sentences.zh: 在打折吗？

sentences.en: Do you have a smaller size?
sentences.zh: 有小一号的吗？

sentences.en: Do you accept international cards?
sentences.zh: 可以刷国际卡吗？

sentences.en: Could I try this on?
sentences.zh: 能试穿一下吗？

sentences.en: I'll take it, thank you.
sentences.zh: 我要了，谢谢

sentences.en: How much is this?
sentences.zh: 这个多少钱？

sentences.en: Is there a cheaper option?
sentences.zh: 有便宜一点的吗？

sentences.en: Does this come in another color?
sentences.zh: 这个有别的颜色吗？

sentences.en: I'll go with this one.
sentences.zh: 我就要这个。

sentences.en: Excuse me, how much is this?
sentences.zh: 打扰一下，这个多少钱？

sentences.en: Is it on sale?
sentences.zh: 在打折吗？

sentences.en: Do you have a smaller size?
sentences.zh: 有小一号的吗？

sentences.en: Do you accept international cards?
sentences.zh: 可以刷国际卡吗？

sentences.zh: 能试穿一下吗？

sentences.en: I'll take it, thank you.

sentences.en: Excuse me, is this the sale price or the regular price?
sentences.zh: 请问这是折后价还是原价？

sentences.en: Is that the price before tax?
sentences.zh: 这是税前价格吗？

sentences.en: Is that price per pound, or is it per item?
sentences.zh: 那个价格是按磅算还是按件算？

sentences.en: Do you have this in a medium in the back?
sentences.zh: 库房里还有中号的吗？

sentences.en: Do you price-match other stores?
sentences.zh: 你们跟别的商店比价吗？

sentences.en: Is there a student or member discount?
sentences.zh: 有学生折扣或会员折扣吗？

sentences.en: Is this final sale, or can I still return it?
sentences.zh: 这个是特价不退不换，还是还能退？

sentences.en: Could I get a gift receipt with that?
sentences.zh: 能给我开一张礼品小票吗？

sentences.en: That works — I'll go ahead and get it.
sentences.zh: 可以——那我就买了。

sentences.en: Hi, I bought this last week and I'd like to return it.
sentences.zh: 你好，这个我上周买的，我想退货。

sentences.en: I don't have the receipt, but could you look it up with the card I paid with?
sentences.zh: 我没带小票，但能用我付款的那张卡查到吗？

sentences.en: The tags are still on, and I never used it.
sentences.zh: 吊牌还在，我一次都没用过。

sentences.en: I'd prefer a refund to the original card rather than store credit.
sentences.zh: 我希望退回原卡，而不是 store credit。

sentences.en: I know the sale has ended, but your website says returns are good for fourteen days.
sentences.zh: 我知道折扣已经结束了，但你们网站上写退货期限是十四天。

sentences.en: Would you mind checking with a manager on that?
sentences.zh: 能麻烦你跟经理确认一下吗？

sentences.en: If a refund isn't possible, could I exchange it for a different color instead?
sentences.zh: 如果退不了，我能换成别的颜色吗？

sentences.en: Do you have that color in the store, or would I have to order it?
sentences.zh: 那个颜色店里有货吗，还是得订？

sentences.en: Is the warranty handled through you or through the manufacturer?
sentences.zh: 保修是你们负责还是找厂家？

sentences.en: And if the refund goes through instead, how long until it shows up on my card?
sentences.zh: 如果最后是退款，多久能显示在我卡上？

sentences.en: Thanks — I appreciate you taking care of that.
sentences.zh: 谢谢——谢谢你帮我处理好。

scenes.title: 药店买药
scenes.subtitle: At the pharmacy
scenes.description: 描述症状买 OTC 药，问服用方法、副作用。

sentences.en: Excuse me, I have a bad cough.
sentences.zh: 打扰一下，我咳嗽很严重

sentences.en: Do you have anything for it?
sentences.zh: 有对症的药吗？

sentences.en: I also have a sore throat.
sentences.zh: 我嗓子也疼

sentences.en: Is this safe to take with food?
sentences.zh: 这个随餐吃安全吗？

sentences.zh: 多久吃一次？

sentences.en: Is there anything non-drowsy?
sentences.zh: 有不含嗜睡成分的吗？

sentences.en: Thanks, how much is it?
sentences.zh: 谢谢，多少钱？

sentences.en: I have a cough.
sentences.zh: 我咳嗽。

sentences.en: Where's the cold medicine?
sentences.zh: 感冒药在哪儿？

sentences.en: Do I need a prescription for this?
sentences.zh: 这个需要处方吗？

sentences.en: Just this, thanks.
sentences.zh: 就要这个，谢谢。

sentences.en: Excuse me, I have a bad cough.
sentences.zh: 打扰一下，我咳嗽很严重

sentences.en: Do you have anything for it?
sentences.zh: 有对症的药吗？

sentences.en: I also have a sore throat.
sentences.zh: 我嗓子也疼

sentences.en: Is this safe to take with food?
sentences.zh: 这个随餐吃安全吗？

sentences.en: How often should I take it?
sentences.zh: 多久吃一次？

sentences.en: Is there anything non-drowsy?
sentences.zh: 有不含嗜睡成分的吗？

sentences.en: Thanks, how much is it?
sentences.zh: 谢谢，多少钱？

sentences.en: Hi, I'm here to pick up a prescription.
sentences.zh: 你好，我来取处方药。

sentences.en: It's under Chen — C-H-E-N.
sentences.zh: 登记名是 Chen——C-H-E-N。

sentences.en: Sure — my date of birth is May twelfth, nineteen eighty-five.
sentences.zh: 好的——我的出生日期是 1985 年 5 月 12 日。

sentences.en: Does my insurance cover this one?
sentences.zh: 我的保险能覆盖这个药吗？

sentences.en: Is there a generic version that's cheaper?
sentences.zh: 有没有便宜一些的仿制药？

sentences.en: I take a daily antihistamine for allergies — is that a problem with this?
sentences.zh: 我每天吃一种抗组胺的过敏药——和这个会有冲突吗？

sentences.en: Are there any foods or drinks I should avoid while I'm taking this?
sentences.zh: 吃这个药期间，有什么食物或饮料要避开吗？

sentences.en: I'm out of refills. Could you contact my doctor for a new prescription?
sentences.zh: 我的续配次数用完了。能帮我联系医生重开处方吗？

sentences.en: If it doesn't help, I'll check with my doctor.
sentences.zh: 要是没效果，我再去问我的医生。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm here to pick up a prescription — I got the text that it's ready.
sentences.zh: 你好，我来取处方药——我收到短信说配好了。

sentences.en: Last time my copay was twenty dollars — is it the same this time?
sentences.zh: 上次我的自付额是二十美元——这次一样吗？

sentences.en: That's a lot higher than usual. Could you run it through my insurance again?
sentences.zh: 这比平时高不少。能麻烦你再用我的保险走一遍吗？

sentences.en: I just switched plans, so the card on file is probably out of date.
sentences.zh: 我刚换了保险计划，你们存档的卡应该已经过期了。

sentences.en: Here's my new card — could you try it with this one?
sentences.zh: 这是我的新卡——能用这张试一下吗？

sentences.en: If it's still that much, is there a manufacturer coupon or discount program?
sentences.zh: 如果还是这么贵，有厂家优惠券或折扣项目吗？

sentences.en: While you're in there, my doctor mentioned a lower dose — could you check what was actually sent over?
sentences.zh: 顺便，我的医生提过要开小剂量的——能帮我核对一下实际开过来的是什么吗？

sentences.en: Could you also set this up on auto-refill for me?
sentences.zh: 能顺便帮我设置成自动续药吗？

sentences.en: And I'm traveling next month — can you make a note that I may need to fill it early?
sentences.zh: 还有我下个月要出门——能备注一下我可能需要提前配药吗？

sentences.en: Are there any side effects I should watch for at this dose?
sentences.zh: 这个剂量有什么副作用需要留意吗？

sentences.en: Great — I'll wait right here while you reprocess it.
sentences.zh: 好的——你重新处理，我就在这儿等。

sentences.zh: 我们在家能做些什么来帮她？

sentences.en: Is there anything she's struggling with that we should know about?
sentences.zh: 有什么她学得吃力、我们应该知道的吗？

sentences.en: How does she get along with the other kids?

问报案编号给保险（网上报案先拿临时号）
包里有钥匙和行驶证＝对方拿到住址，当天换锁
叫上门换玻璃（replacement），问清含不含吸玻璃碴

sentences.en: Hi, is this the right number for a non-emergency report?
sentences.zh: 你好，非紧急报案是打这个号码吗？

sentences.en: Someone broke into my car — it happened overnight.
sentences.zh: 有人撬了我的车——是夜里发生的。

sentences.en: They smashed my window and took my backpack.
sentences.zh: 他们砸了我的车窗，拿走了我的背包。

sentences.en: It's at a public parking lot at Third and Main, in Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 在洛杉矶第三街和主街的一个公共停车场。

sentences.en: No one was hurt, and I didn't see who did it.
sentences.zh: 没有人受伤，我也没看到是谁干的。

sentences.en: Can I file this online, or does an officer need to come out?
sentences.zh: 这个能网上报案吗，还是需要警察出警？

sentences.en: There was a laptop in that backpack, and I have the serial number written down.
sentences.zh: 那个背包里有台笔记本电脑，序列号我记下来了。

sentences.en: If I file it online, how long before I get the report number for my insurance?
sentences.zh: 如果我网上报案，多久能拿到给保险用的报案编号？

sentences.en: My house keys and my registration were in that bag — I'm changing the locks today.
sentences.zh: 我的家门钥匙和行驶证都在那个包里——我今天就去换锁。

sentences.en: Hi, my car window was smashed last night — do you do mobile window replacement?
sentences.zh: 你好，我的车窗昨晚被砸了——你们上门换玻璃吗？

sentences.en: It's the front passenger window on a 2019 Honda CR-V.
sentences.zh: 是一辆 2019 款本田 CR-V 的前排副驾驶车窗。

sentences.en: It's drivable, but I've only taped plastic over the window — there's still glass down in the door and all over the seats.
sentences.zh: 车还能开，但我只用塑料布把窗口封上了——门里和座椅上到处都是玻璃碴。

sentences.en: Does the price include vacuuming the glass out?
sentences.zh: 报价包含把玻璃碴吸干净吗？

sentences.en: Can you also check the door lock and the window regulator while you're there?
sentences.zh: 你们来的时候能顺便检查一下门锁和升降器吗？

sentences.en: I think I have glass coverage — do I need to open a claim first, or can you bill my insurance directly?
sentences.zh: 我应该有玻璃险——我需要先开理赔吗，还是你们能直接跟我的保险结算？

sentences.en: If I pay out of pocket instead, what's the total with tax?
sentences.zh: 如果我自己付，含税总共多少钱？

sentences.en: How soon could you get someone out to me?
sentences.zh: 最快什么时候能派人过来？

sentences.en: Do I need to be there the whole time, or just long enough to hand over the keys?
sentences.zh: 我需要全程在场吗，还是把钥匙交给你们就行？

sentences.en: Is there a warranty on the glass and the installation?
sentences.zh: 玻璃和安装有保修吗？

sentences.en: Great — let's book it for tomorrow morning.
sentences.zh: 好的——就约明天上午吧。

scenes.title: 保险理赔
scenes.subtitle: Filing an insurance claim
scenes.description: 车被砸、东西被偷之后打给保险公司：报案拿 claim 号、问免赔额值不值得报、约定损、选修理厂。
learn: 报案说清时间地点与损失
车损走 comprehensive，车内私人物品走 renter's / homeowner's 保单
免赔额常高于换一块侧窗的钱，未必值得报
定损单与修理厂报价对不上怎么周旋、租车怎么算

sentences.en: Hi, I'd like to file a claim on my auto policy.
sentences.zh: 你好，我想用我的车险报一个理赔。

sentences.en: My policy number is on my card — let me read it to you.
sentences.zh: 保单号在我的卡上——我念给你听。

sentences.en: Someone smashed my car window and took my backpack.
sentences.zh: 有人砸了我的车窗，拿走了我的背包。

sentences.en: It happened overnight in a parking lot.
sentences.zh: 是夜里在一个停车场发生的。

sentences.en: I already filed a police report.
sentences.zh: 我已经报过警了。

sentences.en: I filed it online, so right now I only have the temporary number.
sentences.zh: 我是网上报的案，所以现在只有临时受理号。

sentences.en: I also took photos of the damage.
sentences.zh: 我还拍了损坏的照片。

sentences.en: What happens next?
sentences.zh: 接下来会怎么处理？

sentences.en: I want to report a claim.
sentences.zh: 我要报一个理赔。

sentences.en: My car was broken into.
sentences.zh: 我的车被撬了。

sentences.en: It happened last night.
sentences.zh: 是昨晚发生的。

sentences.en: What do I do next?
sentences.zh: 接下来我该做什么？

sentences.en: Hi, I'd like to file a claim on my auto policy.
sentences.zh: 你好，我想用我的车险报一个理赔。

sentences.en: My policy number is on my card — let me read it to you.
sentences.zh: 保单号在我的卡上——我念给你听。

sentences.en: Someone smashed my car window and took my backpack.
sentences.zh: 有人砸了我的车窗，拿走了我的背包。

sentences.en: It happened overnight in a parking lot.
sentences.zh: 是夜里在一个停车场发生的。

sentences.en: I already filed a police report.
sentences.zh: 我已经报过警了。

sentences.en: I filed it online, so right now I only have the temporary number.
sentences.zh: 我是网上报的案，所以现在只有临时受理号。

sentences.en: I also took photos of the damage.
sentences.zh: 我还拍了损坏的照片。

sentences.en: What happens next?
sentences.zh: 接下来会怎么处理？

sentences.en: Hi, I'm calling to follow up on a claim I filed yesterday.
sentences.zh: 你好，我想跟进一下我昨天报的理赔。

sentences.en: The claim number is 0-4-8-2-6-1-9-3-3-7.
Is the window covered under comprehensive?
sentences.zh: 车窗走综合险能赔吗？

sentences.en: What's my deductible on this one?
sentences.zh: 这一项我的免赔额是多少？

sentences.en: The repair quote is under my deductible — should I just drop the claim?
sentences.zh: 修车报价比我的免赔额还低——我是不是干脆撤掉这个理赔？

sentences.en: The backpack and laptop were inside — I think that's my renter's policy, not this one, right?
sentences.zh: 背包和笔记本电脑在车里——那部分应该走我的租房保险，不是这份，对吗？

sentences.en: When will the adjuster contact me?
sentences.zh: 定损员什么时候联系我？

sentences.en: Can I use my own repair shop, or does it have to be one of yours?
sentences.zh: 我能用自己找的修理厂吗，还是必须用你们指定的？

sentences.en: Could you email me a summary of everything we just went over?
sentences.zh: 能把我们刚才谈的内容整理成邮件发我吗？

sentences.en: Hi, I'd like to go over the estimate the adjuster sent me.
sentences.zh: 你好，我想跟你核对一下定损员发给我的估价单。

sentences.en: The shop quoted me four hundred more than what's on your estimate.
sentences.zh: 修理厂给我的报价比你们的估价单高出四百美元。

sentences.en: They said they found damage to the window regulator that wasn't on your estimate, so they're writing a supplement.
sentences.zh: 他们说发现升降器也坏了，你们的估价单上没有，所以要补一份追加单。

sentences.en: Could you have the adjuster call the shop directly to work that out?
sentences.zh: 能让定损员直接跟修理厂沟通解决吗？

sentences.en: The shop says it'll be in for two days — do I have rental reimbursement on this policy?
sentences.zh: 修理厂说要修两天——我这份保单有租车补偿吗？

sentences.en: What's the daily limit, and how many days does it cover?
sentences.zh: 每天的限额是多少？总共能覆盖几天？

sentences.en: I'm putting the stolen laptop through my renter's policy, so let's keep this claim to the vehicle damage.
sentences.zh: 被偷的笔记本我走租房保险，所以这个理赔就只算车辆损失吧。

sentences.en: Is a comprehensive theft claim treated as not-at-fault in California?
sentences.zh: 在加州，综合险的失窃理赔算作无责吗？

sentences.en: If I close this out with no payment, does it still show up on my claims history?
sentences.zh: 如果这个理赔零赔付结案，还会留在我的理赔记录里吗？

sentences.en: Please put a note on the file that I'd like a phone call when there's a decision, not just an email.
sentences.zh: 请在档案里备注一下：有结果时我希望接到电话，而不只是邮件。

sentences.en: And then follow up with the same thing in writing, so I have a record.
sentences.zh: 然后再把同样的内容用书面发我一份，我好留个记录。

scenes.title: 求职面试
scenes.subtitle: A job interview
scenes.description: 从开场到反问,一整套面试英语:介绍背景、讲优势、答动机、应对缺点/离职、反问面试官。
learn: 回答难题(缺点/离职原因)

sentences.en: Nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到您。

sentences.en: Thank you for your time.
sentences.zh: 谢谢您抽出时间。

sentences.en: I'm excited about this role.
sentences.zh: 我对这个职位很感兴趣。

sentences.en: I look forward to hearing from you.
sentences.zh: 期待您的回复。

sentences.en: Thank you for meeting with me today.
sentences.zh: 谢谢您今天抽时间见我。

sentences.en: I have three years of experience in marketing.
sentences.zh: 我有三年市场营销的经验。

sentences.en: I'm a quick learner and a team player.
sentences.zh: 我学得快，也善于团队合作。

sentences.en: I applied because I really want to grow here.
sentences.zh: 我来应聘是因为很想在这里成长。

sentences.en: My biggest strength is my attention to detail.
sentences.zh: 我最大的优势是注重细节。

sentences.en: When can I expect to hear back from you?
sentences.zh: 我大概什么时候能收到您的回复？

sentences.en: Thanks for taking the time to meet with me today.
sentences.zh: 谢谢您今天抽时间见我。

sentences.en: In my current role, I manage a team of five.
sentences.zh: 在目前的岗位上，我带一个五人的团队。

sentences.en: I'd say my strongest skill is problem-solving.
sentences.zh: 我认为我最强的技能是解决问题。

sentences.en: I'm really drawn to your company's focus on innovation.
sentences.zh: 我很欣赏贵公司对创新的重视。

sentences.en: Could you tell me more about the team I'd be working with?
sentences.zh: 能多讲讲我将合作的团队吗？

sentences.en: What does success look like in this position?
sentences.zh: 在这个岗位上，怎样算做得出色？

sentences.en: I appreciate you walking me through the role in such detail.
sentences.zh: 谢谢您这么详细地介绍这个岗位。

sentences.en: I left my last position because I was looking for a bigger challenge.
sentences.zh: 我离开上一份工作，是想寻求更大的挑战。

sentences.en: If I had to name a weakness, I'd say I can be a bit of a perfectionist.
sentences.zh: 要说缺点的话，我有点完美主义。

sentences.en: I'm confident I could add value from day one.
sentences.zh: 我有信心从第一天起就能创造价值。

sentences.en: How would you describe the company culture here?
sentences.zh: 您会怎么形容这里的公司文化？

sentences.en: Is there anything about my background you'd like me to expand on?
sentences.zh: 关于我的背景，有什么需要我进一步说明的吗？

scenes.title: 认识新朋友
scenes.subtitle: Meeting someone new
scenes.description: KET 口语 Part 1 高频：第一次见面，介绍自己、家人和来历。
scenes.examTip:
**考法** 这段是 KET 个人信息话题的生活对话拓展，不是真实 Speaking Part 1 考场流程。真实 Part 1 是考官问、考生答，通常先问姓名、年龄、来自哪里或住在哪里，再进入学校、家庭、兴趣等个人话题。
**掌握** 练这段时重点掌握 My name is… / I’m… / I live in… / There are…
**注意** 正式考试中回答考官即可，不需要反问对方。

**Part 2** 你和另一位考生看五幅认识新朋友的场合图(在学校、在俱乐部、一起运动、邻居、网上)。说说你们喜欢或不喜欢在哪些场合交朋友、为什么,并回应对方 —— **不需要选同一种**。

templates.en: My name is ___. / I'm ___.
I'm ___ years old.
I'm from ___. / I live in ___.
There are ___ people in my family.

sentences.en: Hi! Nice to meet you. I'm Tom.
sentences.zh: 你好！很高兴认识你，我是汤姆。

sentences.en: Nice to meet you too, Tom. My name is Lily.
sentences.zh: 我也很高兴认识你，汤姆。我叫莉莉。

sentences.en: Where are you from, Lily?
sentences.zh: 你来自哪里，莉莉？

sentences.en: I'm from China. And you?
sentences.zh: 我来自中国。你呢？

sentences.en: I'm from Canada. How old are you?
sentences.zh: 我来自加拿大。你多大了？

sentences.en: I'm fifteen years old.
sentences.zh: 我十五岁。

sentences.en: Do you have any brothers or sisters?
sentences.zh: 你有兄弟姐妹吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I have one younger brother.
sentences.zh: 有的，我有一个弟弟。

sentences.en: There are lots of ways to make new friends. I usually meet people at school.
sentences.zh: 交新朋友有很多方式。我一般在学校认识人。

sentences.en: Same for me. My classmates are all really friendly.
sentences.zh: 我也一样。我同学都很友好。

sentences.en: Joining a club is difficult for me because I'm a bit shy.
sentences.zh: 参加俱乐部对我来说有点难，因为我有点害羞。

sentences.en: Really? I love clubs. I made two new friends at the chess club.
sentences.zh: 真的吗？我喜欢俱乐部。我在象棋社交了两个新朋友。

sentences.en: I think playing sports is a good way too.
sentences.zh: 我觉得一起运动也是个好办法。

sentences.en: I agree. You talk to lots of people when you're in a team.
sentences.zh: 同意。在一个队里会和很多人说话。

sentences.en: Do you ever make friends with your neighbours?
sentences.zh: 你会和邻居交朋友吗？

sentences.en: Yes, the girl next door is my friend. We grew up together.
sentences.zh: 会啊，隔壁的女孩就是我朋友。我们一起长大的。

sentences.en: I don't really like making friends online. You can't see them.
sentences.zh: 我不太喜欢在网上交朋友。看不到真人。

sentences.en: That's true, but I've met some nice people through online games.
sentences.zh: 确实，但我通过网络游戏认识了一些不错的人。

scenes.title: 买一件 T 恤
scenes.subtitle: Buying a T-shirt
scenes.description: 在商店里问价格、要颜色、试穿和付款的常用说法。
scenes.examTip:
**要点** 购物是 KET 常见生活话题。真实 Speaking Part 1 里，考官可能问 Do you like shopping? 或 What did you buy recently?，要用完整句回答并给理由。
**场景** 下面这段是店内购物场景拓展，不是真实 Part 1 考场流程；问价 How much is…、要颜色 Do you have it in…、试穿 Can I try it on 都是真实买东西时很实用的表达。

**Part 2** 你和另一位考生看五幅衣服图(T恤、连衣裙、牛仔裤、外套、运动鞋)。说说你们喜欢或不喜欢穿哪些、为什么,并回应对方 —— **不需要一起买同一件**。

templates.en: How much is this ___?
Do you have it in ___?
Can I try it on?
I'll take it. Here you are.

sentences.en: Excuse me, how much is this T-shirt?
sentences.zh: 打扰一下，这件 T 恤多少钱？

sentences.en: It's twelve dollars.
sentences.zh: 十二美元。

sentences.en: Do you have it in blue?
sentences.zh: 有蓝色的吗？

sentences.en: Yes, here you are.
sentences.zh: 有的，给你。

sentences.en: Can I try it on?
sentences.zh: 我可以试穿吗？

sentences.en: Sure. The changing room is over there.
sentences.zh: 当然，试衣间在那边。

sentences.en: It fits well. I'll take it.
sentences.zh: 很合身，我就要这件。

sentences.en: Great. That's twelve dollars, please.
sentences.zh: 好的，一共十二美元，谢谢。

sentences.en: I really like the T-shirts. What do you think?
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢这些T恤。你觉得呢？

sentences.en: Me too. They're comfortable and easy to wear.
sentences.zh: 我也是。穿着舒服又方便。

sentences.en: What about jeans? I wear them every day.
sentences.zh: 牛仔裤呢？我每天都穿。

sentences.en: Really? I don't like jeans much. They're too hot in summer.
sentences.zh: 真的吗？我不太喜欢牛仔裤。夏天太热了。

sentences.en: I love this dress. It's great for parties.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这条连衣裙。参加聚会很好看。

sentences.en: It's nice, but I don't often wear dresses. I like the coat because it's warm.
sentences.zh: 挺好看，但我不常穿裙子。我喜欢那件外套，因为很暖和。

sentences.en: Do you like these trainers?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢这双运动鞋吗？

sentences.en: Yes! I wear trainers for sport and for school.
sentences.zh: 喜欢！我运动和上学都穿运动鞋。

sentences.en: T-shirts are my favourite because they're cheap.
sentences.zh: T恤是我的最爱，因为便宜。

sentences.en: The trainers are my favourite because I wear them a lot.
sentences.zh: 运动鞋是我的最爱，因为我经常穿。

scenes.title: 在快餐店点餐
scenes.subtitle: Ordering at a café
scenes.description: 点餐、点饮料、回答“还要别的吗”——餐厅必备口语。
scenes.examTip:
**考法** 饮食是 KET 常见生活话题。真实 Speaking Part 1 里，考官可能问 What’s your favourite food? 或 Do you often eat out?，回答时要用完整句并给简单理由。

**提示** 下面这段是点餐生活场景拓展，不是真实 Part 1 考场流程；练熟 I’d like…、Can I have…、Anything else?，出国点餐很实用。

**Part 2** 你和另一位考生看五幅食物图(面条、沙拉、披萨、水果、冰淇淋)。说说你们喜欢或不喜欢哪些、为什么,并回应对方 —— **不需要真的点一份餐**。

templates.en: I'd like a ___, please.
Can I have a ___?
For here or to take away?
That's all, thank you.

sentences.en: Are you ready to order?
sentences.zh: 您可以点餐了吗？

sentences.en: Yes. I'd like a cheeseburger, please.
sentences.zh: 好的，我要一个芝士汉堡，谢谢。

sentences.en: Would you like anything to drink?
sentences.zh: 需要喝点什么吗？

sentences.en: Can I have an orange juice?
sentences.zh: 可以来一杯橙汁吗？

sentences.en: Sure. Anything else?
sentences.zh: 当然，还要别的吗？

sentences.en: No, that's all, thank you.
sentences.zh: 不用了，就这些，谢谢。

sentences.en: Okay. Your food will come soon.
sentences.zh: 好的，您的餐很快就好。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Do you like these foods? I really like noodles.
sentences.zh: 你喜欢这些食物吗？我很喜欢面条。

sentences.en: Me too. My mum makes noodles every week.
sentences.zh: 我也是。我妈妈每周都做面条。

sentences.en: What about salad? I don't like it very much.
sentences.zh: 沙拉呢？我不太喜欢。

sentences.en: Really? I like salad because it's healthy.
sentences.zh: 真的吗？我喜欢沙拉，因为很健康。

sentences.en: Pizza is my favourite. It's delicious and we can share it.
sentences.zh: 披萨是我的最爱。好吃，还能一起分着吃。

sentences.en: Pizza is nice, but it isn't very healthy.
sentences.zh: 披萨不错，但不太健康。

sentences.en: Do you like fruit?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢水果吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I eat fruit every day. Apples are the best.
sentences.zh: 喜欢，我每天都吃水果。苹果最好。

sentences.en: I like ice cream more, but only in summer.
sentences.zh: 我更喜欢冰淇淋，不过只在夏天吃。

sentences.en: Salad is my favourite. What about you?
sentences.zh: 沙拉是我的最爱。你呢？

sentences.en: Noodles! I can eat them every day.
sentences.zh: 面条！我能天天吃。

scenes.title: 问路去车站
scenes.subtitle: Asking the way
scenes.description: 问路、判断远近、问坐几路车——出行必备。
scenes.examTip:
**要点** 出行问路是日常旅行中的实用口语。

**注意** 真实 KET Speaking Part 1 可能问 How do you get to school? 这类个人出行问题；下面这段练的是街头问路场景，不是真实 Part 1 考场流程。

**掌握** 重点掌握 Excuse me, how do I get to… / go straight / turn left / Is it far?。

**Part 2** 你和另一位考生看五幅城里地方的图(公园、图书馆、商店、博物馆、体育馆)。说说你们喜欢或不喜欢去哪些地方、为什么,并回应对方 —— **不需要选同一个**。

templates.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the ___?
Is it far from here?
Which bus goes to the ___?
Could you say that again, please?

sentences.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the train station?
sentences.zh: 打扰一下，请问火车站怎么走？

sentences.en: Go straight and turn left at the bank.
sentences.zh: 一直走，在银行那里左转。

sentences.en: Is it far from here?
sentences.zh: 离这里远吗？

sentences.en: No, it's about five minutes on foot.
sentences.zh: 不远，走路大约五分钟。

sentences.en: Which bus goes there?
sentences.zh: 哪路公交车到那里？

sentences.en: You can take the number ten bus.
sentences.zh: 你可以坐十路公交车。

sentences.en: Thank you for your help.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你的帮助。

sentences.en: You're welcome. Have a nice day!
sentences.zh: 不客气，祝你今天愉快！

sentences.en: There are some nice places in our town. I love going to the park.
sentences.zh: 我们镇上有些不错的地方。我很喜欢去公园。

sentences.en: Me too. It's great for playing football with friends.
sentences.zh: 我也是。很适合和朋友踢球。

sentences.en: What about the library? I go there to read every week.
sentences.zh: 图书馆呢？我每周都去那儿看书。

sentences.en: Really? I think libraries are a bit boring.
sentences.zh: 真的吗？我觉得图书馆有点无聊。

sentences.en: I like the shops in the town centre. They're always busy.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢市中心的商店。总是很热闹。

sentences.en: I agree, but they can be too crowded at the weekend.
sentences.zh: 同意，不过周末可能太挤了。

sentences.en: Have you ever been to the museum?
sentences.zh: 你去过博物馆吗？

sentences.en: Yes, once. It was interesting but a little quiet for me.
sentences.zh: 去过一次。挺有意思，但对我来说有点太安静。

sentences.en: The sports centre is great. I go swimming there.
sentences.zh: 体育馆很棒。我去那儿游泳。

sentences.en: That sounds fun. I should try it sometime.
sentences.zh: 听起来很好玩。我改天该试试。

scenes.title: 聊聊学校
scenes.subtitle: Talking about school
scenes.description: 谈最喜欢的科目、课程安排和作业——校园日常话题。
scenes.examTip:
**要点** 学校是 KET 高频话题。  
**考法** 真实 Speaking Part 1 里考官会问 What’s your favourite subject? How many lessons do you have today? Do you get a lot of homework?，答题要给科目 + 理由（I like science because it’s interesting），别只蹦一个词。  
**提示** 注意：考试中 Part 1 只需回答考官、不反问对方，本段是同伴互练版。

**Part 2** 你和另一位考生看五幅学校科目图(数学、英语、科学、美术、体育)。说说你们喜欢或不喜欢哪些课、为什么,并回应对方 —— **不需要选同一门**。

templates.en: My favourite subject is ___.
I like ___ because ___.
We have ___ lessons today.
I usually do my homework after ___.

sentences.en: What's your favourite subject?
sentences.zh: 你最喜欢哪门课？

sentences.en: I really like science. What about you?
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢科学。你呢？

sentences.en: I like English best.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢英语。

sentences.en: How many lessons do you have today?
sentences.zh: 你今天有几节课？

sentences.en: I have six lessons today.
sentences.zh: 我今天有六节课。

sentences.en: Do you have any homework tonight?
sentences.zh: 你今晚有作业吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I have some maths homework.
sentences.zh: 有，我有一些数学作业。

sentences.en: Good luck with it!
sentences.zh: 祝你顺利！

sentences.en: I really like English. Do you like it?
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢英语。你喜欢吗？

sentences.en: Me too. I love reading stories in English.
sentences.zh: 我也是。我喜欢读英语故事。

sentences.en: What about maths? I think it's difficult.
sentences.zh: 数学呢？我觉得挺难的。

sentences.en: Really? I like maths because I'm good with numbers.
sentences.zh: 真的吗？我喜欢数学，因为我数字很在行。

sentences.en: I don't like science much. There are too many new words.
sentences.zh: 我不太喜欢科学。生词太多了。

sentences.en: Science is OK, but art is more fun for me.
sentences.zh: 科学还行，但对我来说美术更有意思。

sentences.en: Do you like PE?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢体育吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I love PE because we play outside.
sentences.zh: 喜欢，我很喜欢体育，因为能在外面玩。

sentences.en: English is my favourite. It's useful and fun.
sentences.zh: 英语是我的最爱。有用又有趣。

sentences.en: I like art best. I can draw anything I want.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢美术。想画什么就画什么。

scenes.title: 周末做什么
scenes.subtitle: Free time and hobbies
scenes.description: 谈周末活动、阅读和音乐喜好——交朋友常聊的话题。
learn: 谈音乐喜好并发出邀请
scenes.examTip:
**要点** 兴趣爱好是 KET 高频话题。
**考法** 真实 Speaking Part 1 里考官会问 What do you do at the weekend? Do you like sport or music?，用 usually/often 讲频率、用 because 给理由。
**注意** 下面这段含同伴互动（How about you? / 发出邀请），是同伴互练版——正式 Part 1 只需回答考官即可。

**Part 2** 你和另一位考生看五幅周末活动图(看电影、打羽毛球、骑车、阅读、玩电脑游戏)。说说你们喜欢或不喜欢这些活动、为什么,并回应对方 —— **不需要共同决定周末做什么**,两人喜好不同很正常。

templates.en: At the weekend, I usually ___.
I often ___ with my friends.
I really like ___ because ___.
Do you want to ___ together?

sentences.en: What do you usually do at the weekend?
sentences.zh: 你周末通常做什么？

sentences.en: I often play basketball with my friends.
sentences.zh: 我经常和朋友打篮球。

sentences.en: That sounds fun. Do you like reading?
sentences.zh: 听起来很有趣。你喜欢阅读吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I read books in the evening.
sentences.zh: 喜欢，我晚上看书。

sentences.en: What kind of music do you like?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢什么类型的音乐？

sentences.en: I love pop music. How about you?
sentences.zh: 我喜欢流行音乐。你呢？

sentences.en: I like rock music a lot.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢摇滚乐。

sentences.en: Maybe we can go to a concert together.
sentences.zh: 也许我们可以一起去看场演唱会。

sentences.en: Do you like these hobbies? I really like badminton.
sentences.zh: 你喜欢这些爱好吗？我很喜欢打羽毛球。

sentences.en: Me too. I play badminton with my brother every weekend.
sentences.zh: 我也是。我每个周末都和我弟弟打羽毛球。

sentences.en: What about the cinema? I don't like films very much.
sentences.zh: 那看电影呢？我不太喜欢电影。

sentences.en: Really? I love films because they help me relax.
sentences.zh: 真的吗？我很喜欢电影，因为能让我放松。

sentences.en: I prefer reading. It's quiet and I can do it at home.
sentences.zh: 我更喜欢阅读。很安静，在家就能做。

sentences.en: Reading is OK, but cycling is more fun for me.
sentences.zh: 阅读还行，但对我来说骑车更有意思。

sentences.en: I'm not very good at cycling, so I don't like it much.
sentences.zh: 我骑车不太行，所以不太喜欢。

sentences.en: Do you like computer games?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢玩电脑游戏吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I play them sometimes, but my favourite is still badminton.
sentences.zh: 喜欢，有时候玩，不过我最喜欢的还是羽毛球。

sentences.en: Cycling is my favourite. It's fun and it's free.
sentences.zh: 骑车是我的最爱。有意思，还不花钱。

scenes.title: 聊聊日常作息
scenes.subtitle: Talking about daily life
scenes.description: PET 口语 · 聊聊日常作息 · Part 1 面试问答 + Part 2 看图描述长描述 + Part 3 讨论
scenes.examTip:
**考法** 日常作息是 PET 口语 Part 1 的高频开场话题。考官常问你平时几点起床、工作日和周末有什么不同、晚上一般做什么。
**怎么答** B1 学生不能只答一个词，要用完整句并给出理由或细节，比如「I usually get up at seven because I have to catch the bus.」。注意自如切换一般现在时和频率副词（always/usually/sometimes/hardly ever）。
**场景** Part 2 看单图描述时，可能出现某人在家做家务或吃早餐的场景，要用现在进行时说清谁在做什么、在哪里。

templates.en: I usually ___ in the morning.
On weekdays I have to ___, but at the weekend I can ___.
I ___ about ___ times a week.
After that, I normally ___ because ___.
templates.zh: 说接下来做什么并给理由

sentences.en: What time do you usually get up on a normal day?
sentences.zh: 平常你一般几点起床？

sentences.en: I usually get up at about seven o'clock because I have to go to school early.
sentences.zh: 我一般七点左右起床，因为我得早早去学校。

sentences.en: What do you normally do in the evenings?
sentences.zh: 你晚上一般做什么？

sentences.en: In the evenings I usually do my homework first, and then I watch a film or chat with my friends.
sentences.zh: 晚上我通常先写作业，然后看部电影或者跟朋友聊天。

sentences.en: Is your weekend very different from your weekdays?
sentences.zh: 你的周末和工作日很不一样吗？

sentences.en: Yes, it's quite different, because on weekdays I'm always busy, but at the weekend I can relax and sleep a bit longer.
sentences.zh: 是的，挺不一样的，因为工作日我总是很忙，但周末我可以放松，多睡一会儿。

sentences.en: Do you think you have a healthy daily routine?
sentences.zh: 你觉得自己的日常作息健康吗？

sentences.en: Not really, because I often go to bed too late, so I should try to sleep earlier.
sentences.zh: 不太健康，因为我经常太晚睡，所以我应该试着早点睡。

sentences.en: In the picture, I can see a young woman in her kitchen at home.
sentences.zh: 照片里我能看到一个年轻女人在家里的厨房。

sentences.en: It looks like it is early in the morning because sunlight is coming through the window.
sentences.zh: 看起来是清晨时分，因为阳光正从窗户照进来。

sentences.en: She is making breakfast and there is some bread and a cup of coffee on the table.
sentences.zh: 她正在做早餐，桌上有一些面包和一杯咖啡。

sentences.en: She is wearing comfortable clothes, so I think she has just woken up.
sentences.zh: 她穿着舒适的衣服，所以我觉得她刚起床。

sentences.en: She looks quite relaxed and maybe a little sleepy.
sentences.zh: 她看起来挺放松的，也许还有点困。

sentences.en: There is a small plant on the windowsill, and the kitchen looks clean and tidy.
sentences.zh: 窗台上有一盆小植物，厨房看起来干净整洁。

sentences.en: Behind her, there is a white fridge with a few photos and notes stuck on the door.
sentences.zh: 她身后有一台白色冰箱，冰箱门上贴着几张照片和便条。

sentences.en: Next to the cooker, there is a kettle and a few clean plates on the counter.
sentences.zh: 灶台旁边的台面上放着一个水壶和几个干净的盘子。

sentences.en: I think it's a calm and peaceful start to her day.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是她一天平静而美好的开始。

sentences.en: So, Tom says he never has enough time in the evenings. Let's look at these ideas.
sentences.zh: Tom 说他晚上的时间总是不够用。我们来看看这些建议吧。

sentences.en: Sure. Going to bed earlier could help, because he always looks tired at school.
sentences.zh: 好啊。早点睡觉可能有用，因为他在学校总是一脸疲惫。

sentences.en: That's true, but sleeping more doesn't really give him extra free time.
sentences.zh: 确实，不过多睡觉并不能真的给他多出空闲时间。

sentences.en: Good point. What about doing some sport? It gives you more energy for everything else.
sentences.zh: 有道理。那做点运动呢？运动能让人做其他事情更有精力。

sentences.en: I like that idea, though he might say he's too busy for sport already.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个主意，不过他可能会说自己已经忙得没时间运动了。

sentences.en: Then packing his school bag the night before could save him time in the morning.
sentences.zh: 那前一晚收拾好书包，早上就能省不少时间。

sentences.en: Yes, that's a small change, but I don't think it solves the real problem.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是个小改变，但我觉得解决不了根本问题。

sentences.en: What about reading a book in the evening? It's relaxing and good for him.
sentences.zh: 那晚上读读书呢？既放松，对他也有好处。

sentences.en: It is, but Tom says reading makes him sleepy after a long day.
sentences.zh: 是的，但 Tom 说忙了一天后，一看书就犯困。

sentences.en: You're right. Honestly, he spends hours on his phone every evening.
sentences.zh: 你说得对。说实话，他每天晚上都要在手机上花好几个小时。

sentences.en: Exactly, so using his phone less would probably make the biggest difference.
sentences.zh: 没错，所以少玩手机可能才是改变最大的。

sentences.en: I agree. Let's say that's the most helpful idea for Tom.
sentences.zh: 我同意。那我们就说这是对 Tom 最有帮助的建议吧。

scenes.title: 聊聊兴趣爱好
scenes.subtitle: Talking about free time
scenes.description: PET 口语 · 聊聊兴趣爱好 · Part 1 面试问答 + Part 2 看图描述长描述 + Part 3 讨论
learn: 说想学但还不擅长的事
scenes.examTip:
**要点** 空闲时间和爱好几乎是 PET 口语 Part 1 必考内容。考官会问你喜欢做什么、什么时候做、为什么喜欢、是和别人一起还是自己做。B1 学生要能说出爱好的名称，并用 because/so 给出理由，还要会用 like/enjoy/be interested in + 动名词（enjoy playing, interested in drawing）。也常被问到「将来想学什么新爱好」，需要用 would like to 或 be going to。

**注意** Part 2 单图可能是有人在弹吉他、踢球或画画，要用现在进行时描述动作，并用 maybe/probably 推测心情。

templates.en: In my free time, I really enjoy ___.
I like ___ because it helps me ___.
I'm not very good at ___, but I'd like to learn.
templates.zh: 说想学但还不擅长的事

templates.en: I usually do it with ___ rather than alone.

sentences.en: What do you like doing in your free time?
sentences.zh: 你空闲时喜欢做什么？

sentences.en: In my free time I really enjoy playing basketball, because it keeps me fit and it's fun with my friends.
sentences.zh: 空闲时我很喜欢打篮球，因为它让我保持健康，而且和朋友一起很有意思。

sentences.en: How often do you do your hobby?
sentences.zh: 你多久做一次这个爱好？

sentences.en: I play about three times a week, usually after school in the park near my house.
sentences.zh: 我大约一周打三次，一般放学后在我家附近的公园打。

sentences.en: Would you like to try a new hobby in the future?
sentences.zh: 你以后想尝试新的爱好吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I'd like to learn to play the guitar, because I think music is a great way to relax.
sentences.zh: 想的，我想学弹吉他，因为我觉得音乐是放松的好方法。

sentences.en: Do you prefer doing hobbies alone or with other people?
sentences.zh: 你更喜欢一个人还是和别人一起做爱好？

sentences.en: I usually prefer doing them with other people, but sometimes I also like reading alone at home.
sentences.zh: 我通常更喜欢和别人一起，不过有时候我也喜欢一个人在家看书。

sentences.en: In this picture, there are two boys sitting on the grass in a park.
sentences.zh: 这张照片里有两个男孩坐在公园的草地上。

sentences.en: One of them is playing the guitar and the other one is singing along.
sentences.zh: 其中一个在弹吉他，另一个在跟着唱。

sentences.en: It looks like a sunny day because the sky is clear and blue.
sentences.zh: 看起来是个晴天，因为天空湛蓝清澈。

sentences.en: There are some other people walking behind them, so the park seems quite busy.
sentences.zh: 他们身后还有一些人走过，所以公园看起来挺热闹。

sentences.en: There is a music book open on the grass in front of them.
sentences.zh: 他们面前的草地上摊开着一本乐谱。

sentences.en: The boy with the guitar is wearing a blue cap and a white T-shirt.
sentences.zh: 弹吉他的男孩戴着一顶蓝色鸭舌帽，穿着白色T恤。

sentences.en: In the background, I can see some tall trees and a small pond.
sentences.zh: 背景里我能看到几棵高大的树和一个小池塘。

sentences.en: I think they are probably good friends who love music.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他们可能是热爱音乐的好朋友。

sentences.en: They look really happy and they are enjoying their free time together.
sentences.zh: 他们看起来非常开心，正一起享受空闲时光。

sentences.en: Our school wants to start a new club, and there are five ideas here.
sentences.zh: 我们学校想新开一个社团，这里有五个备选。

sentences.en: Let's see. A photography club sounds fun because everyone has a camera on their phone.
sentences.zh: 我看看。摄影社听起来很有意思，毕竟每个人手机上都有相机。

sentences.en: True, and you could learn to take much better pictures.
sentences.zh: 是啊，还能学会把照片拍得更好。

sentences.en: A chess club would be quieter. It makes you think, but maybe it isn't for everyone.
sentences.zh: 棋类社会安静一些。很锻炼思维，但可能不是人人都合适。

sentences.en: I'm not sure about chess. How about a music club instead? People love playing together.
sentences.zh: 棋类我不太确定。那音乐社呢？大家都喜欢一起演奏。

sentences.en: It could get noisy, though! A hiking club would take us outside at weekends.
sentences.zh: 不过那可能会很吵！远足社周末能带我们走出校园。

sentences.en: That sounds healthy, but it depends on the weather a lot.
sentences.zh: 听起来很健康，但太看天气了。

sentences.en: And a cooking club means we get to eat what we make, which is a big plus.
sentences.zh: 烹饪社的话，做完还能吃掉，这可是个大优点。

sentences.en: They're all quite good, but for me photography is still the most interesting.
sentences.zh: 这些都挺好的，但对我来说摄影还是最有意思的。

sentences.en: I see why, though I'd still choose hiking. It's fine that we like different ones!
sentences.zh: 我懂你，不过我还是会选远足。我们喜欢的不一样也没关系嘛！

scenes.title: 聊聊旅行计划
scenes.subtitle: Talking about travel
scenes.description: PET 口语 · 聊聊旅行计划 · Part 1 面试问答 + Part 2 看图描述长描述 + Part 3 讨论
scenes.examTip:
**考法** 旅行与假期是 PET 口语的经典话题。Part 1 里考官常问你去过哪里、喜欢什么样的假期、下次想去哪。这里要灵活用过去时（讲去过的地方）和将来表达 be going to / would like to（讲计划）。
**对策** B1 学生要避免只说地名，应补充原因和细节，比如「I went to the seaside because I love swimming.」。
**场景** Part 2 看单图可能是海滩、机场或山里露营，要用 There is/are 和现在进行时说出地点、人物动作，并用 It looks like 和 probably 推测天气与心情，把句子用 and/but/so 连起来更连贯。

templates.en: Last year I went to ___ and it was ___.
I'd really like to visit ___ one day.
When I travel, I prefer ___ rather than ___.
The best thing about the trip was ___.

sentences.en: Do you enjoy travelling? Why or why not?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢旅行吗？为什么？

sentences.en: Yes, I really enjoy travelling, because I can see new places and try different food.
sentences.zh: 喜欢，我很喜欢旅行，因为可以看新的地方，尝不同的食物。

sentences.en: Where did you go on your last holiday?
sentences.zh: 你上次假期去哪了？

sentences.en: Last summer I went to the seaside with my family, and we had a wonderful time.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天我和家人去了海边，我们玩得很开心。

sentences.en: Do you prefer travelling by train or by plane?
sentences.zh: 你更喜欢坐火车还是坐飞机旅行？

sentences.en: I prefer travelling by train, because it's cheaper and I can enjoy the view.
sentences.zh: 我更喜欢坐火车，因为更便宜，而且我能欣赏风景。

sentences.en: Is there a place you would like to visit in the future?
sentences.zh: 将来有没有你想去的地方？

sentences.en: Yes, I'd really like to visit Japan one day, because I'm interested in its culture and history.
sentences.zh: 有的，我很想有一天去日本，因为我对它的文化和历史感兴趣。

sentences.en: In the picture, I can see a family spending time on a sandy beach.
sentences.zh: 照片里，我能看到一家人正在沙滩上度假。

sentences.en: There are two children building a sandcastle near the water.
sentences.zh: 有两个孩子在水边堆沙堡。

sentences.en: It looks like a hot summer day, because everyone is wearing shorts and sunglasses.
sentences.zh: 看起来像是炎热的夏日，因为大家都穿着短裤、戴着墨镜。

sentences.en: The parents are sitting under a big umbrella and probably watching their children.
sentences.zh: 父母坐在一把大伞下，可能在看着孩子。

sentences.en: The sea is blue and the sky is clear, so it's a perfect day for the beach.
sentences.zh: 大海是蓝色的，天空很晴朗，所以是去海滩的完美日子。

sentences.en: The children have a red bucket and a small spade next to them.
sentences.zh: 孩子们旁边放着一个红色的小桶和一把小铲子。

sentences.en: There are a few other people swimming in the sea further away.
sentences.zh: 远一点的海里还有几个人在游泳。

sentences.en: Behind the family, I can see some white beach houses and a few palm trees.
sentences.zh: 在这家人身后，我能看到几栋白色的海滨小屋和几棵棕榈树。

sentences.en: I think they are on holiday and they all look very relaxed and happy.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他们在度假，每个人看起来都很放松、很开心。

sentences.en: The family can only choose one place for Saturday. Where should they go?
sentences.zh: 这家人周六只能去一个地方。他们该去哪儿呢？

sentences.en: Well, the beach is always popular, especially if the weather is warm.
sentences.zh: 嗯，海滩总是很受欢迎，尤其是天气暖和的时候。

sentences.en: Yes, but they went to the beach last month, so maybe something different?
sentences.zh: 是啊，不过他们上个月刚去过海滩，也许换个不一样的？

sentences.en: Fair enough. The museum could be interesting, and it's fine even if it rains.
sentences.zh: 有道理。博物馆可能挺有意思，而且下雨也不怕。

sentences.en: That's a safe choice, though the children might find it a bit boring.
sentences.zh: 这是个稳妥的选择，不过孩子们可能会觉得有点无聊。

sentences.en: What about climbing the mountain? The views from the top are amazing.
sentences.zh: 那去爬山怎么样？山顶的风景特别棒。

sentences.en: It might be too hard for the grandparents, to be fair.
sentences.zh: 说句公道话，对爷爷奶奶来说可能太吃力了。

sentences.en: How about the old town? The streets are pretty and there are little shops everywhere.
sentences.zh: 那老城区怎么样？街道很漂亮，到处都是小店。

sentences.en: Pretty, yes, but the children would get bored walking around for hours.
sentences.zh: 漂亮是漂亮，但逛上几个小时孩子们会觉得无聊的。

sentences.en: Then the theme park could work. There are rides for children and shows for adults.
sentences.zh: 那主题公园应该行。有孩子玩的项目，也有大人看的演出。

sentences.en: You know, that really does have something for everyone in the family.
sentences.zh: 你还别说，那里真是全家老小都能玩得开心。

sentences.en: Agreed. Let's say the theme park would be the best choice for them.
sentences.zh: 同意。那我们就定主题公园是最合适的选择。

scenes.title: 聊聊购物消费
scenes.subtitle: Talking about shopping
scenes.description: PET 口语 · 聊聊购物消费 · Part 1 面试问答 + Part 2 看图描述长描述 + Part 3 讨论
scenes.examTip:
**考法** 购物是 PET 口语 Part 1 常考话题，考官会问你喜欢去哪购物、网购还是逛店、上次买了什么。

**怎么答** 回答要会用比较级（cheaper, more comfortable）和原因连接词来表达偏好，比如「I prefer shopping online because it's more convenient.」。B1 学生要能描述上次的购物经历（过去时），并给出评价。

**场景** Part 2 单图常是超市、商场或市场，画面里有人在挑选、付钱或推购物车，要用现在进行时和 There is/are 描述货架、商品和人物，并用 maybe/I think 推测他们在买什么。

templates.en: I prefer shopping ___ because it's ___.
Last week I bought ___ and I was ___ with it.
When I go shopping, I usually look for ___.
I think ___ is more ___ than ___.
templates.zh: 用比较级比较两种选择

sentences.en: Do you enjoy going shopping?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢逛街购物吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I enjoy it a lot, especially when I go shopping for clothes with my friends.
sentences.zh: 喜欢，我很喜欢，尤其是和朋友一起买衣服的时候。

sentences.en: Do you prefer shopping in stores or online?
sentences.zh: 你更喜欢逛实体店还是网购？

sentences.en: I prefer shopping online because it's more convenient and often a bit cheaper.
sentences.zh: 我更喜欢网购，因为更方便，而且常常更便宜一点。

sentences.en: What was the last thing you bought?
sentences.zh: 你最近买的最后一样东西是什么？

sentences.en: Last week I bought a new pair of running shoes, and I'm really happy with them.
sentences.zh: 上周我买了一双新跑鞋，我对它们很满意。

sentences.en: Do you think people buy too many things these days?
sentences.zh: 你觉得现在人们买的东西太多了吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I think so, because shopping online is so easy, so people sometimes buy things they don't need.
sentences.zh: 是的，我这么觉得，因为网购太容易了，所以人们有时会买不需要的东西。

sentences.en: In this picture, there is a woman shopping in a big supermarket.
sentences.zh: 这张照片里有个女人在一家大超市购物。

sentences.en: She is pushing a shopping trolley and looking at the products on the shelf.
sentences.zh: 她正推着购物车，看着货架上的商品。

sentences.en: There are a lot of fruit and vegetables in front of her, so I think she is buying food for the week.
sentences.zh: 她面前有很多水果和蔬菜，所以我觉得她在买这一周的食物。

sentences.en: The supermarket looks clean and bright, and there are a few other customers behind her.
sentences.zh: 超市看起来干净又明亮，她身后还有几位顾客。

sentences.en: She is holding a piece of fruit and reading the label carefully.
sentences.zh: 她拿着一个水果，仔细地看着标签。

sentences.en: She is wearing a grey jumper and jeans, and she has a handbag on her shoulder.
sentences.zh: 她穿着灰色毛衣和牛仔裤，肩上挎着一个手提包。

sentences.en: In her trolley, there are already some bottles of milk and a bag of apples.
sentences.zh: 她的购物车里已经有几瓶牛奶和一袋苹果。

sentences.en: I think she wants to choose the freshest products, and she looks quite focused.
sentences.zh: 我觉得她想挑最新鲜的商品，看起来挺专注的。

sentences.en: It's Anna's birthday next week. What do you think we should get her?
sentences.zh: Anna 下周过生日。你觉得我们该送她什么？

sentences.en: A book is a classic present, and she does enjoy reading at the weekend.
sentences.zh: 书是很经典的礼物，而且她周末确实喜欢看书。

sentences.en: She does, but I never know which books she has already read.
sentences.zh: 确实，但我总猜不到哪些书她已经看过了。

sentences.en: True. Trainers could be useful because she just joined the running team.
sentences.zh: 有道理。运动鞋可能很实用，她刚加入跑步队。

sentences.en: The problem is we don't know her size, and shoes are hard to choose.
sentences.zh: 问题是我们不知道她的尺码，鞋子太难挑了。

sentences.en: How about concert tickets then? She listens to music all the time.
sentences.zh: 那演唱会门票呢？她一天到晚都在听音乐。

sentences.en: They're quite expensive, though, and the good seats sell out fast.
sentences.zh: 不过票挺贵的，好座位又卖得特别快。

sentences.en: We could get her a new backpack. Her old one looks quite worn.
sentences.zh: 我们可以送她一个新背包。她的旧包看起来挺旧的了。

sentences.en: Hmm, a backpack feels a bit ordinary for a birthday present, doesn't it?
sentences.zh: 嗯，背包当生日礼物是不是有点普通了？

sentences.en: OK, what about a board game? We could all play it together at her party.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那桌游呢？生日聚会上我们还能一起玩。

sentences.en: Oh, I love that! It's fun, not too expensive, and it would be a birthday present she'd remember.
sentences.zh: 哎，这个我喜欢！有意思，不算贵，还会是一份让她难忘的生日礼物。

sentences.en: Perfect, so a board game it is. She'll definitely enjoy that.
sentences.zh: 太好了，那就定桌游。她肯定会喜欢的。

scenes.title: 聊聊饮食外食
scenes.subtitle: Talking about food
scenes.description: PET 口语 · 聊聊饮食外食 · Part 1 面试问答 + Part 2 看图描述长描述 + Part 3 讨论
learn: 讲最喜欢的食物并给理由
scenes.examTip:
**场景** 饮食与外出就餐是 PET 口语 Part 1 的常见话题，考官会问你最喜欢的食物、平时谁做饭、喜不喜欢在外面吃。

**怎么答** B1 学生要能用 because/so 解释喜好，用频率副词说习惯，还要会用一点 present perfect（Have you ever tried…?）。回答应给出具体例子，比如「I love noodles because they're tasty and easy to make.」。

**考法** Part 2 单图常是一家人吃饭、餐厅或厨房做菜的场景，要用 There is/are、现在进行时描述桌上的食物和人物动作，并用 It looks like / probably 推测这是什么场合、大家心情如何。

templates.en: My favourite food is ___ because ___.
templates.zh: 讲最喜欢的食物并给理由

templates.en: I usually eat ___ for ___.
I don't really like ___, so I hardly ever eat it.
When I eat out, I often choose ___.

sentences.en: What's your favourite food?
sentences.zh: 你最喜欢的食物是什么？

sentences.en: My favourite food is dumplings, because they're delicious and my mum makes them really well.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的食物是饺子，因为它们很好吃，而且我妈妈做得特别好。

sentences.en: Do you often eat out at restaurants?
sentences.zh: 你经常去餐厅吃饭吗？

sentences.en: Not very often, maybe once a week, usually when I meet my friends at the weekend.
sentences.zh: 不太经常，大概一周一次，通常是周末和朋友见面的时候。

sentences.en: Who usually cooks in your family?
sentences.zh: 你家里通常谁做饭？

sentences.en: My mum usually cooks, but I sometimes help her, and I'm slowly getting better at it.
sentences.zh: 通常是我妈妈做饭，不过我有时会帮她，我的厨艺也在慢慢进步。

sentences.en: Is there any food you don't like?
sentences.zh: 有没有什么你不喜欢的食物？

sentences.en: Yes, I don't really like spicy food, so I hardly ever order it in restaurants.
sentences.zh: 有，我不太喜欢辣的食物，所以我在餐厅几乎从不点辣的。

sentences.en: In the picture, I can see a family having dinner together at home.
sentences.zh: 照片里我能看到一家人在家里一起吃晚餐。

sentences.en: There are several dishes on the table, including rice, vegetables and some meat.
sentences.zh: 桌上有好几道菜，包括米饭、蔬菜和一些肉。

sentences.en: Everyone is sitting around the table and talking while they eat.
sentences.zh: 大家围坐在桌边，一边吃一边聊天。

sentences.en: The father is passing a plate of vegetables to a little girl.
sentences.zh: 爸爸正把一盘蔬菜递给一个小女孩。

sentences.en: The little girl is laughing, so it looks like a happy family meal.
sentences.zh: 小女孩笑着，看起来是一顿开心的家庭晚餐。

sentences.en: It's probably the evening, because the lights in the room are on.
sentences.zh: 可能是晚上，因为房间里的灯都开着。

sentences.en: The table is covered with a white cloth, and everyone has a glass of water.
sentences.zh: 桌上铺着白色桌布，每个人面前都有一杯水。

sentences.en: Behind them, I can see a window with the curtains closed and a picture on the wall.
sentences.zh: 他们身后有一扇拉上窗帘的窗户，墙上还挂着一幅画。

sentences.en: I think they really enjoy spending time together and the food looks delicious.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他们很享受在一起的时光，而且食物看起来很好吃。

sentences.en: We need to decide something for the class dinner. Shall we go through the choices?
sentences.zh: 我们得为班级聚餐拿个主意。要不要把选项过一遍？

sentences.en: Yes. Pizza is easy because almost everyone likes it, and it's not expensive.
sentences.zh: 好。披萨最省事，几乎人人都爱吃，还不贵。

sentences.en: That's true, although we had pizza at the last two class parties.
sentences.zh: 没错，不过前两次班级聚会我们都吃的披萨。

sentences.en: Did we? Then we could go to a Chinese restaurant and order lots of dishes to share.
sentences.zh: 是吗？那我们可以去中餐馆，点很多菜大家一起分。

sentences.en: Sharing sounds nice, but booking a table for thirty people is difficult.
sentences.zh: 分享听着不错，但三十个人订位子可不容易。

sentences.en: Good point. A barbecue would be fun, though someone has to do all the cooking.
sentences.zh: 有道理。烧烤会很好玩，不过得有人一直烤东西。

sentences.en: There's also the buffet — everyone can pick exactly what they want.
sentences.zh: 还有自助餐——每个人都能挑自己想吃的。

sentences.en: That's true, but buffets are usually more expensive than the other choices.
sentences.zh: 确实，不过自助餐通常比其他选择都贵。

sentences.en: Exactly. I'd rather have a picnic in the park. Everyone brings one dish, so it's easy.
sentences.zh: 是啊。我更想去公园野餐。每人带一道菜，特别省事。

sentences.en: Hmm, a picnic depends on the weather. I still think pizza is the safest choice.
sentences.zh: 嗯，野餐得看天气。我还是觉得披萨最稳妥。

sentences.en: I see your point, but I'd choose the picnic for a change.
sentences.zh: 我明白你的意思，但我想换换花样，还是选野餐。

sentences.en: Then let's give both ideas to the class and have a quick vote.
sentences.zh: 那我们把这两个方案都交给全班，快速投个票吧。

scenes.title: 聊聊学习计划
scenes.subtitle: Talking about studies
scenes.description: PET 口语 · 聊聊学习计划 · Part 1 面试问答 + Part 2 看图描述长描述 + Part 3 讨论
learn: 讲最喜欢的科目并给理由
讲学习中的困难和打算
scenes.examTip:
**考法** 学习与未来计划在 PET 口语里既出现在 Part 1，也常作为收尾的展望话题。考官会问你最喜欢哪门课、为什么、将来想做什么。这里非常考验将来表达：be going to / would like to / want to + 动词原形。B1 学生要给出理由和具体计划，避免只说「I like English.」，应说「I like English because I want to study abroad in the future.」。

**怎么答** Part 2 单图常是教室、图书馆或学生在学习的场景，要用 There is/are 和现在进行时描述谁在做什么、用了什么工具，并用 I think / probably 推测他们在学什么、感觉如何。

templates.en: My favourite subject is ___ because ___.
templates.zh: 讲最喜欢的科目并给理由

templates.en: In the future, I'd like to ___.
I find ___ quite difficult, so I need to ___.
templates.zh: 讲学习中的困难和打算

templates.en: After I finish school, I'm going to ___.

sentences.en: What's your favourite subject at school?
sentences.zh: 你在学校最喜欢哪门课？

sentences.en: My favourite subject is English, because I enjoy learning new words and watching films in English.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的科目是英语，因为我喜欢学新单词，也喜欢看英文电影。

sentences.en: Is there a subject you find difficult?
sentences.zh: 有没有你觉得难的科目？

sentences.en: Yes, I find maths quite difficult, so I usually ask my teacher for extra help.
sentences.zh: 有，我觉得数学挺难的，所以我经常向老师寻求额外的帮助。

sentences.en: What do you want to do after you finish school?
sentences.zh: 你毕业后想做什么？

sentences.en: After school, I'd like to go to university and study business, because I want to start my own company one day.
sentences.zh: 毕业后，我想上大学学商科，因为我希望有一天能开自己的公司。

sentences.en: Do you prefer studying alone or with classmates?
sentences.zh: 你更喜欢自己学还是和同学一起学？

sentences.en: I usually prefer studying with classmates, because we can help each other and it's less boring.
sentences.zh: 我通常更喜欢和同学一起学，因为我们可以互相帮助，而且没那么无聊。

sentences.en: In this picture, there are some students studying in a quiet library.
sentences.zh: 这张照片里有一些学生在安静的图书馆里学习。

sentences.en: A girl at the front is reading a thick book and taking notes.
sentences.zh: 前面有个女孩正在读一本厚书并做笔记。

sentences.en: There are a lot of bookshelves behind them, full of different books.
sentences.zh: 他们身后有很多书架，摆满了各种书。

sentences.en: On the table, there are some notebooks, pens and a bottle of water.
sentences.zh: 桌上放着一些笔记本、几支笔和一瓶水。

sentences.en: Some students are using laptops, so I think they are working on a project together.
sentences.zh: 有些学生在用笔记本电脑，所以我觉得他们在一起做一个项目。

sentences.en: The girl has long dark hair and is wearing glasses and a green jumper.
sentences.zh: 那个女孩留着深色长发，戴着眼镜，穿着绿色毛衣。

sentences.en: There are big windows on one side, and the light from outside makes the room bright.
sentences.zh: 一侧有几扇大窗户，外面的光线让房间很明亮。

sentences.en: It looks like they are preparing for an important exam.
sentences.zh: 看起来他们在为一场重要的考试做准备。

sentences.en: They all look very serious and focused, but maybe a little tired too.
sentences.zh: 他们看起来都很认真、很专注，不过也许还有点累。

sentences.en: The exams start on Monday, so which way of revising works best?
sentences.zh: 周一就开始考试了，哪种复习方式最有效呢？

sentences.en: Studying at home is comfortable, but I always end up watching videos instead.
sentences.zh: 在家复习很舒服，但我最后总是变成刷视频。

sentences.en: Same here! The library is better because it's quiet and everyone else is working.
sentences.zh: 我也是！图书馆就好多了，又安静，周围的人都在学习。

sentences.en: That helps, though you can't discuss questions when you get stuck.
sentences.zh: 那确实有用，不过卡住的时候没法和人讨论。

sentences.en: What about asking the teacher? She explains things really clearly.
sentences.zh: 那请教老师呢？她讲题特别清楚。

sentences.en: She does, but she's only free after class for a short time.
sentences.zh: 确实，但她只有课后一小段时间有空。

sentences.en: Doing past papers shows you what the questions look like, which is useful.
sentences.zh: 做往年试题能让你知道题目长什么样，挺有用的。

sentences.en: Very useful. But my favourite is still studying in a group — we can test each other.
sentences.zh: 非常有用。但我最喜欢的还是小组学习——我们可以互相提问。

sentences.en: And explaining answers to someone else really makes you understand them better.
sentences.zh: 而且给别人讲题，自己反而理解得更透。

sentences.en: Exactly. So let's say group study works best, with some past papers too.
sentences.zh: 没错。那就定小组学习最有效，再配合做点往年试题。

scenes.title: 科技与社交
scenes.subtitle: Tech and Social Media
scenes.description: FCE 口语 · 科技与社交 · Part 1 面试问答 + Part 2 对比两图长描述 + Part 3 讨论
scenes.examTip:
**考法** 科技是 FCE 高频话题。Part 1 考官会问你日常如何使用手机、社交媒体和网络,通常会自然用到现在时和现在完成时给出 2 句左右的回答,并补充理由或例子。

**场景** Part 2 常给你两张人们使用科技的照片(如有人在打视频电话、有人独自刷手机),要求约一分钟对比异同并推测人们为什么这样使用。

**提示** B2 学生要主动用对比衔接词 whereas、on the other hand,以及推测语气 might、could、probably,避免只罗列画面而不分析。多用搭配如 stay in touch、a huge impact、rely on technology 来提升档次。

templates.en: One of the main advantages of ___ is that it helps us stay in touch.
On the other hand, ___ can have a negative impact on ___.
I think the person in the first picture might be ___ing, whereas the other one seems to be ___.
If I had to choose, I'd say ___ because ___.
templates.zh: 表达个人选择并给理由

sentences.en: Do you use your phone a lot during the day?
sentences.zh: 你白天经常用手机吗?

sentences.en: Honestly, I'm on it more than I'd like to admit. I check messages every few minutes, and I rely on it for almost everything.
sentences.zh: 说实话,我用得比我愿意承认的还多。我每隔几分钟就看消息,几乎什么都靠它。

sentences.en: What kind of apps do you find most useful?
sentences.zh: 你觉得哪类应用最有用?

sentences.en: Probably the ones that help me stay organised, like my calendar and notes. They've completely changed the way I plan my week.
sentences.zh: 大概是帮我把事情安排好的那些,比如日历和笔记。它们彻底改变了我规划一周的方式。

sentences.en: Do you think social media brings people closer together?
sentences.zh: 你觉得社交媒体让人们更亲近吗?

sentences.en: In some ways, yes, because it lets me keep in touch with friends abroad. However, it can also make people feel a bit isolated.
sentences.zh: 某种程度上是的,因为它让我和国外的朋友保持联系。不过,它也会让人感到有点孤立。

sentences.en: Would you say technology has made your life easier?
sentences.zh: 你会说科技让你的生活更轻松了吗?

sentences.en: Definitely, especially when it comes to studying. I can look things up instantly, which saves me a huge amount of time.
sentences.zh: 当然,尤其是学习方面。我能立刻查到东西,这帮我省下了大量时间。

sentences.en: Both pictures show people using technology in their everyday lives, but in quite different situations.
sentences.zh: 两张照片都展示了人们在日常生活中使用科技,但场景很不一样。

sentences.en: In the first picture, a group of friends seem to be making a video call together, and they all look relaxed and cheerful.
sentences.zh: 第一张照片里,一群朋友似乎在一起打视频电话,他们看起来都很放松、很开心。

sentences.en: Whereas the first one is clearly social, the second picture shows a person sitting alone, scrolling through their phone.
sentences.zh: 第一张明显是社交场景,而第二张展示的是一个人独自坐着,刷着手机。

sentences.en: The people in the first photo might be catching up with relatives who live far away, which is something technology makes much easier.
sentences.zh: 第一张照片里的人可能在和住得很远的亲戚叙旧,而这正是科技让其变得容易得多的事。

sentences.en: On the other hand, the person on their own could just be killing time, or perhaps reading the news on the way to work.
sentences.zh: 另一方面,那个独自一人的人可能只是在打发时间,或者也许是在上班路上看新闻。

sentences.en: I'd say people use technology like this because it lets them stay connected and entertained wherever they happen to be.
sentences.zh: 我会说,人们这样使用科技,是因为它让他们无论身在何处都能保持联系和获得娱乐。

sentences.en: Personally, I think the first situation is healthier, since sharing a moment with others probably makes us feel less lonely than being glued to a screen on our own.
sentences.zh: 就我个人而言,我觉得第一种情形更健康,因为和别人分享一个瞬间,大概比独自盯着屏幕更不让人感到孤独。

sentences.en: So, the question is how technology has changed the way we socialise. Where shall we start?
sentences.zh: 问题是科技如何改变了我们的社交方式。我们从哪儿说起？

sentences.en: Let's take instant messaging first — it's probably the one we all use most.
sentences.zh: 先说即时消息吧——这可能是我们用得最多的。

sentences.en: Definitely. It keeps conversations going all day, although people sometimes hide behind texts instead of talking face to face.
sentences.zh: 没错。它让聊天一整天不间断，不过有时人们会躲在文字后面，而不是面对面交流。

sentences.en: That's a fair point. Social media goes even further — it lets you present a version of yourself to hundreds of people at once.
sentences.zh: 有道理。社交媒体走得更远——它让你一次向几百个人展示一个「你的版本」。

sentences.en: Which isn't always healthy, is it? Comparing your real life with the perfect lives people present online can really affect your confidence.
sentences.zh: 但这并不总是健康的，对吧？拿自己的真实生活和别人网上展示的完美生活比，很影响自信。

sentences.en: True, whereas video calls feel much more genuine — you see real faces and real reactions.
sentences.zh: 确实，相比之下视频通话就真实多了——你看到的是真实的脸和真实的反应。

sentences.en: My grandparents would agree — video calls are the only reason they feel close to us during term time.
sentences.zh: 我爷爷奶奶肯定同意——学期里视频通话是他们觉得和我们亲近的唯一原因。

sentences.en: And we shouldn't forget online gaming — for lots of teenagers it's where friendships actually happen now.
sentences.zh: 还有在线游戏也不能忽略——对很多青少年来说，友谊现在真的是在游戏里发生的。

sentences.en: OK, if we had to choose the one with the biggest influence on teenagers, which would it be?
sentences.zh: 好，如果必须选一个对青少年影响最大的，会是哪个？

sentences.en: I'd say social media, because it shapes how they see themselves, not just how they talk.
sentences.zh: 我会说社交媒体，因为它塑造的是他们怎么看自己，而不只是怎么聊天。

sentences.en: I was going to argue for messaging, but you're right — social media changes opinions, habits, even moods.
sentences.zh: 我本来想说即时消息，但你说得对——社交媒体改变的是观点、习惯，甚至情绪。

sentences.en: So we agree: social media has the biggest influence, for better or worse.
sentences.zh: 那我们达成一致：社交媒体影响最大，无论是好是坏。

scenes.title: 环境与可持续
scenes.subtitle: Environment and Sustainability
scenes.description: FCE 口语 · 环境与可持续 · Part 1 面试问答 + Part 2 对比两图长描述 + Part 3 讨论
scenes.examTip:
**考法** 环保是 FCE 必备话题,常和日常习惯绑定。Part 1 会问你做了哪些环保的事、所在城市污染情况、个人能否带来改变,通常会自然用到现在完成时和情态动词谈责任(should、ought to)。

**场景** Part 2 可能给两张图,比如人们骑车上班 vs 开车堵在路上,要你对比并推测原因和影响。

**注意** B2 学生要会用条件句 If more people did this, ... 和因果衔接词 as a result、therefore,并准确使用搭配 cut down on、reduce waste、climate change。注意别只描述画面,要给出有理由支撑的观点收尾。

templates.en: If more people ___, it would make a real difference to the environment.
One simple way to cut down on ___ is to ___.
Compared with the first picture, the second one shows ___, which is far more sustainable.
I believe we all ought to ___, otherwise ___.

sentences.en: Do you do anything to help protect the environment?
sentences.zh: 你做些什么来保护环境吗?

sentences.en: I try my best, to be honest. I've started recycling properly and I always carry a reusable bottle to cut down on plastic.
sentences.zh: 说实话,我尽力而为。我开始认真做垃圾分类,也总是带一个可重复使用的瓶子来减少塑料。

sentences.en: Is pollution a big problem where you live?
sentences.zh: 你住的地方污染严重吗?

sentences.en: Unfortunately it is, especially the traffic. On bad days the air quality is so poor that you can actually taste it.
sentences.zh: 很遗憾确实严重,尤其是交通。糟糕的日子里空气质量差到你都能尝出来。

sentences.en: Do you think one person can really make a difference?
sentences.zh: 你觉得一个人真的能带来改变吗?

sentences.en: I do, actually. If everyone made small changes, the overall impact would be enormous, so it's worth the effort.
sentences.zh: 我其实觉得能。如果每个人都做点小改变,整体影响会非常大,所以值得去努力。

sentences.en: Would you be willing to pay more for eco-friendly products?
sentences.zh: 你愿意为环保产品多花钱吗?

sentences.en: Within reason, yes. I'd rather spend a bit extra on something sustainable than buy cheap things that end up as waste.
sentences.zh: 在合理范围内,愿意。我宁愿在可持续的东西上多花一点,也不愿买便宜货最后变成垃圾。

sentences.en: Both pictures are connected to how people travel around a city, but they show two very contrasting choices.
sentences.zh: 两张照片都和人们如何在城市里出行有关,但它们展示了两种截然不同的选择。

sentences.en: In the first picture, a man is cycling to work along a quiet street, and he looks healthy and quite content.
sentences.zh: 第一张照片里,一个男人沿着安静的街道骑车上班,他看起来健康又相当满足。

sentences.en: Whereas the cyclist has plenty of space, the second picture shows a long line of cars stuck in heavy traffic.
sentences.zh: 骑车的人有充足的空间,而第二张照片展示的是一长排汽车堵在严重的车流里。

sentences.en: The man on the bike has probably chosen it because it's cheaper and far better for the environment.
sentences.zh: 骑车的男人选这样大概是因为更便宜,而且对环境好得多。

sentences.en: On the other hand, the drivers might rely on their cars because they live too far away, or they could be carrying heavy things.
sentences.zh: 另一方面,开车的人可能依赖汽车是因为他们住得太远,或者他们也许在搬运重物。

sentences.en: The cars in the second picture are clearly producing far more pollution than the bicycle in the first.
sentences.zh: 第二张图里的汽车产生的污染，显然远多于第一张图里的自行车。

sentences.en: If I had to give my opinion, I'd say cycling is the more sustainable option, even though it isn't always practical for everyone.
sentences.zh: 如果要我表态,我会说骑车是更可持续的选择,尽管它并不总是对每个人都现实。

sentences.en: The question here is how easy these environmental actions are for ordinary people to take. Where shall we start?
sentences.zh: 这里的问题是：这些环保做法对普通人来说各有多容易做到。我们从哪个开始？

sentences.en: Reducing plastic seems the obvious place to begin — everyone talks about it.
sentences.zh: 减少塑料似乎是最顺理成章的起点——人人都在谈这个。

sentences.en: They do, but talking is easier than doing. Almost everything in a supermarket comes wrapped in plastic.
sentences.zh: 是啊，但说比做容易。超市里几乎所有东西都是塑料包装。

sentences.en: Exactly, so it partly depends on shops, not just on us. Taking the bus, on the other hand, is a choice we make every day.
sentences.zh: 没错，所以这部分取决于商家，不只是我们。而坐公交则是我们每天都能自己做的选择。

sentences.en: That's true, although in smaller towns the buses run so rarely that people can hardly rely on them.
sentences.zh: 确实，不过在小城镇公交班次太少，人们很难指望它。

sentences.en: Fair enough. What about saving energy at home? Switching things off costs nothing and actually saves money.
sentences.zh: 有道理。那在家节约能源呢？随手关电器不花一分钱，还能省钱。

sentences.en: I like that one — it's the kind of small habit you barely notice once you've built it.
sentences.zh: 这条我喜欢——这是那种一旦养成就几乎注意不到的小习惯。

sentences.en: Buying second-hand is similar: it feels normal very quickly, and it prevents a lot of waste.
sentences.zh: 二手消费也类似：很快就会觉得理所当然，还能避免大量浪费。

sentences.en: Right, so let's decide — which of these is the easiest to keep up in the long run?
sentences.zh: 好，那我们来定——这些做法里哪个最容易长期坚持？

sentences.en: For me, it's saving energy, precisely because you see the reward immediately in a lower electricity bill.
sentences.zh: 我选节约能源，正因为你能立刻在变少的电费单上看到回报。

sentences.en: Hmm, I'd have said second-hand shopping, but a habit with an instant reward probably lasts longer.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我本来想说二手消费，但有即时回报的习惯可能坚持得更久。

sentences.en: Then saving energy it is — small, invisible, but it never stops working.
sentences.zh: 那就定节约能源——微小、不起眼，但它永远在起作用。

scenes.title: 工作与职业
scenes.subtitle: Work and Careers
scenes.description: FCE 口语 · 工作与职业 · Part 1 面试问答 + Part 2 对比两图长描述 + Part 3 讨论
scenes.examTip:
**要点** 工作话题在 FCE 中既考真实经历也考观点。

**考法** Part 1 会问你理想的工作、未来计划、在家工作还是去办公室,通常会自然用到将来时(will、be going to)和现在完成时谈经历。Part 2 常给两张人们在不同环境工作的照片(如团队开会 vs 独自远程办公),要你对比并推测各自的优缺点。

**掌握** B2 学生要会用关系从句 a job where you can...、比较结构 not as ... as,以及表达偏好的句型 I'd much rather。准确使用搭配 work under pressure、meet a deadline、career path,并以一句带理由的观点收尾。

templates.en: What appeals to me most about ___ is the chance to ___.
I'd much rather work in ___ than ___, mainly because ___.
The people in the first picture seem to be ___ing, which suggests they enjoy ___.
Although both jobs have their advantages, ___ is probably more ___.

sentences.en: What kind of job would you like to have in the future?
sentences.zh: 你将来想做什么样的工作?

sentences.en: I'd love a job where I can be creative and work with people. Something in design would suit me perfectly.
sentences.zh: 我很想要一份能发挥创意又能和人打交道的工作。设计类的会非常适合我。

sentences.en: Do you think it's better to work in an office or from home?
sentences.zh: 你觉得在办公室工作好还是在家工作好?

sentences.en: It depends, really. Working from home is more flexible, but I'd miss the energy you get from being around colleagues.
sentences.zh: 其实要看情况。在家工作更灵活,但我会怀念和同事在一起所带来的那种活力。

sentences.en: Have you ever had any work experience?
sentences.zh: 你有过工作经历吗?

sentences.en: I have, actually. I did a summer job in a café, and although it was tiring, it taught me how to deal with pressure.
sentences.zh: 其实有过。我在一家咖啡馆做过暑期工,虽然很累,但它教会了我如何应对压力。

sentences.en: Is earning a lot of money important to you?
sentences.zh: 赚很多钱对你重要吗?

sentences.en: Not as much as you'd think. I'd rather do something I find meaningful than chase a big salary and feel miserable.
sentences.zh: 没你想的那么重要。我宁愿做点我觉得有意义的事,也不愿追逐高薪却过得痛苦。

sentences.en: Both pictures show people at work, but the way they're working couldn't be more different.
sentences.zh: 两张照片都展示了人们在工作,但他们工作的方式再不同不过了。

sentences.en: In the first picture, a team is having a meeting around a table, and they seem to be sharing ideas enthusiastically.
sentences.zh: 第一张照片里,一个团队围着桌子开会,他们似乎在热情地交流想法。

sentences.en: Whereas the first group are clearly collaborating, the second picture shows someone working alone from home on a laptop.
sentences.zh: 第一组人显然在协作,而第二张照片展示的是有人在家独自用笔记本电脑工作。

sentences.en: The people in the meeting are probably solving a problem together, which often produces better results than working on your own.
sentences.zh: 开会的人大概在一起解决问题,这往往比独自工作产生更好的结果。

sentences.en: On the other hand, the person at home might concentrate more easily, since there are fewer distractions and no commute.
sentences.zh: 另一方面,在家的人也许更容易集中注意力,因为干扰更少,也不用通勤。

sentences.en: Both ways of working have their advantages, although teamwork can be far more motivating when you're stuck on something.
sentences.zh: 两种工作方式都有各自的优点,不过当你卡住时,团队合作可能更能激励人。
