sentences.en: If you asked me, I'd say a mix of the two would be ideal, because you'd get the focus of home and the support of a team.
sentences.zh: 如果你问我,我会说两者结合最理想,因为你既能拥有在家的专注,又能得到团队的支持。

sentences.en: We need to discuss how these factors can influence someone's choice of career. Shall I start with salary?
sentences.zh: 我们要讨论这些因素会怎样影响一个人的职业选择。我先从薪水说起？

sentences.en: Go ahead — it's the factor everyone thinks about first, even if they pretend not to.
sentences.zh: 说吧——这是每个人最先想到的因素，哪怕嘴上不承认。

sentences.en: Well, a good salary gives you security, but on its own it doesn't make you enjoy Monday mornings.
sentences.zh: 嗯，高薪能给你安全感，但光有它并不能让你喜欢周一早晨。

sentences.en: That's where interest comes in — if you love what you do, the effort feels much lighter.
sentences.zh: 这就轮到兴趣了——如果你热爱所做的事，付出就轻松得多。

sentences.en: But passion alone can be risky, can't it? Plenty of people love things that don't pay the bills.
sentences.zh: 不过光有热情也有风险，对吧？很多人热爱的事情养不活自己。

sentences.en: True. Work-life balance might be the factor people underestimate most — burnout can ruin even a dream job.
sentences.zh: 没错。工作与生活的平衡可能是被低估得最厉害的因素——过劳能毁掉哪怕是梦想中的工作。

sentences.en: I completely agree, and career development matters too — a job with no future starts to feel like a trap.
sentences.zh: 我完全同意，发展空间也很重要——一份没有前景的工作会渐渐让人觉得像陷阱。

sentences.en: So most of these connect with each other, which makes the choice genuinely difficult.
sentences.zh: 所以这些因素大多是相互关联的，这才让选择变得真正困难。

sentences.en: It does. Still, we have to pick the single most important one — what's your call?
sentences.zh: 确实。不过我们还是得选出最重要的一个——你的选择是？

sentences.en: Honestly, I'd put work-life balance first, because without your health and time, nothing else can be enjoyed.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我会把工作与生活平衡放第一，因为没有健康和时间，其他一切都无从享受。

sentences.en: I see your point, but I'd still choose interest — it's what keeps you motivated and learning throughout your career.
sentences.zh: 我明白你的意思，但我还是会选兴趣——是它让你在整个职业生涯里保持动力、不断学习。

sentences.en: That's a strong point. I still think balance matters, but interest probably has more influence over a whole career, so let's go with that.
sentences.zh: 这点很有说服力。我仍然觉得平衡重要，但就整个职业生涯而言，兴趣的影响可能更大——那我们就选它。

scenes.title: 旅行与文化
scenes.subtitle: Travel and Culture
scenes.description: FCE 口语 · 旅行与文化 · Part 1 面试问答 + Part 2 对比两图长描述 + Part 3 讨论
learn: 比较两种方式并给理由
scenes.examTip:
**考法** 旅行话题鼓励考生展示叙事和描述能力。Part 1 会问你去过哪里、喜欢什么样的假期、是否愿意一个人旅行,通常会自然用到过去时和现在完成时讲经历(I've been to..., Last summer I went...)。

**怎么答** Part 2 常给两张不同度假方式的照片(如海滩放松 vs 城市观光),要你对比并推测人们为什么选择这样旅行。

**掌握** B2 学生要会用比较级 more relaxing than、推测语气 must be、they look as if...,并使用搭配 get away from it all、broaden your horizons、a once-in-a-lifetime experience。结尾给出一句有理由的个人偏好。

templates.en: One of the best things about travelling is the chance to ___.
The people in this picture look as if they're ___ing, so they must be ___.
I find ___ far more ___ than ___, because ___.
templates.zh: 比较两种方式并给理由

templates.en: If I were on holiday there, I'd probably ___ rather than ___.

sentences.en: Do you enjoy travelling to new places?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢去新地方旅行吗?

sentences.en: I absolutely love it. There's nothing better than exploring somewhere I've never been and trying the local food.
sentences.zh: 我超级喜欢。没有什么比探索一个我从没去过的地方、尝尝当地美食更棒的了。

sentences.en: What was the best trip you've ever been on?
sentences.zh: 你去过的最棒的旅行是哪次?

sentences.en: Probably a trip to the mountains last year. The scenery was breathtaking, and it was the most relaxing week I've had in ages.
sentences.zh: 大概是去年的一次山区之旅。风景美得让人窒息,那是我很久以来过得最放松的一周。

sentences.en: Would you prefer to travel alone or with other people?
sentences.zh: 你更喜欢独自旅行还是和别人一起?

sentences.en: It depends on my mood, but generally with friends. Sharing the experience makes the good moments even more memorable.
sentences.zh: 看心情吧,但一般是和朋友一起。分享这段经历会让那些美好时刻更难忘。

sentences.en: Do you think travel can change the way people think?
sentences.zh: 你觉得旅行能改变人们的想法吗?

sentences.en: Definitely. Seeing how other people live really broadens your horizons and makes you more open-minded.
sentences.zh: 绝对能。看到别人是怎么生活的,真的会开阔你的视野,让你更加开放包容。

sentences.en: Both pictures show people enjoying their holidays, but they've clearly chosen completely different kinds of trip.
sentences.zh: 两张照片都展示了人们在享受假期,但他们显然选择了两种完全不同的旅行方式。

sentences.en: In the first picture, a couple are lying on a sunny beach, and they look as if they haven't a care in the world.
sentences.zh: 第一张照片里,一对情侣躺在阳光明媚的海滩上,他们看起来仿佛无忧无虑。

sentences.en: Whereas the first scene is all about relaxing, the second picture shows tourists exploring a busy old city, taking photos of the buildings.
sentences.zh: 第一个场景的主题完全是放松,而第二张照片展示的是游客在探索一座繁忙的老城,给建筑拍照。

sentences.en: The people on the beach have probably chosen this because they want to switch off and get away from it all.
sentences.zh: 海滩上的人选这样大概是因为他们想彻底放空、暂时逃离一切。

sentences.en: On the other hand, the sightseers may have chosen a city break because they enjoy staying active and learning about the local culture.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，观光的人选择城市游，可能是因为他们喜欢保持活力、了解当地文化。

sentences.en: I'd say the city break is more tiring but probably more rewarding, since you come home having seen and learned so much.
sentences.zh: 我会说城市游更累,但大概更有收获,因为回家时你已经见识和学到了很多。

sentences.en: Personally, if I were choosing, I'd go for the beach, because after a stressful term all I'd really want is to rest and recharge.
sentences.zh: 就我个人而言,如果要选,我会选海滩,因为在紧张的一学期之后,我真正想要的不过是休息和恢复精力。

sentences.en: The question is why travelling is good for people. Which of these benefits speaks to you most?
sentences.zh: 问题是旅行为什么对人有益。这些好处里哪条最打动你？

sentences.en: Learning about different cultures, without a doubt — food, festivals, even how people queue.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问是了解不同文化——饮食、节日，甚至人们排队的方式。

sentences.en: Ha, queuing says a lot about a country! And once you're there, you can't avoid practising the language either.
sentences.zh: 哈，排队方式还真能说明一个国家！而且身在当地，你想不练语言都难。

sentences.en: Exactly — ordering dinner in another language teaches you more than a month of classes.
sentences.zh: 正是——用外语点一顿晚餐，比上一个月的课学得还多。

sentences.en: Travelling also forces you to become independent: reading maps, solving problems, managing money.
sentences.zh: 旅行还逼着你变得独立：看地图、解决问题、管好钱。

sentences.en: Especially when something goes wrong! Missing a train abroad teaches you to stay calm very quickly.
sentences.zh: 尤其是出岔子的时候！在国外错过一趟火车，能让你飞快学会保持冷静。

sentences.en: And of course some people travel simply to relax — lying on a beach is a benefit in itself.
sentences.zh: 当然也有人旅行纯粹是为了放松——躺在沙滩上本身就是一种收获。

sentences.en: It is, though I'd say the friendships you make on the road often outlast the suntan.
sentences.zh: 是的，不过我觉得旅途上交到的朋友，往往比晒出的肤色留得更久。

sentences.en: Nice way to put it! So, decision time — which benefit is the greatest overall?
sentences.zh: 说得真好！那到决策时间了——总体来看哪项收获最大？

sentences.en: I'd go for independence, because it changes who you are, not just what you know.
sentences.zh: 我选独立，因为它改变的是你这个人，而不只是你知道的东西。

sentences.en: That's persuasive. Cultural understanding was my first instinct, but independence stays with you everywhere.
sentences.zh: 有说服力。我的第一反应是文化理解，但独立性走到哪儿都跟着你。

sentences.en: Then we both say independence — travel as a training ground for life.
sentences.zh: 那我们都选独立——旅行就是人生的训练场。

scenes.title: 娱乐与媒体
scenes.subtitle: Entertainment and Media
scenes.description: FCE 口语 · 娱乐与媒体 · Part 1 面试问答 + Part 2 对比两图长描述 + Part 3 讨论
scenes.examTip:
**考法** 娱乐话题贴近考生生活,容易展开。Part 1 会问你喜欢看什么、听什么、更爱影院还是在家看流媒体,通常会自然用到频率副词和现在时谈习惯,并给出理由。

**场景** Part 2 常给两张人们娱乐的照片(如去看现场演出 vs 在家看电影),要你对比氛围并推测人们的偏好原因。

**注意** B2 学生要会用强调结构 What I really enjoy is...、对比语 by contrast,以及搭配 catch up on a series、a live performance、it's not really my thing。注意 B2 答案要避免只说 good/bad,改用 fascinating、overrated、hooked 等更精准的词,并以观点收尾。

templates.en: What I really enjoy about ___ is the way it ___.
Personally, I find ___ a bit overrated, whereas ___ never gets boring.
The atmosphere in the first picture looks ___, by contrast the second seems much more ___.
I could imagine the people ___ing, simply because ___.
templates.zh: 推测人物行为并给理由

sentences.en: What kind of films or series do you enjoy?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢什么类型的电影或剧?

sentences.en: I'm really into thrillers at the moment. Once I start a good series, I get completely hooked and binge the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 我最近特别迷悬疑片。一旦开始看一部好剧,我就会彻底入坑,一口气追完。

sentences.en: Do you prefer watching films at the cinema or at home?
sentences.zh: 你更喜欢在影院还是在家看电影?

sentences.en: Honestly, both have their charm. The cinema has an amazing atmosphere, but at home I can pause whenever I like.
sentences.zh: 说实话,各有各的魅力。影院有很棒的氛围,但在家我想暂停就能暂停。

sentences.en: Is live music something you'd ever pay to see?
sentences.zh: 现场音乐是你会花钱去看的吗?

sentences.en: Without a doubt. There's an energy at a live concert that you just can't get from listening at home.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问。现场演唱会有一种你在家听根本感受不到的能量。

sentences.en: Do you think people spend too much time watching screens?
sentences.zh: 你觉得人们花太多时间盯屏幕了吗?

sentences.en: Probably, yes. It's easy to lose track of time, so I try to set myself limits and do other things too.
sentences.zh: 大概是的。人很容易就忘了时间,所以我尽量给自己设限,也做点别的事。

sentences.en: Both pictures show people enjoying some form of entertainment, but the experiences feel completely different.
sentences.zh: 两张照片都展示了人们在享受某种娱乐,但这两种体验感觉完全不同。

sentences.en: In the first picture, a huge crowd is watching a live concert, and everyone seems thrilled, with their hands in the air.
sentences.zh: 第一张照片里,一大群人在看现场演唱会,所有人都举着手,看起来兴奋极了。

sentences.en: Whereas the concert is loud and full of energy, the second picture shows a family curled up on the sofa watching a film together.
sentences.zh: 演唱会喧闹又充满能量,而第二张照片展示的是一家人窝在沙发上一起看电影。

sentences.en: The people at the concert have probably paid a lot because they want a once-in-a-lifetime experience they'll never forget.
sentences.zh: 看演唱会的人大概花了不少钱,因为他们想要一次永生难忘的独特体验。

sentences.en: By contrast, the family at home might simply want a cosy, relaxing night that costs much less.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，在家的一家人可能只是想要一个舒适放松、花费少得多的夜晚。

sentences.en: I could imagine the crowd singing along, simply because that sense of being part of something is what makes live music special.
sentences.zh: 我能想象人群跟着合唱,正是因为那种融入集体的感觉,才让现场音乐如此特别。

sentences.en: If I had to choose, I'd go for the concert now and then, but for everyday relaxation a film at home is far more practical.
sentences.zh: 如果要选,我偶尔会选演唱会,但日常放松的话,在家看电影要现实得多。

sentences.en: Our question is why people choose such different kinds of entertainment. Let's compare a few.
sentences.zh: 我们的问题是人们为什么选择如此不同的娱乐方式。来比较几种吧。

sentences.en: Streaming is the easy answer — a whole series is waiting for you the moment you sit down.
sentences.zh: 流媒体是最省事的答案——你一坐下，整部剧都在等着你。

sentences.en: Which is exactly its danger: one more episode always turns into three more hours.
sentences.zh: 而这恰恰是它的危险之处：「再看一集」总会变成「再看三小时」。

sentences.en: Guilty! Live concerts are the opposite — expensive and inconvenient, but the atmosphere is unrepeatable.
sentences.zh: 说的就是我！现场演出正相反——又贵又麻烦，但那种氛围无法复制。

sentences.en: There's something about sharing a moment with thousands of people that a screen can't give you.
sentences.zh: 和几千人共享同一个瞬间的感觉，屏幕给不了。

sentences.en: Gaming gives you something else again — you're not watching the story, you're inside it.
sentences.zh: 游戏给的又是另一种东西——你不是在看故事，而是身在故事之中。

sentences.en: Fair, though books have been doing that for centuries, just with your imagination as the console.
sentences.zh: 有道理，不过书几百年来一直在做这件事，只是主机换成了你的想象力。

sentences.en: Ha! I knew you'd defend reading. Watching live sport pulls in huge audiences too, though it's never really been my thing.
sentences.zh: 哈！我就知道你会为读书辩护。看体育比赛也吸引着大批观众，不过我一直不太感冒。

sentences.en: So, decision time — maybe we should judge them by what they leave behind: some entertainment empties you, some fills you up.
sentences.zh: 那么到决策时间了——也许该看它们留下什么：有的娱乐让你被掏空，有的让你被充实。

sentences.en: By that standard I'd pick reading, even though I spend far more hours gaming.
sentences.zh: 按这个标准我会选读书，尽管我花在游戏上的时间多得多。

sentences.en: Same here — books demand more from you, but they give more back.
sentences.zh: 我也是——书对你要求更多，但回馈也更多。

sentences.en: Agreed then: reading is the one most worth our time, with a concert now and then as a treat.
sentences.zh: 那就一致了：读书最值得花时间，偶尔再看场演出犒劳自己。

scenes.title: 健康与生活
scenes.subtitle: Health and Lifestyle
scenes.description: FCE 口语 · 健康与生活 · Part 1 面试问答 + Part 2 对比两图长描述 + Part 3 讨论
learn: 说为保持健康做的努力
scenes.examTip:
**考法** 健康与生活方式话题考查考生谈论习惯和给建议的能力。Part 1 会问你如何保持健康、是否吃得均衡、压力大时怎么办,通常会自然用到频率副词、情态动词 should、以及现在完成时谈变化。Part 2 常给两张人们追求健康的照片(如户外运动 vs 在家做饭),要你对比并推测人们这样做的好处。
**掌握** B2 学生要会用结果状语 so that、让步 even though,以及搭配 keep fit、a balanced diet、relieve stress、burn off energy。
**注意** 注意避免只说 healthy/good,可用 energetic、refreshed、worn out 等更细腻的词,并以带理由的观点收尾。

templates.en: I make a real effort to ___ so that I can stay ___.
templates.zh: 说为保持健康做的努力

templates.en: Whenever I feel stressed, I tend to ___, which really helps me ___.
The person in the first picture looks ___, whereas the one in the second seems ___.
Even though ___ takes more effort, it's definitely worth it because ___.

sentences.en: What do you do to keep healthy?
sentences.zh: 你做些什么来保持健康?

sentences.en: I try to stay active and eat fairly well. I go running a couple of times a week, which keeps me feeling energetic.
sentences.zh: 我尽量保持运动,也吃得还算好。我每周跑步几次,这让我一直精力充沛。

sentences.en: Do you think young people eat a balanced diet these days?
sentences.zh: 你觉得现在的年轻人吃得均衡吗?

sentences.en: Not always, to be honest. A lot of us grab fast food because it's convenient, even though we know it isn't great for us.
sentences.zh: 说实话,并不总是。我们很多人图方便就买快餐,尽管我们知道那对身体不太好。

sentences.en: How do you usually deal with stress?
sentences.zh: 你通常怎么应对压力?

sentences.en: Whenever things get on top of me, I go for a walk or listen to music. It clears my head and helps me relax.
sentences.zh: 每当事情让我喘不过气,我就去散步或听音乐。这能让我头脑清醒,帮我放松下来。

sentences.en: Do you think people get enough sleep nowadays?
sentences.zh: 你觉得现在的人睡眠充足吗?

sentences.en: Probably not. People stay up late on their phones, and as a result they end up feeling worn out the next day.
sentences.zh: 大概不够。人们熬夜玩手机,结果第二天就感到疲惫不堪。

sentences.en: Both pictures are about people trying to look after their health, but they're going about it in different ways.
sentences.zh: 两张照片都关于人们努力照顾自己的健康,但他们采取的方式不同。

sentences.en: In the first picture, a young woman is running outdoors in a park, and she looks energetic despite obviously working hard.
sentences.zh: 第一张照片里,一位年轻女子在公园里户外跑步,尽管显然很卖力,她看起来精力充沛。

sentences.en: Whereas the runner is burning off energy through exercise, the second picture shows someone preparing a fresh, healthy meal at home.
sentences.zh: 跑步的人通过运动来消耗精力,而第二张照片展示的是有人在家准备新鲜健康的一餐。

sentences.en: The woman running has probably chosen exercise because it not only keeps her fit but also helps relieve stress.
sentences.zh: 跑步的女子选择运动,大概是因为它不仅让她保持健康,还有助于缓解压力。

sentences.en: On the other hand, the person cooking might believe that a balanced diet matters just as much as staying active.
sentences.zh: 另一方面,做饭的人也许认为均衡的饮食和保持运动同样重要。

sentences.en: Even though cooking from scratch takes more effort than buying ready-made food, it's definitely worth it for your health.
sentences.zh: 尽管从头做饭比买现成的食物更费工夫,但为了健康,这绝对值得。

sentences.en: If you asked me, I'd say the ideal approach is to combine the two, because exercise and good food really work best together.
sentences.zh: 如果你问我,我会说理想的做法是两者结合,因为运动和好的饮食确实是相辅相成、效果最佳。

sentences.en: The card asks how each of these factors helps people maintain a healthy lifestyle. Shall we start with sleep?
sentences.zh: 卡片问的是这些因素分别如何帮助人保持健康的生活方式。我们先从睡眠说起？

sentences.en: Sleep, definitely. Everything falls apart when you've only had five hours.
sentences.zh: 肯定是睡眠。只睡五个小时的话，一切都会垮掉。

sentences.en: Absolutely — and yet students treat sleep as the first thing to sacrifice before exams.
sentences.zh: 完全同意——可学生们偏偏把睡眠当成考前第一个牺牲品。

sentences.en: Which is ironic, since a tired brain remembers almost nothing. What about diet?
sentences.zh: 这很讽刺，因为疲惫的大脑几乎记不住东西。那饮食呢？

sentences.en: A balanced diet matters, though I'd say most people know the theory and just find it hard to follow.
sentences.zh: 均衡饮食很重要，不过我觉得大多数人都懂道理，只是难做到。

sentences.en: Same with exercise — gyms are full in January and empty by March.
sentences.zh: 运动也一样——健身房一月人满为患，三月就空空荡荡。

sentences.en: Ha, true! But stress management is different — many people don't even realise it's a health issue.
sentences.zh: 哈，太真实了！但压力管理不一样——很多人根本没意识到它是个健康问题。

sentences.en: They treat headaches and bad moods as a normal part of life instead of warning signs.
sentences.zh: 他们把头疼和坏情绪当成生活的正常部分，而不是警示信号。

sentences.en: So, which of the five do we think is the most overlooked?
sentences.zh: 那么，五项里我们认为哪一项最容易被忽视？

sentences.en: I'd argue it's stress management, for exactly the reason you gave — it's invisible until it's serious.
sentences.zh: 我认为是压力管理，理由正是你刚说的——它在变严重之前是隐形的。

sentences.en: I was tempted to say check-ups, but you're right: stress does damage quietly every single day.
sentences.zh: 我本想说体检，但你是对的：压力每天都在悄悄造成伤害。

sentences.en: Stress management it is, then — the health habit nobody puts in their timetable.
sentences.zh: 那就定压力管理——这是没人写进日程表的健康习惯。

scenes.title: 人际关系与友谊
scenes.subtitle: Relationships and Friendship
scenes.description: FCE 高频话题:交友方式、维系友谊、什么算好朋友。Part 1 深答 + Part 2 两类友谊对比独白。 + Part 3 讨论
learn: 对比独处友谊 vs 群体社交
用 Personally 表个人看法
scenes.examTip: **考法** 人际关系是 FCE 高频话题。Part 1 考官会问你的交友方式、如何维系老友、什么样才算好朋友,回答给出 2 句左右并说明理由(常用现在时+现在完成时)。Part 2 常给「两人独处 vs 群体聚会」的对比图,用 whereas / on the other hand 对比,结尾用 Personally 表个人看法。

templates.en: I'd say I have ___ rather than ___.
It matters a great deal to me because ___.
For me, it comes down to ___.
Personally, I'd say ___, since ___.

sentences.en: Do you have a large group of friends, or just a few close ones?
sentences.zh: 你朋友很多,还是只有几个亲密的?

sentences.en: I'd say I have a small circle of close friends rather than lots of acquaintances. I find it much easier to be myself around people who really know me.
sentences.zh: 我会说我有一小圈亲密朋友,而不是一堆泛泛之交。在真正了解我的人面前,我更容易做自己。

sentences.en: How important is it to you to keep in touch with old friends?
sentences.zh: 和老朋友保持联系对你有多重要?

sentences.en: It matters a great deal to me. Even if we don't speak for months, there's a real comfort in knowing they'll still be there when it counts.
sentences.zh: 对我非常重要。即使几个月不联系,一想到关键时刻他们仍会在,就让人很安心。

sentences.en: Do you think it's possible to make genuine friends online?
sentences.zh: 你觉得能在网上交到真心朋友吗?

sentences.en: Absolutely, though it does take time. I've met people through shared hobbies online who've become just as close as my offline friends.
sentences.zh: 当然,不过确实需要时间。我在网上因共同爱好认识的人,有些已经和我线下的朋友一样亲近。

sentences.en: What do you think makes someone a good friend?
sentences.zh: 你觉得什么样的人算好朋友?

sentences.en: For me, it comes down to trust and being a good listener. A real friend sticks around when things get difficult, not just when it's fun.
sentences.zh: 对我来说,关键在于信任和会倾听。真朋友在困难时也不离开,而不只是在开心时才在。

sentences.en: Both photographs show people spending time together, but the nature of their relationships looks quite different.
sentences.zh: 两张照片都展示人们共处,但关系的性质看起来很不一样。

sentences.en: In the first picture, two friends are sitting in a café, deep in conversation and clearly enjoying each other's company.
sentences.zh: 第一张照片里,两个朋友坐在咖啡馆里,聊得很投入,显然很享受彼此的陪伴。

sentences.en: The second image, by contrast, shows a large group at what looks like a party, all laughing and celebrating together.
sentences.zh: 相比之下,第二张展示的是一大群人在类似聚会的场合,一起说笑、庆祝。

sentences.en: The pair in the café might be catching up after a long time apart, sharing something personal that matters to them both.
sentences.zh: 咖啡馆里那两个人可能是久别重逢在叙旧,分享着对彼此都重要的私事。

sentences.en: On the other hand, the group in the second photo seem more focused on enjoying themselves together than building individual connections.
sentences.zh: 另一方面,第二张里的那群人似乎更在意一起玩乐,而非建立一对一的联系。

sentences.en: I imagine people value both kinds of relationship, because we need close friends to confide in as well as a wider circle to enjoy ourselves with.
sentences.zh: 我想人们对两种关系都很看重,因为我们既需要能倾诉的密友,也需要一个能一起玩乐的更大圈子。

sentences.en: Personally, I'd say the quieter, one-to-one friendship looks more meaningful to me, since that's usually where the deepest bonds are formed.
sentences.zh: 就我个人而言,那种安静的一对一友谊对我更有意义,因为最深的情谊通常正是在那里建立的。

sentences.en: So what makes a friendship last? The card gives us five ingredients.
sentences.zh: 什么让友谊长久？卡片给了我们五种「配料」。

sentences.en: Trust has to be the foundation — without it, everything else is just acting.
sentences.zh: 信任必须是地基——没有它，其他一切都只是演戏。

sentences.en: I completely agree. But friendships often start with shared interests, don't they? You bond over the same music or team.
sentences.zh: 我完全同意。不过友谊往往是从共同兴趣开始的，对吧？因为同一种音乐或同一支球队走到一起。

sentences.en: They start there, but interests change — my oldest friend and I like completely different things now.
sentences.zh: 开始是那样，但兴趣会变——我和我最老的朋友现在喜欢的东西完全不同。

sentences.en: And you're still close, which rather proves the point. What kept you together, then?
sentences.zh: 可你们依然亲密，这恰恰说明了问题。那是什么让你们没散？

sentences.en: Honest communication, I think — we argue sometimes, but we never pretend.
sentences.zh: 我想是坦诚的沟通——我们有时会争吵，但从不假装。

sentences.en: That takes courage. Support in hard times matters enormously too — that's when you learn who your real friends are.
sentences.zh: 那需要勇气。困难时的支持也极其重要——那时你才知道谁是真朋友。

sentences.en: And giving each other space — clinging too tightly can suffocate even a good friendship.
sentences.zh: 还有给彼此空间——抓得太紧，再好的友谊也会窒息。

sentences.en: All five matter, clearly. But if we had to crown one as the most important, which would it be?
sentences.zh: 显然五个都重要。但如果必须选出最重要的一个，会是哪个？

sentences.en: Trust, for me — it's what makes honesty, support and space possible in the first place.
sentences.zh: 我选信任——正是它让坦诚、支持和空间成为可能。

sentences.en: You've convinced me. The others are branches; trust is the root.
sentences.zh: 你说服我了。其他都是枝干，信任才是根。

sentences.en: Then it's settled — trust is what makes a friendship last.
sentences.zh: 那就定了——让友谊长久的是信任。

scenes.title: 教育与学习
scenes.subtitle: Education and Learning
scenes.description: FCE 高频话题:学习方式、课堂 vs 自学、教育的意义。Part 1 深答 + Part 2 学习场景对比独白。 + Part 3 讨论
learn: 评价考试与实践的价值
对比传统课堂 vs 在线自学
scenes.examTip: **考法** 教育是 FCE 常考话题。Part 1 考官会问你喜欢的学习方式、考试是否重要、学校教育的价值,回答要给理由和例子。Part 2 常给「课堂上课 vs 独自在线学习」的对比图,用 whereas / while 对比两种方式的利弊,结尾表明个人偏好。

templates.en: I learn best when ___.
There's a lot to be said for ___.
While ___ suits some people, I personally prefer ___.
At the end of the day, what matters most is ___.

sentences.en: How do you prefer to study — on your own or with others?
sentences.zh: 你更喜欢怎么学习——自己学还是和别人一起?

sentences.en: It really depends on the subject, but on the whole I learn best on my own, in a quiet place where I can focus without any distractions.
sentences.zh: 这其实要看科目,但总体上我一个人在安静、没干扰的地方学得最好。

sentences.en: Do you think exams are a fair way to measure ability?
sentences.zh: 你觉得考试是衡量能力的公平方式吗?

sentences.en: Not entirely, to be honest. They show how well you perform under pressure, but they don't always capture creativity or practical skills.
sentences.zh: 老实说,不完全公平。考试能看出你在压力下的表现,却未必能反映创造力或实际能力。

sentences.en: Have you ever learned something useful outside of school?
sentences.zh: 你有没有在学校之外学到过有用的东西?

sentences.en: Definitely. I taught myself to edit videos through online tutorials, and it's turned out to be far more useful than I ever expected.
sentences.zh: 当然。我通过网上教程自学了剪辑视频,结果发现它比我预想的有用得多。

sentences.en: How important do you think it is to keep learning as an adult?
sentences.zh: 你觉得成年后继续学习有多重要?

sentences.en: I'd say it's essential these days. The world changes so quickly that if you stop learning, you can fall behind before you even realise it.
sentences.zh: 我觉得如今这是必需的。世界变化太快,你一旦停止学习,可能还没察觉就已经落后了。

sentences.en: Both pictures show different approaches to learning, one based on direct interaction and the other on independent study.
sentences.zh: 两张照片展示了两种不同的学习方式,一种基于直接互动,另一种基于自主学习。

sentences.en: In the first one, a class of students is listening to a teacher, who seems to be explaining something at the front of the room.
sentences.zh: 第一张里,一班学生在听老师讲课,老师似乎正在教室前面讲解着什么。

sentences.en: The second picture, by contrast, shows a young person studying alone at home, following a lesson on their laptop.
sentences.zh: 相比之下,第二张展示的是一个年轻人独自在家,跟着笔记本电脑上的课程学习。

sentences.en: The students in the classroom have the advantage of asking questions directly and learning from one another.
sentences.zh: 教室里的学生有个好处,就是能直接提问、彼此学习。

sentences.en: On the other hand, the person studying online can work at their own pace and revisit anything they find difficult.
sentences.zh: 另一方面,在线学习的人可以按自己的节奏来,任何觉得难的地方都能反复看。

sentences.en: I think both approaches are valuable, since some people thrive on interaction while others concentrate better in their own space.
sentences.zh: 我觉得两种方式各有价值,有些人在互动中如鱼得水,另一些人则在自己的空间里更专注。

sentences.en: Personally, I'd choose a mix of the two, because the discipline of a classroom combined with the flexibility of online study would suit me best.
sentences.zh: 就我个人而言,我会选两者结合,因为课堂的纪律加上在线学习的灵活最适合我。

sentences.en: The question is what helps students learn best. Five ideas here — let's weigh them up.
sentences.zh: 问题是什么最能帮助学生学习。这里有五个选项——我们来掂量掂量。

sentences.en: An inspiring teacher can change everything. I still remember exactly how my primary teacher explained fractions.
sentences.zh: 一位有感染力的老师能改变一切。我到现在都记得小学老师讲分数的样子。

sentences.en: That's the thing about great teachers — you remember them decades later, not just the facts.
sentences.zh: 好老师就是这样——几十年后你记住的是他们这个人，而不只是知识点。

sentences.en: Small classes help too, because the teacher actually notices when you're lost.
sentences.zh: 小班教学也有用，因为老师真的能注意到你什么时候听懵了。

sentences.en: True, although small classes with a boring teacher still produce bored students!
sentences.zh: 没错，不过小班配上无聊的老师，教出来的还是无聊的学生！

sentences.en: Ha! What do you make of technology, then — tablets, learning apps, all of that?
sentences.zh: 哈！那你怎么看科技——平板、学习类App这些？

sentences.en: Useful as a tool, but it's a servant, not a master. An app can't see that you're having a bad day.
sentences.zh: 作为工具很有用，但它是仆人不是主人。App 看不出你今天状态不好。

sentences.en: Nicely put. And hands-on practice makes knowledge stick — you understand a circuit by building one.
sentences.zh: 说得好。动手实践能让知识扎根——亲手搭一个电路，你才真正理解它。

sentences.en: So, decision time: which single factor has the greatest impact?
sentences.zh: 那么到决策时间了：哪一个因素影响最大？

sentences.en: I keep coming back to the teacher — every other factor works better with a good one in the room.
sentences.zh: 我总是绕回到老师身上——教室里有位好老师，其他所有因素都会更有效。

sentences.en: Agreed, though I'd add that family support is the invisible half — a child who's encouraged at home arrives ready to learn.
sentences.zh: 同意，不过我想补充：家庭支持是看不见的另一半——在家被鼓励的孩子，走进教室时已经准备好学习了。

sentences.en: Then our answer is the teacher first, with family support as the essential partner behind the scenes.
sentences.zh: 那我们的答案就是：老师第一，家庭支持是幕后不可缺少的搭档。

scenes.title: 理想与未来
scenes.subtitle: Ambitions and the Future
scenes.description: FCE 高频话题:未来计划、梦想职业、成功的定义。Part 1 深答 + Part 2 追梦场景对比独白。 + Part 3 讨论
learn: 对比稳定 vs 冒险的人生路
scenes.examTip: **考法** 理想与未来是 FCE 常考话题。Part 1 考官会问你的未来计划、想从事的工作、如何定义成功,回答多用 would like to / hope to / be planning to,并给理由。Part 2 常给「稳定工作 vs 追逐梦想」的对比图,用条件句(If...)设想不同选择,结尾表明自己的价值取向。

templates.en: In the long run, I'd like to ___.
What matters more to me than money is ___.
If I had the chance, I would ___.
Success, to me, means ___ rather than ___.

sentences.en: Do you have a clear idea of what you'd like to do in the future?
sentences.zh: 你对未来想做什么有清晰的想法吗?

sentences.en: Roughly, yes. In the long run I'd like to work in something creative, though I'm still keeping my options open for now.
sentences.zh: 大致有。长远来看我想做点有创造性的工作,不过目前我还在保留各种可能。

sentences.en: Is earning a lot of money important to you?
sentences.zh: 赚很多钱对你重要吗?

sentences.en: It's nice to be comfortable, of course, but what matters more to me than money is doing something I actually find meaningful.
sentences.zh: 生活宽裕当然好,但对我来说比钱更重要的,是做一件我真正觉得有意义的事。

sentences.en: If you could live anywhere in the world, where would it be?
sentences.zh: 如果你能住在世界任何地方,会选哪里?

sentences.en: If I had the chance, I'd live somewhere by the coast. Being near the sea has always helped me think clearly and feel more relaxed.
sentences.zh: 如果有机会,我想住在海边。靠近大海总能让我思路清晰、更放松。

sentences.en: How would you define a successful life?
sentences.zh: 你会怎样定义成功的人生?

sentences.en: For me, success means having good relationships and being content with what I do, rather than simply climbing to the top of a career ladder.
sentences.zh: 对我而言,成功是拥有好的人际关系、对自己所做的事感到满足,而不只是爬到职业阶梯的顶端。

sentences.en: Both images seem to capture people at an important turning point in their lives, but their choices look very different.
sentences.zh: 两张照片似乎都捕捉到人们人生的重要转折点,但他们的选择看起来很不一样。

sentences.en: In the first picture, a young woman in an office looks settled and confident, as though she's built a stable career.
sentences.zh: 第一张里,一位年轻女性在办公室里显得安稳自信,仿佛已经建立起稳定的事业。

sentences.en: The second one, on the other hand, shows someone travelling with a backpack, apparently chasing a very different kind of dream.
sentences.zh: 第二张则展示一个背着背包旅行的人,显然在追逐一种截然不同的梦想。

sentences.en: The woman in the office may well value security and a steady income, which could allow her to plan ahead with more confidence.
sentences.zh: 办公室里的女性很可能看重安全感和稳定收入,这让她能有底气地规划未来。

sentences.en: In contrast, the traveller seems willing to take risks and gain new experiences, even if that means giving up some stability.
sentences.zh: 相反，旅行者似乎愿意冒险去获得新的经历，哪怕这意味着放弃一些安稳。

sentences.en: If I'm honest, I can see the appeal of both, since we all have to balance our dreams against the need to feel secure.
sentences.zh: 说实话,两者的吸引力我都能理解,因为我们都得在梦想和安全感之间寻找平衡。

sentences.en: Personally, I'd lean towards the traveller's path while I'm young, because I believe experiences shape us far more than possessions ever could.
sentences.zh: 就我个人而言,趁年轻我更倾向旅行者的道路,因为我相信经历对人的塑造远胜过任何财物。

sentences.en: What does it take to achieve a long-term goal? The card lists five things.
sentences.zh: 实现一个长远目标需要什么？卡片列了五样东西。

sentences.en: A clear plan seems the logical start — without one, effort just leaks away in all directions.
sentences.zh: 清晰的计划似乎是合理的起点——没有它，努力就会四处漏掉。

sentences.en: But plans rarely survive reality, do they? Life keeps rewriting them.
sentences.zh: 不过计划很少能扛得住现实，对吧？生活总在不断改写它们。

sentences.en: Which is exactly why persistence matters more — the people who succeed are usually the ones who simply don't stop.
sentences.zh: 所以坚持才更重要——成功的人通常就是那些不肯停下来的人。

sentences.en: There's a lot of truth in that. A mentor can save you years, though, by pointing out the mistakes you can't see.
sentences.zh: 这话很有道理。不过良师能帮你省下好几年——他们能指出你自己看不见的错误。

sentences.en: If you're lucky enough to find one! Which brings us to luck itself — does it deserve a place on this list?
sentences.zh: 前提是你有幸遇到！这就说到运气本身了——它配出现在这张单子上吗？

sentences.en: Honestly, yes. Being in the right place at the right time has launched many careers — but you can't rely on it.
sentences.zh: 老实说，配。天时地利成就过许多人——但你不能指望它。

sentences.en: And confidence is what lets you act when the lucky moment appears, instead of hesitating.
sentences.zh: 而自信是让你在幸运时刻出现时敢于行动、而不是犹豫的东西。

sentences.en: Well argued. So which one is truly indispensable — the thing you cannot do without?
sentences.zh: 说得好。那哪一样是真正不可或缺、缺了就不行的？

sentences.en: Persistence, without question. Plans fail, mentors leave, luck runs out — determination remains.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问是坚持。计划会失败，导师会离开，运气会用完——只有那份决心一直在。

sentences.en: I'd have chosen confidence, but I admit even confidence grows out of persisting through failures.
sentences.zh: 我本来会选自信，但我承认，连自信也是在一次次失败中坚持出来的。

sentences.en: Then persistence takes the crown — the engine that keeps every other quality running.
sentences.zh: 那桂冠就给坚持——它是让其他所有品质持续运转的引擎。

scenes.title: 生活方式与节奏
scenes.subtitle: Lifestyle and Daily Habits
scenes.description: FCE 高频话题:作息习惯、工作生活平衡、想改变的习惯。Part 1 深答 + Part 2 忙碌 vs 悠闲生活对比。 + Part 3 讨论
learn: 对比快节奏 vs 慢生活
用条件句谈想改的习惯
scenes.examTip: **考法** 生活方式是 FCE 常考话题。Part 1 考官会问你的日常作息、如何平衡工作与休息、有没有想改的习惯,回答多用一般现在时+频率副词,并给理由。Part 2 常给「忙碌都市 vs 悠闲慢生活」的对比图,用 whereas / by contrast 对比节奏,结尾表明自己更向往哪种。

templates.en: I tend to ___ most days, although ___.
I try to strike a balance between ___ and ___.
One habit I'd love to change is ___.
Given the choice, I'd rather ___ than ___.

sentences.en: Are you more of an early riser or a night owl?
sentences.zh: 你更像早起的人还是夜猫子?

sentences.en: Definitely a night owl, I'm afraid. I do my best thinking late at night, though I know it isn't the healthiest routine.
sentences.zh: 恐怕绝对是夜猫子。我在深夜思路最清晰,尽管我知道这不是最健康的作息。

sentences.en: How do you usually balance work or study with relaxing?
sentences.zh: 你通常怎么平衡工作学习和放松?

sentences.en: I try to strike a balance by setting clear cut-off times. Once I finish for the day, I make a point of switching off completely.
sentences.zh: 我靠设定明确的收工时间来平衡。一旦当天结束,我会刻意让自己彻底放松下来。

sentences.en: Is there a habit you'd like to change?
sentences.zh: 有没有你想改掉的习惯?

sentences.en: One habit I'd love to change is checking my phone first thing in the morning. It makes me feel distracted for the rest of the day.
sentences.zh: 我很想改掉的一个习惯是一早醒来就看手机。它给一整天定下了焦躁的基调。

sentences.en: Do you think people's lifestyles are healthier than they used to be?
sentences.zh: 你觉得现在人们的生活方式比过去更健康吗?

sentences.en: In some ways, yes, since people are far more aware of diet and exercise. That said, we also sit in front of screens far more than before.
sentences.zh: 某些方面是的,因为人们对饮食和运动的意识强多了。不过话说回来,我们盯着屏幕的时间也远比从前多。

sentences.en: Both pictures capture very different lifestyles, one fast-paced and the other far more laid-back.
sentences.zh: 两张照片捕捉了截然不同的生活方式,一种快节奏,另一种则悠闲得多。

sentences.en: In the first image, a woman is rushing through a busy city street, coffee in hand, clearly in a hurry to get somewhere.
sentences.zh: 第一张里,一位女士手拿咖啡快步穿过繁忙的城市街道,显然在赶着去某个地方。

sentences.en: The second picture, by contrast, shows a man relaxing in a hammock by the sea, with nothing pressing to do.
sentences.zh: 相比之下,第二张展示一个男人惬意地躺在海边吊床上,没有任何紧要的事要做。

sentences.en: The woman in the city might enjoy that energy and the feeling of always being busy.
sentences.zh: 城市里那位女士也许正是靠这种活力和时刻有目标的感觉而充满干劲。

sentences.en: On the other hand, the man by the sea seems to have made a conscious choice to slow down and appreciate the moment.
sentences.zh: 另一方面,海边那个男人似乎是有意选择放慢脚步、享受当下。

sentences.en: I suspect most of us swing between the two, chasing deadlines during the week and craving peace at the weekend.
sentences.zh: 我猜我们大多数人都在两者之间摆荡,平日追着截止日期跑,周末又渴望宁静。

sentences.en: Personally, I'd lean towards the slower pace, since I believe we do our best work when we're rested rather than run down.
sentences.zh: 就我个人而言,我更倾向慢节奏,因为我相信人在休息充分而非精疲力竭时才能做出最好的成果。

sentences.en: The card asks how people can make fast-paced lives more balanced. Quite a modern problem, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 卡片问人们如何让快节奏的生活更平衡。很「当代」的问题，对吧？

sentences.en: Very. Working less overtime would be the direct answer, but many people feel they simply can't refuse.
sentences.zh: 非常。少加班是最直接的答案，但很多人觉得根本没法拒绝。

sentences.en: Exactly — the pressure comes from the whole workplace culture, not just personal choice.
sentences.zh: 正是——压力来自整个职场文化，不只是个人选择。

sentences.en: A digital detox is more within our control: phone off after nine, and the evening suddenly doubles in length.
sentences.zh: 数字排毒就更在我们掌控之内：九点后关手机，晚上的时间瞬间翻倍。

sentences.en: I tried it for a week — it was uncomfortable for two days and wonderful afterwards.
sentences.zh: 我试过一周——头两天难受，之后美妙极了。

sentences.en: That's encouraging! Hobbies work in a similar way: an hour of painting or playing the guitar completely clears your head.
sentences.zh: 真让人心动！爱好也有类似作用：画一小时画或弹一小时吉他，头脑就完全清爽了。

sentences.en: And exercise does the same for the body — even a twenty-minute walk clears the fog.
sentences.zh: 运动对身体也是同理——哪怕散步二十分钟，脑子里的雾就散了。

sentences.en: Then there's family time, which is often what actually gets sacrificed first.
sentences.zh: 还有陪家人的时间——它往往才是最先被牺牲掉的。

sentences.en: Sadly true. So if someone could only start with one change, which should it be?
sentences.zh: 很遗憾，确实如此。那如果一个人只能先做一个改变，该是哪个？

sentences.en: I'd say the digital detox, because it automatically creates time for hobbies, exercise and family.
sentences.zh: 我会说数字排毒，因为它会自动为爱好、运动和家人腾出时间。

sentences.en: That's clever — it creates time for three of the other changes: hobbies, exercise and family time.
sentences.zh: 这个想法妙——它为另外三项改变腾出了时间：爱好、运动和陪家人。

sentences.en: So we recommend starting with a digital detox: one switch, several rewards.
sentences.zh: 那我们就推荐从数字排毒开始：关一个开关，收获好几份回报。

scenes.title: 饮食与美食
scenes.subtitle: Food and Eating Habits
scenes.description: FCE 高频话题:饮食习惯、在家做饭 vs 外食、健康饮食。Part 1 深答 + Part 2 家庭聚餐 vs 快餐对比。 + Part 3 讨论
learn: 对比聚餐 vs 独食快餐
scenes.examTip: **考法** 饮食是 FCE 常考话题。Part 1 考官会问你的饮食习惯、常做饭还是外食、是否注意健康,回答给出具体例子和理由。Part 2 常给「家庭围坐聚餐 vs 独自吃快餐」的对比图,用 whereas 对比,谈食物在社交与健康中的角色,结尾表个人偏好。

templates.en: I'm quite fond of ___, especially when ___.
I'd rather cook at home because ___.
There's something special about ___.
On the whole, I try to ___.

sentences.en: Do you enjoy cooking, or do you prefer eating out?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢做饭,还是更喜欢在外面吃?

sentences.en: I genuinely enjoy cooking when I have the time. There's something satisfying about making a meal from scratch and sharing it with others.
sentences.zh: 有时间的时候我是真心享受做饭。从头做一顿饭再和别人分享,有种特别的满足感。

sentences.en: Has your diet changed much over the years?
sentences.zh: 这些年你的饮食变化大吗?

sentences.en: Quite a bit, actually. I've cut down on processed food and started eating far more vegetables than I did as a teenager.
sentences.zh: 其实变化不小。我减少了加工食品,蔬菜也比青少年时期吃得多多了。

sentences.en: Is there a dish from your country you'd recommend to a visitor?
sentences.zh: 有没有你家乡的一道菜想推荐给游客?

sentences.en: I'd definitely recommend our dumplings. They're the kind of dish families make together, so they represent family traditions as well as having great flavour.
sentences.zh: 我一定会推荐我们的饺子。那是一家人一起包的菜,所以除了味道,还承载着很多意义。

sentences.en: Do you think people pay enough attention to healthy eating?
sentences.zh: 你觉得人们对健康饮食的关注够吗?

sentences.en: It varies a lot. Some people are very careful, but for many others, busy lifestyles make it far too easy to reach for convenience food.
sentences.zh: 差别很大。有些人很讲究,但对很多其他人来说,忙碌的生活让人太容易随手就吃方便食品了。

sentences.en: Both photographs show people eating, but the atmosphere around each meal could hardly be more different.
sentences.zh: 两张照片都展示人们在吃饭,但两顿饭的氛围简直天差地别。

sentences.en: In the first picture, a whole family is gathered around a table, sharing dishes and chatting happily over dinner.
sentences.zh: 第一张里,一家人围坐在餐桌旁,一边分享菜肴,一边愉快地聊着晚餐。

sentences.en: The second image shows a young man eating a burger alone at his desk, apparently grabbing a quick bite between tasks.
sentences.zh: 第二张展示一个年轻男子独自在办公桌前吃汉堡,显然是在工作间隙匆匆填个肚子。

sentences.en: The family meal is about far more than food; it's a chance to reconnect at the end of a busy day.
sentences.zh: 家庭聚餐远不只是吃饭,更是在忙碌一天后重新联络感情的机会。

sentences.en: The man eating alone, by contrast, is probably prioritising convenience and fitting food around a packed schedule.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，独自吃饭的男士大概是把方便放在第一位，在排得满满的日程里挤时间吃饭。

sentences.en: I imagine both scenes are increasingly common, as modern life pulls us between the meals we'd like and the meals we have time for.
sentences.zh: 我想这两种场景都越来越常见,因为现代生活让我们在想吃的饭和有时间吃的饭之间挣扎。

sentences.en: Personally, I find the shared family meal far more appealing, since eating together gives people a chance to reconnect and slow down.
sentences.zh: 就我个人而言，全家共餐更吸引我，因为一起吃饭让人有机会重新联结、放慢脚步。

sentences.en: Why are people's eating habits changing? The card offers five possible reasons.
sentences.zh: 人们的饮食习惯为什么在变？卡片给了五个可能的原因。

sentences.en: Delivery apps must be part of it — dinner now arrives faster than you can cook rice.
sentences.zh: 外卖 App 肯定是原因之一——现在晚饭送到的速度比你煮米饭还快。

sentences.en: Convenient, but it quietly changes what we consider a 'normal' meal — often saltier and greasier.
sentences.zh: 方便是方便，但它悄悄改变了我们对「一顿正常饭」的定义——往往更咸更油。

sentences.en: On the other hand, health awareness is pushing in the opposite direction — sugar-free this, high-protein that.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，健康意识正把人往反方向推——这个无糖、那个高蛋白。

sentences.en: The two trends literally fight each other in the same shopping basket!
sentences.zh: 这两股潮流简直是在同一个购物篮里打架！

sentences.en: Nicely observed. Sustainable eating is a newer trend — some of my friends have cut down on meat for the planet, not for their waistline.
sentences.zh: 观察得妙。可持续饮食是更新的潮流——我有些朋友少吃肉是为了地球，不是为了腰围。

sentences.en: And cooking shows have turned food into entertainment — people watch chefs for hours yet order takeaway for dinner.
sentences.zh: 烹饪节目则把食物变成了娱乐——人们看大厨看几个小时，晚饭却还是点外卖。

sentences.en: Ha! And the pace of modern life may well connect several of these trends.
sentences.zh: 哈！而现代生活的节奏，很可能正是把这几股潮流串起来的那条线。

sentences.en: So, time to decide: which of these has the biggest influence on how we eat?
sentences.zh: 那么该决定了：这些原因里哪个对我们的饮食影响最大？

sentences.en: I'd argue it's the fast pace of life — it's what makes delivery apps so irresistible in the first place.
sentences.zh: 我认为是快节奏生活——正是它让外卖 App 一开始就变得难以抗拒。

sentences.en: Convincing. I nearly said health awareness, but that's still a smaller force than simple lack of time.
sentences.zh: 有说服力。我差点选健康意识，但它的力量仍然比不过「没时间」这三个字。

sentences.en: Agreed — the pace of life shapes our plates more than anything else.
sentences.zh: 一致通过——塑造我们餐盘的，首先是生活的节奏。

scenes.title: 金钱与消费
scenes.subtitle: Money and Spending
scenes.description: FCE 高频话题:消费习惯、存钱、网购 vs 实体店。Part 1 深答 + Part 2 逛店 vs 网购对比。 + Part 3 讨论
learn: 对比实体购物 vs 网购
用 rather than 表取舍
scenes.examTip: **考法** 金钱消费是 FCE 常考话题。Part 1 考官会问你的花钱习惯、是否存钱、喜欢网购还是逛店,回答要有具体例子和价值判断。Part 2 常给「实体店逛街 vs 在家网购」的对比图,用 whereas 对比两种方式的利弊,谈便利与体验的取舍,结尾表个人偏好。

templates.en: I'd describe myself as a fairly ___ spender.
I'd rather spend money on ___ than on ___.
The main appeal of ___ is that ___.
That said, nothing quite beats ___.

sentences.en: Would you describe yourself as a spender or a saver?
sentences.zh: 你会说自己是爱花钱的人还是爱存钱的人?

sentences.en: Honestly, a bit of both. I'm careful with everyday expenses, but I don't mind splashing out on things that genuinely last.
sentences.zh: 老实说,两者都有点。日常开销我很谨慎,但对真正耐用的东西,我不介意大方一点。

sentences.en: Do you prefer shopping online or in actual stores?
sentences.zh: 你更喜欢网购还是逛实体店?

sentences.en: It depends on what I'm buying. For everyday items I shop online for convenience, but for clothes I'd rather try things on in person.
sentences.zh: 看买什么。日常用品我图方便就网购,但买衣服我还是宁愿到店里试穿。

sentences.en: What's the best thing you've ever spent money on?
sentences.zh: 你花过最值的一笔钱是什么?

sentences.en: Without a doubt, travelling. I'd rather spend money on experiences than on possessions, because the memories stay with you for life.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问是旅行。比起买东西,我更愿意把钱花在经历上,因为那些回忆会伴随你一生。

sentences.en: Do you think young people today are good at managing money?
sentences.zh: 你觉得现在的年轻人擅长理财吗?

sentences.en: It's a mixed picture. Many are surprisingly good at saving and managing money, yet easy online shopping can lead others into debt.
sentences.zh: 情况参差不齐。很多人在存钱和投资上出人意料地精明,但网上消费的便利也可能诱使另一些人陷入负债。

sentences.en: Both pictures show people shopping, but they've chosen two quite different ways of going about it.
sentences.zh: 两张照片都展示人们在购物,但他们选择了两种颇为不同的方式。

sentences.en: In the first image, a couple are browsing the shops in a busy shopping centre, carrying bags and clearly enjoying the outing.
sentences.zh: 第一张图里，一对情侣正在热闹的购物中心逛店，拎着购物袋，显然很享受这次出行。

sentences.en: The second picture, by contrast, shows a woman shopping from her sofa, comparing products on a tablet at home.
sentences.zh: 相比之下,第二张展示一位女士窝在沙发上购物,在家用平板比较各种商品。

sentences.en: The couple at the shopping centre are treating it as a social occasion, something to do together rather than just a transaction.
sentences.zh: 购物中心里那对情侣把它当成一种社交活动,是可以一起做的事,而不只是一笔交易。

sentences.en: The main appeal of shopping online, however, is convenience: you can compare prices instantly and avoid the crowds altogether.
sentences.zh: 而网购的主要吸引力在于便利:你能即时比价,还完全避开了人群。

sentences.en: I'd say each suits a different mood, since sometimes we want the lively atmosphere of shops and streets and other times we just want it done quickly.
sentences.zh: 我会说两者适合不同的心情,有时我们想要商业街的热闹,有时只想赶快搞定。

sentences.en: Personally, I lean towards online shopping for convenience, but nothing quite beats wandering round the shops on a lazy afternoon.
sentences.zh: 就我个人而言,图方便我更偏向网购,但没什么比得上在慵懒的午后随意逛逛店铺。

sentences.en: How should young people learn to manage money? Five methods on the card — let's dig in.
sentences.zh: 年轻人该如何学会管钱？卡片上有五种办法——我们来深入聊聊。

sentences.en: A fixed amount of pocket money teaches the first lesson: when it's gone, it's gone.
sentences.zh: 定额的零花钱教的是第一课：花完就没了。

sentences.en: A painful but effective lesson! Though some parents top it up anyway, which rather ruins the point.
sentences.zh: 痛苦但有效的一课！不过有些家长花完还会补，这就把意义全毁了。

sentences.en: True — the rule only works if it's actually a rule. A part-time job goes deeper, because earned money feels different from given money.
sentences.zh: 没错——规则只有真是规则才管用。兼职就更进一步，因为挣来的钱和给的钱感觉完全不同。

sentences.en: Completely different! You think twice about a pair of trainers when they cost ten hours of washing dishes.
sentences.zh: 完全不同！当一双运动鞋等于十小时刷盘子，你买之前一定会三思。

sentences.en: Exactly. Savings goals add direction — saving 'for a guitar' beats saving 'because you should'.
sentences.zh: 正是。储蓄目标则提供方向——「为一把吉他存钱」胜过「因为应该存所以存」。

sentences.en: And keeping a record of spending is eye-opening — most people have no idea where their money actually goes.
sentences.zh: 记账则让人大开眼界——大多数人根本不知道自己的钱到底去了哪儿。

sentences.en: School lessons could tie all of this together, though lessons without practice tend to evaporate.
sentences.zh: 学校理财课能把这些都串起来，不过没有实践的课往往转眼就蒸发了。

sentences.en: So which single method works best for actually learning to manage money?
sentences.zh: 那么真正学会管钱，哪种办法最有效？

sentences.en: The part-time job, I'd say — it teaches you how to earn money, value it and budget it, all at once.
sentences.zh: 我会说兼职——它同时教会你怎么挣钱、怎么珍惜钱、怎么规划钱。

sentences.en: Strong case. I'd pair it with a savings goal, so the earned money has somewhere meaningful to go.
sentences.zh: 很有力。我会再配上一个储蓄目标，让挣来的钱有个有意义的去处。

sentences.en: Perfect combination — earn it through work and put it towards a goal. The part-time job is still our main answer.
sentences.zh: 完美组合——靠劳动挣来，存向一个目标。兼职仍是我们的主答案。

scenes.title: 聊聊健康习惯
scenes.subtitle: Keeping fit and healthy
scenes.description: PET 口语 · 聊聊健康习惯 · Part 1 面试问答 + Part 2 看图描述长描述 + Part 3 讨论
learn: 说明喜欢某项运动的原因
介绍日常饮食中的健康食物
scenes.examTip:
**考法** 在PET口语Part 1中，考官通常会问关于你保持健康的方式，比如你常做什么运动、饮食上有什么好习惯。你回答时需要用完整句，并给出理由或例子，自然而然会用到一般现在时（如I go running）、现在完成时（如I've started eating more vegetables）或比较级（如It's healthier than junk food）。

**怎么答** Part 2中，你会看到一张彩色照片，要描述人们在运动或吃东西的场景。这时你通常会用到现在进行时来描述动作（如They are playing football），用maybe或probably推测心情（如They probably feel happy），以及用连接词because、so、but等使你的独白更连贯。

**注意** 注意不要只蹦单词，而要试着把句子连起来说。

templates.en: I usually ___ to keep fit.
I like doing ___ because it makes me ___.
templates.zh: 说明喜欢某项运动的原因

templates.en: I try to eat ___ every day.
templates.zh: 介绍日常饮食中的健康食物

templates.en: I think ___ is important for health.
templates.zh: 表达对健康重要因素的看法

sentences.en: Do you do any sports or exercise to stay healthy?
sentences.zh: 你会做运动或锻炼来保持健康吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I usually go jogging in the park near my home three times a week. It helps me relax and keeps me fit.
sentences.zh: 是的，我通常每周三次在离家不远的公园慢跑。这让我放松，也能让我保持健康。

sentences.en: What do you usually eat to stay healthy?
sentences.zh: 你通常吃什么来保持健康？

sentences.en: I try to eat a lot of fruit and vegetables every day, and I drink plenty of water instead of sugary drinks.
sentences.zh: 我尽量每天吃很多水果和蔬菜，而且多喝水，少喝含糖饮料。

sentences.en: Have you made any changes to your lifestyle recently to be healthier?
sentences.zh: 你最近为了更健康，改变了什么生活习惯吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I've started going to bed earlier because I want to get enough sleep. I also walk more instead of taking the bus.
sentences.zh: 是的，我开始早睡了，因为我想保证充足睡眠。我也多走路，少坐公交车。

sentences.en: Which do you think is better for health, doing sports at school or playing computer games?
sentences.zh: 你觉得哪种对健康更好，在学校运动还是玩电脑游戏？

sentences.en: I think doing sports at school is definitely better because you move your body and it's also a good way to make friends.
sentences.zh: 我觉得在学校运动肯定更好，因为你能活动身体，而且也是交朋友的好途径。

sentences.en: In the picture, I can see two children playing football in a park.
sentences.zh: 在照片里，我看到两个孩子在公园里踢足球。

sentences.en: There is also a woman, maybe their mother, sitting on a bench and watching them.
sentences.zh: 还有一个女人，可能是他们的妈妈，坐在长凳上看着他们。

sentences.en: The boy in a red T-shirt is kicking the ball, while the girl is trying to stop it.
sentences.zh: 穿红色T恤的男孩正在踢球，而女孩正试图拦住球。

sentences.en: It looks like a sunny day because the sky is clear and there are some trees with green leaves.
sentences.zh: 看起来是晴天，因为天空晴朗，还有一些长着绿叶的树木。

sentences.en: The girl is wearing a yellow top and white trainers, and her hair is tied back.
sentences.zh: 女孩穿着黄色上衣和白色运动鞋，头发扎在脑后。

sentences.en: Behind them, there is a playground with a slide and some swings.
sentences.zh: 他们身后有一个游乐场，有滑梯和几个秋千。

sentences.en: They probably enjoy the game very much, and the woman looks relaxed and happy.
sentences.zh: 他们很可能很享受这场比赛，而那位女士看起来轻松又开心。

sentences.en: I think spending time outdoors like this is a great way to stay active and have fun.
sentences.zh: 我认为像这样在户外活动是保持活力和享受乐趣的好方法。

sentences.en: Jack wants to get fitter, but he doesn't know which sport to start.
sentences.zh: Jack 想变得更健康，但不知道从哪种运动开始。

sentences.en: Running is the simplest one. You just need a pair of good shoes.
sentences.zh: 跑步最简单了。只需要一双好鞋就行。

sentences.en: True, but he told me running hurts his knees a little.
sentences.zh: 是的，不过他跟我说过跑步膝盖会有点疼。

sentences.en: Oh, then cycling might be better. It's easier on the knees.
sentences.zh: 哦，那骑自行车可能更好。对膝盖的压力小一些。

sentences.en: Cycling is nice, though the roads near his home are quite busy.
sentences.zh: 骑车挺好的，但他家附近的路车太多了。

sentences.en: Basketball is fun because you play with friends, so you don't give up easily.
sentences.zh: 打篮球很有意思，和朋友一起玩就不容易放弃。

sentences.en: He'd need a team for that, and he's a bit shy about joining one.
sentences.zh: 那得加入一个队，他还有点不好意思。

sentences.en: A fitness class could suit him — the teacher shows you exactly what to do.
sentences.zh: 健身操课可能适合他——老师会手把手教你怎么做。

sentences.en: Classes are at fixed times, though, and he's often busy after school.
sentences.zh: 不过上课时间是固定的，他放学后经常没空。

sentences.en: Then what about swimming? It exercises the whole body and it's gentle.
sentences.zh: 那游泳呢？全身都能锻炼到，而且很温和。

sentences.en: And the pool is just ten minutes from his house, so it's easy to go often.
sentences.zh: 而且游泳馆离他家才十分钟，常去也方便。

sentences.en: Great, so swimming seems the best way for Jack to start.
sentences.zh: 太好了，那游泳应该是 Jack 起步的最佳选择。

scenes.title: 聊聊季节与天气
scenes.subtitle: Weather and seasons
scenes.description: PET 口语 · 聊聊季节与天气 · Part 1 面试问答 + Part 2 看图描述长描述 + Part 3 讨论
learn: 描述特定天气下喜欢做的事
表达天气偏好并给出理由
scenes.examTip:
**要点** 这个话题在PET口语Part 1中，考官常会提问个人偏好与经历，例如你喜欢哪个季节、不同天气通常做什么、你的家乡气候如何。回答时不能只说一个词，需用完整句给出理由或例子，比如用'because...'解释原因，或用'when it's... I usually...'描述习惯。
**怎么答** 在Part 2，你会看到一张彩色照片，通常展示人们在某种天气或季节里的活动，你需要连续说大约1分钟。描述时要先整体说'In the picture...'，然后讲人物、地点、动作，用现在进行时，如'He is wearing...'。推测天气或心情时，自然会用到'It looks like...'、'probably'、'I think...'等表达。
**注意** 要特别注意连接词如'so'、'and'、'but'、'also'，使描述更连贯。B1级别学生容易只说简单句，务必扩展句子，例如加上比较或个人感受。

templates.en: When it's ___, I like to ___.
templates.zh: 描述特定天气下喜欢做的事

templates.en: I prefer ___ weather because ___.
templates.zh: 表达天气偏好并给出理由

templates.en: In my hometown, it usually ___ in summer.
One thing I enjoy doing on a ___ day is ___.
templates.zh: 说一种天气下享受的活动

sentences.en: What's your favourite season? Why?
sentences.zh: 你最喜欢哪个季节？为什么？

sentences.en: My favourite season is spring because the weather is warm and flowers bloom.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢春天，因为天气温暖，鲜花盛开。

sentences.en: What do you usually do when it's rainy?
sentences.zh: 下雨的时候你通常做什么？

sentences.en: When it's rainy, I usually stay at home and read a book or watch a film.
sentences.zh: 下雨的时候，我通常待在家里读书或看电影。

sentences.en: What's the weather like in your hometown in summer?
sentences.zh: 你家乡夏天的天气怎么样？

sentences.en: In my hometown, summer is usually hot and humid, so I often go swimming to cool down.
sentences.zh: 在我的家乡，夏天通常又热又潮湿，所以我经常去游泳降温。

sentences.en: Do you prefer hot or cold weather? Why?
sentences.zh: 你更喜欢热天还是冷天？为什么？

sentences.en: I prefer cold weather because I enjoy wearing warm clothes and drinking hot chocolate. Also, I like snow.
sentences.zh: 我更喜欢冷天，因为我喜欢穿暖和衣服、喝热巧克力。而且，我喜欢雪。

sentences.en: In the picture, there are two children playing in a park.
sentences.zh: 照片里有两个孩子在公园玩耍。

sentences.en: They are wearing light jackets and scarves, so it looks like it's autumn.
sentences.zh: 他们穿着薄外套和围巾，所以看起来是秋天。

sentences.en: The sky is grey and there are some leaves falling.
sentences.zh: 天空灰蒙蒙的，有些树叶在飘落。

sentences.en: There is a wooden bench beside the path behind the children.
sentences.zh: 孩子们身后的小路边有一张木长椅。

sentences.en: The children are laughing and running, so they seem very happy.
sentences.zh: 孩子们在笑在跑，所以他们看起来很开心。

sentences.en: One of the children is holding a big yellow leaf in one hand.
sentences.zh: 其中一个孩子一只手里拿着一片大大的黄叶。

sentences.en: There are some tall trees along the path, and most of them have lost their leaves.
sentences.zh: 小路两旁有几棵高大的树，大多数已经掉光了叶子。

sentences.en: In the distance, I can see a man walking a dog near the gate.
sentences.zh: 远处，我能看到一个男人在大门附近遛狗。

sentences.en: I think they are probably enjoying the cool weather.
sentences.zh: 我想他们很可能在享受凉爽的天气。

sentences.en: The ground is covered with yellow and brown leaves, which makes the park look colourful.
sentences.zh: 地上铺满了黄色和棕色的落叶，让公园看起来色彩斑斓。

sentences.en: The weather forecast says it will rain all weekend. What could we do at home?
sentences.zh: 天气预报说周末会一直下雨。我们在家能做点什么呢？

sentences.en: Watching films is the classic rainy-day plan. We could make it a movie marathon.
sentences.zh: 看电影是雨天的经典安排。我们可以来一场电影马拉松。

sentences.en: That's relaxing, but sitting all day makes me feel a bit lazy.
sentences.zh: 那很放松，但坐一整天会让我觉得有点颓。

sentences.en: Then board games are more active. We can invite the neighbours to play too.
sentences.zh: 那桌游就更有参与感。还可以叫上邻居一起玩。

sentences.en: Fun idea! Reading is another option, though it's something we do alone.
sentences.zh: 好主意！读书也是个选项，不过那是一个人做的事。

sentences.en: Right, and the same is true for painting, I suppose.
sentences.zh: 对，我想画画也是一样（比较个人）。

sentences.en: Actually, I'd love to try baking. Warm cookies on a rainy day sound perfect.
sentences.zh: 其实我特别想试试烘焙。雨天配热乎乎的曲奇太完美了。

sentences.en: Mmm, that smells good already! But a whole afternoon of films is hard to beat.
sentences.zh: 嗯，光是想想就香了！但看一下午电影也很难拒绝啊。

sentences.en: Tell you what — we could bake in the morning and watch films after lunch.
sentences.zh: 这样吧——我们上午烘焙，午饭后再看电影。

sentences.en: Now that's the best plan: fresh cookies during the movie marathon!
sentences.zh: 这才是最棒的安排：看电影马拉松，配新鲜出炉的曲奇！

scenes.title: 我的电影与音乐品味
scenes.subtitle: My taste in movies and music
scenes.description: PET 口语 · 我的电影与音乐品味 · Part 1 面试问答 + Part 2 看图描述长描述 + Part 3 讨论
scenes.examTip:
**要点** 在PET口语Part 1中，考官会就电影与音乐话题提问，例如你喜欢的电影类型、近期看过的电影、是否喜欢在影院看电影、喜欢的音乐类型、是否会演奏乐器等。通常需要用完整句回答，并给出理由或例子。
**考法** Part 2中，可能会给出一张与娱乐活动相关的彩色照片，要求考生描述照片内容，通常会自然用到现在进行时、There be句型、推测性语言如maybe/probably等。
**掌握** B1级别考生要注意运用连接词（because, so, but, also）使回答更连贯，尽量拓展1-2句话，避免只答yes/no。描述照片时要组织好逻辑，先说整体场景，再描述人物动作和可能的心情，最后可加入个人观点。

templates.en: I enjoy watching ___ films because they are ___.
I prefer ___ to ___ because it’s more ___.
One of my favourite songs is ___ by ___; it makes me feel ___.
I used to play the ___, but now I ___.

sentences.en: What kind of films do you usually watch?
sentences.zh: 你通常看什么类型的电影？

sentences.en: I usually watch comedies because they make me laugh and help me relax after a long day.
sentences.zh: 我通常看喜剧，因为它们让我笑，帮助我在漫长的一天后放松。

sentences.en: Do you prefer watching films at the cinema or at home?
sentences.zh: 你更喜欢在电影院还是在家看电影？

sentences.en: I prefer watching films at home. It's more comfortable, and I can pause the film whenever I want.
sentences.zh: 我更喜欢在家看电影。这样更舒服，而且我可以随时暂停。

sentences.en: Have you ever been to a live music concert?
sentences.zh: 你曾经去过现场音乐会吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I have. I went to a pop concert last summer. It was amazing because the atmosphere was so exciting.
sentences.zh: 是的，我去过。去年夏天我去了一场流行音乐会。那次体验很棒，因为现场气氛非常热烈。

sentences.en: Can you play any musical instruments?
sentences.zh: 你会演奏任何乐器吗？

sentences.en: I used to play the piano, but I stopped a few years ago. Now I’m thinking about learning the guitar.
sentences.zh: 我以前弹钢琴，但几年前停了。现在我在考虑学吉他。

sentences.en: In the picture, there are two friends sitting on a sofa in a cosy living room.
sentences.zh: 在照片中，两个朋友坐在舒适客厅的沙发上。

sentences.en: They are watching a film on a large TV, and the room is quite dark, so it feels a bit like being at the cinema.
sentences.zh: 他们正在大电视上看电影，房间很暗，感觉有点像在电影院。

sentences.en: The girl on the left is holding a bowl of popcorn and the boy is pointing at the screen, probably because something funny is happening.
sentences.zh: 左边的女孩拿着一碗爆米花，男孩指着屏幕，可能是因为发生了有趣的事情。

sentences.en: Both of them are laughing, so they seem to be enjoying the film very much.
sentences.zh: 他们两个都在笑，所以他们似乎非常享受这部电影。

sentences.en: On the small table in front of them, there are two glasses of juice and a remote control.
sentences.zh: 他们面前的小桌上放着两杯果汁和一个遥控器。

sentences.en: I think they chose a comedy because they both look really happy.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他们选了一部喜剧，因为他们俩看起来都很开心。

sentences.en: There are some cushions on the sofa, which make the room look warm and comfortable.
sentences.zh: 沙发上放着几个抱枕，让房间显得温馨舒适。

sentences.en: For Friday night, the class can organise one activity. Let's talk about the ideas.
sentences.zh: 周五晚上班里可以组织一场活动。我们来聊聊这些点子吧。

sentences.en: A film night is easy to organise. We just need a projector and some snacks.
sentences.zh: 电影夜最容易组织。只需要一台投影仪和一些零食。

sentences.en: Easy, yes, but people just sit quietly and don't really talk to each other.
sentences.zh: 容易是容易，但大家就是安静地坐着，互相都不怎么交流。

sentences.en: That's a fair point. At least karaoke gets everyone singing and laughing.
sentences.zh: 有道理。至少卡拉OK能让所有人又唱又笑。

sentences.en: Some classmates are too shy to sing in front of everyone, though.
sentences.zh: 不过有些同学太害羞，不敢在大家面前唱歌。

sentences.en: Or we could just have a pizza party. Everyone loves pizza.
sentences.zh: 或者干脆办个披萨派对。人人都爱吃披萨。

sentences.en: They do, but eating pizza isn't really an activity by itself, is it?
sentences.zh: 是啊，但光吃披萨本身算不上一项活动，对吧？

sentences.en: True. A games competition could work — teams, small prizes, that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 确实。游戏比赛应该可行——分队、设点小奖品之类的。

sentences.en: I like team games. But have you thought about a talent show?
sentences.zh: 我喜欢团队游戏。不过你想过办才艺表演吗？

sentences.en: A talent show? Tell me more.
sentences.zh: 才艺表演？细说说。

sentences.en: Everyone can join in their own way — singing, magic, dancing, even telling jokes.
sentences.zh: 每个人都能用自己的方式参与——唱歌、魔术、跳舞，甚至讲笑话。

sentences.en: You've convinced me. A talent show gives everybody a chance, so let's suggest that.
sentences.zh: 你说服我了。才艺表演让每个人都有机会，我们就提议这个吧。

scenes.title: 手机与生活
scenes.subtitle: Phones and the Internet
scenes.description: PET 口语 · 手机与生活 · Part 1 面试问答 + Part 2 看图描述长描述 + Part 3 讨论
learn: 表达日常用手机做什么并说明原因
介绍最常用的应用及其用途
scenes.examTip:
**考法** 在PET口语Part 1中，考官通常会问及日常手机使用习惯、常用应用、上网的好处与问题等。考生需用完整句回答，并主动给出原因或例子，例如说明为何常用某个应用。
**怎么答** Part 2的彩色照片常呈现人们在不同场景使用手机或上网，考生要按顺序清楚描述人物、地点、动作和可能的情绪，连接词如because, so, but, also会自然用到。
**提示** B1级考生可以根据内容自然使用一般现在时谈习惯、现在进行时描述照片中的动作，也可以在谈经历时用一般过去时或现在完成时。重点不是硬套语法，而是把人物、地点、动作和原因说清楚。

templates.en: I usually use my phone to ___ because it's convenient.
templates.zh: 表达日常用手机做什么并说明原因

templates.en: My favourite app is ___, which I use for ___.
templates.zh: 介绍最常用的应用及其用途

templates.en: One good thing about the Internet is that ___.
I think it's important to ___ so that we don't ___.
templates.zh: 表达如何平衡上网与生活

sentences.en: How often do you use your mobile phone?
sentences.zh: 你多久用一次手机？

sentences.en: I use it every day, especially for checking messages and social media. I think it's part of my daily routine.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用，尤其是查看信息和社交媒体。我觉得这是我日常生活的一部分。

sentences.en: Do you have a favourite app? Why do you like it?
sentences.zh: 你有一个最喜欢的应用吗？你为什么喜欢它？

sentences.en: Yes, I really like a video-sharing app because I can learn new things and relax by watching clips. It's very entertaining.
sentences.zh: 是的，我很喜欢一个视频分享应用，因为我可以学新东西并通过看短片放松。它很有趣。

sentences.en: What are the good things about the Internet?
sentences.zh: 互联网有什么好处？

sentences.en: The Internet helps me keep in touch with friends and find information quickly. Also, online learning has become much easier.
sentences.zh: 互联网帮我与朋友保持联系并快速查找信息。而且，在线学习也变得更容易了。

sentences.en: Have you ever had a problem with your phone or the Internet?
sentences.zh: 你的手机或上网时遇到过问题吗？

sentences.en: I once forgot my phone at home and felt really lost. It showed me how much I depend on it.
sentences.zh: 有一次我把手机忘在家里，感觉非常失落。这让我意识到我有多依赖它。

sentences.en: In the picture, there is a teenage girl sitting on a bench in a park.
sentences.zh: 照片里，有一个十几岁的女孩坐在公园的长椅上。

sentences.en: She is holding her smartphone and smiling at the screen.
sentences.zh: 她正拿着智能手机，对着屏幕微笑。

sentences.en: There are some trees and flowers around her, so the place looks pleasant and relaxing.
sentences.zh: 她周围有一些树和花，所以这个地方看起来很舒适、很放松。

sentences.en: She may be messaging a friend because she is typing on her phone.
sentences.zh: 她可能在给朋友发消息，因为她正在手机上打字。

sentences.en: She is wearing a light blue jacket and has a school bag next to her on the bench.
sentences.zh: 她穿着浅蓝色外套，长椅上她旁边放着一个书包。

sentences.en: There is a path in front of her, and a few people are cycling past.
sentences.zh: 她前面有一条小路，有几个人正骑车经过。

sentences.en: It looks like a sunny day, and there are a few white clouds in the sky.
sentences.zh: 看起来是个晴天，天上飘着几朵白云。

sentences.en: She seems to be enjoying the conversation because she has a big smile on her face.
sentences.zh: 她似乎聊得很开心，因为她脸上挂着大大的笑容。

sentences.en: Overall, she looks relaxed as she sits outside using her phone.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，她坐在户外用手机的样子很放松。

sentences.en: Grandpa's birthday is coming, and we want to give him something modern.
sentences.zh: 爷爷的生日快到了，我们想送他一件现代一点的礼物。

sentences.en: A new smartphone is the obvious choice. He could video-call us every day.
sentences.zh: 新智能手机是最直接的选择。他可以每天和我们视频通话。

sentences.en: He already has one, but he says the screen is too small for his eyes.
sentences.zh: 他已经有一部了，但他说屏幕太小，眼睛看着累。

sentences.en: Then a tablet solves that problem — bigger screen, same apps.
sentences.zh: 那平板就能解决这个问题——屏幕更大，应用一样。

sentences.en: Maybe, though he finds learning to use new apps quite confusing.
sentences.zh: 也许吧，不过他觉得学用新应用挺让人犯晕的。

sentences.en: A smart speaker is simpler. He can just ask it to play his favourite radio station.
sentences.zh: 智能音箱就简单多了。他直接开口让它放喜欢的电台就行。

sentences.en: He would like the radio part. And what about a smart watch for his health?
sentences.zh: 电台这点他会喜欢的。那智能手表呢？还能关注他的健康。

sentences.en: Useful, but all those buttons and menus might annoy him.
sentences.zh: 有用是有用，但那些按键和菜单可能会把他弄烦。

sentences.en: You know what he'd truly love? A digital photo frame full of family pictures.
sentences.zh: 你知道他真正会喜欢什么吗？一个装满全家照片的电子相框。

sentences.en: That's it — he wouldn't need to learn how to use it, and he'd see all of us every day.
sentences.zh: 就是它了——他不用学怎么用，还能每天看到我们所有人。

scenes.title: 未来工作畅想
scenes.subtitle: My Future Career
scenes.description: PET 口语 · 未来工作畅想 · Part 1 面试问答 + Part 2 看图描述长描述 + Part 3 讨论
scenes.examTip:
**怎么答** 在 PET 口语 Part 1 中，考官通常会问及你的未来职业理想、原因，以及你做过的兼职或家务。你需要用完整句回答，并自然给出理由和例子，比如用 because 或 so 解释。

**要点** Part 2 会给你一张彩色照片，上面可能有人在工作或做家务。你需要用约 1 分钟描述照片中的人物、地点、动作、物品和可能的心情。最后可以用一句简单的个人看法收尾，但重点仍然是照片本身。

templates.en: I would like to be a ___ because I enjoy ___.
I've helped at home or at school. For example, I ___.
templates.zh: 介绍在家或学校帮过的忙

templates.en: Helping with housework like ___ makes me feel ___.
In the future, I’m going to ___ so that I can ___.

sentences.en: Examiner: What job would you like to do in the future?
sentences.zh: 考官：你将来想做什么工作？

sentences.en: Candidate: I want to be a graphic designer because I’m creative and I love art.
sentences.zh: 考生：我想当一名平面设计师，因为我有创意而且热爱艺术。

sentences.en: Examiner: Why do you think that job is interesting?
sentences.zh: 考官：你为什么觉得那份工作有趣？

sentences.en: Candidate: I think it’s more exciting than an office job, and I can use my imagination every day.
sentences.zh: 考生：我觉得这比办公室工作更刺激，而且每天都能发挥想象力。

sentences.en: Examiner: Have you ever done any part-time work or helped at home?
sentences.zh: 考官：你做过兼职或在家帮过忙吗？

sentences.en: Candidate: Yes, I’ve worked as a waiter in a local restaurant. It was tiring but I learned to be patient.
sentences.zh: 考生：是的，我在当地一家餐厅做过服务员。虽然很累，但我学会了耐心。

sentences.en: Examiner: What chores do you do at home?
sentences.zh: 考官：你在家做什么家务？

sentences.en: Candidate: I often wash the dishes and clean my room, so my parents are happier.
sentences.zh: 考生：我经常洗碗和打扫自己的房间，这样父母会更开心。

sentences.en: In the picture, I can see a young woman working in a bright modern kitchen.
sentences.zh: 在照片里，我可以看到一个年轻女子在一个明亮的现代厨房里工作。

sentences.en: She is wearing a chef’s uniform and she’s decorating a cake on a table.
sentences.zh: 她穿着厨师制服，正在桌上装饰一个蛋糕。

sentences.en: There are some bowls, fresh fruit and a rolling pin near her.
sentences.zh: 她旁边有一些碗、新鲜水果和一根擀面杖。

sentences.en: She seems calm and focused because she is looking carefully at the cake.
sentences.zh: 她看起来很平静、很专注，因为她正认真地看着蛋糕。

sentences.en: The cake is white, and she is putting some strawberries on the top.
sentences.zh: 蛋糕是白色的，她正往蛋糕顶上放草莓。

sentences.en: She is wearing a tall white hat, and her hair is tied up under it.
sentences.zh: 她戴着一顶高高的白帽子，头发盘在帽子里。

sentences.en: Behind her, there are some metal shelves with trays, and a big oven on the left.
sentences.zh: 她身后有几个放着托盘的金属架子，左边还有一个大烤箱。

sentences.en: She may be a pastry chef, and she seems pleased with the cake she is making.
sentences.zh: 她可能是位烘焙师，看起来对自己正在做的蛋糕很满意。

sentences.en: The kitchen around her looks tidy and well organised.
sentences.zh: 她周围的厨房看起来整洁而井井有条。

sentences.en: There are five ideas for the summer holidays. Which one sounds good to you?
sentences.zh: 暑假有五个备选的事情。你觉得哪个不错？

sentences.en: Walking dogs sounds fun, and you get some exercise at the same time.
sentences.zh: 帮人遛狗听起来很有意思，同时还能锻炼身体。

sentences.en: It does, although getting up early every morning isn't easy in the holidays.
sentences.zh: 确实，不过假期里每天早起可不容易。

sentences.en: Ha, true! Selling lemonade could teach us about money and business.
sentences.zh: 哈，没错！摆摊卖柠檬水能让我们学到钱和生意的事。

sentences.en: It only works on hot days, though, and we'd need a good place for the stand.
sentences.zh: 但那只有大热天才行，还得找个好位置摆摊。

sentences.en: Helping a neighbour with the garden is kind, and you learn about plants.
sentences.zh: 帮邻居打理花园很暖心，还能学到植物知识。

sentences.en: That's true. For me, volunteering at the library sounds really nice and calm.
sentences.zh: 是的。对我来说，去图书馆做志愿者听起来又好又安静。

sentences.en: Calm, yes — but I'd choose teaching little kids to swim. I'm good at swimming.
sentences.zh: 安静是安静——但我会选教小朋友游泳。我游泳很拿手。

sentences.en: You'd be great at that! I still prefer the library, with all those books around.
sentences.zh: 你肯定教得特别好！我还是更喜欢图书馆，周围全是书。

sentences.en: OK, so we agree they're both useful — you'd be happier with books, and I'd be happier at the pool.
sentences.zh: 好，那我们有个共识：两个都很有意义——你和书在一起更开心，我在泳池更开心。

scenes.title: 温馨一家人
scenes.subtitle: Family and friends
scenes.description: PET 口语 · 温馨一家人 · Part 1 面试问答 + Part 2 看图描述长描述 + Part 3 讨论
learn: 用来介绍家庭成员的数量和构成。
说明和哪位家人最亲近并给出原因。
描述周末全家常一起进行的活动。
scenes.examTip:
**要点** 在PET口语考试中，家庭与朋友是高频话题。Part 1考官通常会问家里有谁、和谁最亲、周末和朋友做什么等，B1考生需用完整句回答并自然给出理由或例子，比如用because、so、also等连接词拓展。

**场景** Part 2会给一张彩色照片，可能展示家庭聚餐或朋友游玩场景，考生需要描述照片里有谁、在哪、做什么、可能的心情，通常会自然用到现在进行时、There is/are、It looks like…等结构，并适当用maybe、probably、I think等词进行推测。

**注意** 注意回答时避免只蹦单词，要连贯表达，多给细节，展现B1级别的沟通能力。

templates.en: There are ___ people in my family, including ___.
templates.zh: 用来介绍家庭成员的数量和构成。

templates.en: I'm closest to ___ because ___.
templates.zh: 说明和哪位家人最亲近并给出原因。

templates.en: At weekends, we usually ___ together.
templates.zh: 描述周末全家常一起进行的活动。

templates.en: My best friend and I enjoy ___ when we meet.
templates.zh: 分享和好友见面时喜欢做的事。

sentences.en: How many people are there in your family?
sentences.zh: 你家有几口人？

sentences.en: There are four people in my family: my parents, my younger sister and me. We all live together in a flat.
sentences.zh: 我家有四口人：我父母、妹妹和我。我们都住在一间公寓里。

sentences.en: Who are you closest to in your family?
sentences.zh: 你和家里谁最亲？

sentences.en: I'm closest to my mum because she always listens to me and gives me good advice. We often go shopping together.
sentences.zh: 我和妈妈最亲，因为她总是听我倾诉并给我好建议。我们经常一起去购物。

sentences.en: What do you usually do with your friends at weekends?
sentences.zh: 你通常和朋友在周末做什么？

sentences.en: We usually meet at the sports centre. We play badminton or sometimes just hang out and chat.
sentences.zh: 我们通常在体育中心见面。我们打羽毛球，有时就只是聚在一起聊聊天。

sentences.en: Do you prefer spending weekends with your family or friends?
sentences.zh: 你更喜欢和家人还是朋友一起度周末？

sentences.en: I enjoy both, but I think I prefer spending time with my family because we don't see each other much during the week. Also, we have a lot of fun cooking together.
sentences.zh: 我都喜欢，但我认为我更喜欢和家人在一起，因为平时我们见面不多。而且，我们一起做饭很有趣。

sentences.en: In the picture, I can see a family having a picnic in a park.
sentences.zh: 在这张照片里，我看到一家人在公园里野餐。

sentences.en: A mother and a father are sitting on a blanket, and they are smiling.
sentences.zh: 一位妈妈和一位爸爸正坐在毯子上，他们在微笑。

sentences.en: A young girl is running after a small dog, and she looks very excited.
sentences.zh: 一个小女孩在追一只小狗，她看上去非常兴奋。

sentences.en: The sun is shining, so it's probably a warm summer day.
sentences.zh: 阳光明媚，所以这很可能是一个温暖的夏日。

sentences.en: The blanket is red and white, and there are some plates and cups on it.
sentences.zh: 毯子是红白相间的，上面放着一些盘子和杯子。

sentences.en: The girl is wearing a pink dress, and the dog is small and brown.
sentences.zh: 小女孩穿着粉色连衣裙，那只狗小小的、棕色的。

sentences.en: There are some big trees behind them, and I can see a lake in the distance.
sentences.zh: 他们身后有几棵大树，远处我能看到一个湖。

sentences.en: I think they are all feeling happy and relaxed because they are spending time together.
sentences.zh: 我想他们都很开心、放松，因为他们在一起享受时光。

sentences.en: Maybe they have brought some food with them, because there is a basket next to them.
sentences.zh: 也许他们带了一些食物，因为旁边有一个篮子。

sentences.en: Mum's birthday is on Sunday. How should we celebrate it?
sentences.zh: 妈妈的生日就在周日。我们该怎么给她庆祝呢？

sentences.en: We could cook her a special breakfast and bring it to her in bed.
sentences.zh: 我们可以给她做一顿特别的早餐，端到床边给她。

sentences.en: She'd love that, though our cooking might be a little dangerous!
sentences.zh: 她肯定喜欢，不过我们的厨艺可能有点危险！

sentences.en: Ha! Then dinner at a restaurant is safer — no cooking and no washing-up.
sentences.zh: 哈！那去餐厅吃晚餐就保险多了——不用做饭也不用洗碗。

sentences.en: Nice, but restaurants are crowded at the weekend, and she doesn't like noise.
sentences.zh: 不错，但周末餐厅人挤人，她又不喜欢吵。

sentences.en: A family day out could be lovely if the weather stays fine.
sentences.zh: 如果天气好的话，全家出游也会很温馨。

sentences.en: It could. What about making her a present ourselves? Something personal.
sentences.zh: 是啊。那我们亲手给她做份礼物呢？更有心意。

sentences.en: Like what? I'm terrible at making things with my hands.
sentences.zh: 比如做什么？我动手能力可差了。

sentences.en: A photo album! We choose the best family pictures and write little notes inside.
sentences.zh: 照片相册呀！我们挑出最好的家庭照片，再在里面写上小纸条。

sentences.en: She'll probably cry with happiness. The album is the perfect idea — let's do it.
sentences.zh: 她大概会开心得哭出来。相册就是最完美的主意——就这么办。

scenes.title: 聊聊我的家人
scenes.subtitle: My family and friends
scenes.description: 这段对话帮你练习用A2口语介绍家人、朋友和周末活动，KET常考这类日常话题。
scenes.examTip:
**考法** 在KET口语考试中，“家庭与朋友”是Part 1常考话题，考官可能会问“Who do you live with?”或“Tell me about your best friend.”。这段是生活对话拓展，不是真实Speaking Part 1考场流程。真实Part 1是考官问、考生答。
**掌握** 核心句型：There is/are… / I live with… / I’m closest to… / My best friend’s name is… / We often… / I like/love doing…
**注意** 回答时切勿只蹦单词，要用完整短句，比如“I live with my mum and dad.”，而不是只说“Mum and dad.”。

**Part 2** 你和另一位考生看五幅家庭活动图(野餐、一起做饭、踢足球、看电影、看望祖父母)。说说你们喜欢或不喜欢这些活动、为什么,并回应对方 —— **不需要安排具体哪天去**。

templates.en: There are ___ people in my family.
I live with my ___.
My best friend's name is ___.
We often ___ at weekends.

sentences.en: How many people are there in your family, Lily?
sentences.zh: 莉莉，你家有几口人？

sentences.en: There are four. I live with my parents and my little brother.
sentences.zh: 四口人。我和父母还有弟弟住在一起。

sentences.en: Who are you closest to in your family?
sentences.zh: 家里你和谁最亲？

sentences.en: I'm closest to my mum because she always listens to me.
sentences.zh: 我和妈妈最亲，因为她总是听我说话。

sentences.en: What's your best friend's name?
sentences.zh: 你最好的朋友叫什么名字？

sentences.en: Her name's Amy. We like playing together.
sentences.zh: 她叫艾米。我们喜欢一起玩。

sentences.en: What do you do with your family and friends at weekends?
sentences.zh: 周末你和家人朋友都做什么？

sentences.en: We often go to the park or have a picnic.
sentences.zh: 我们经常去公园或者野餐。

sentences.en: Do you like these family activities? I really like picnics.
sentences.zh: 你喜欢这些家庭活动吗？我很喜欢野餐。

sentences.en: Me too. My little brother loves running in the park.
sentences.zh: 我也是。我弟弟喜欢在公园里跑来跑去。

sentences.en: What about cooking together? I'm not very good at it.
sentences.zh: 一起做饭呢？我做得不太好。

sentences.en: Really? I like it. My dad teaches me how to cook.
sentences.zh: 真的吗？我喜欢。我爸教我做饭。

sentences.en: Do you like playing football with your family?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢和家人踢足球吗？

sentences.en: Yes, it's fun because we can all play together.
sentences.zh: 喜欢，很好玩，因为大家都能一起玩。

sentences.en: I like watching films at home. It's relaxing.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢在家看电影。很放松。

sentences.en: Films are OK, but I prefer doing something active.
sentences.zh: 电影还行，不过我更喜欢做点运动。

sentences.en: What about visiting your grandparents?
sentences.zh: 那去看望祖父母呢？

sentences.en: I love that. My grandpa tells me funny stories.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢。我爷爷会给我讲有趣的故事。

sentences.en: Picnics are my favourite. We can eat and play outside.
sentences.zh: 野餐是我的最爱。能在外面吃东西还能玩。

scenes.title: 聊聊日常作息
scenes.subtitle: Daily routine
scenes.description: Tom和Lily聊日常作息，练询问起床睡觉，对比周末活动，掌握KET时间表达。
scenes.examTip:
**考法** 在 A2 Key / KET 口语中，"日常作息"常出现在 Part 1 的个人信息问答中，考官可能会问 "What time do you get up?" "How do you go to school?" 或 "What do you do at weekends?"。这段是生活对话拓展，不是真实 Speaking Part 1 考场流程。真实 Part 1 是考官问、考生答，不是两个学生互相采访。
**掌握** 需掌握的核心 A2 句型/词汇：What time...? / I usually... / I walk to school / I go to school by... / At weekends, I... / like doing / so I can... / get up, go to bed, have breakfast。
**注意** 回答时使用完整短句，如 "I get up at 7 o'clock."，不要只说 "7 o'clock."，这样更符合 KET 口语中的完整回答要求。

**Part 2** 你和另一位考生看五幅一天中的活动图(早起、吃早餐、做作业、晚上休息、睡觉)。说说你们喜欢或不喜欢一天中的哪些时候、为什么,并回应对方 —— **不需要一样**。

templates.en: What time do you usually ___?
I ___ to school.
At weekends, I ___.
I go to bed at ___.

sentences.en: What time do you usually get up on school days?
sentences.zh: 你上学日通常几点起床？

sentences.en: I get up at seven and have a quick breakfast.
sentences.zh: 我七点起床，然后很快地吃早餐。

sentences.en: How do you go to school in the morning?
sentences.zh: 你早上怎么去上学？

sentences.en: I usually walk to school with my best friend.
sentences.zh: 我通常和我最好的朋友走路去学校。

sentences.en: At weekends, I sleep late. What about you?
sentences.zh: 周末我会睡懒觉。你呢？

sentences.en: I like to play outside with my friends at the weekend.
sentences.zh: 我周末喜欢和朋友们在外面玩。

sentences.en: What time do you go to bed?
sentences.zh: 你几点睡觉？

sentences.en: I go to bed at nine, so I can get up early.
sentences.zh: 我九点睡觉，这样我就能早起。

sentences.en: I don't really like getting up early for school.
sentences.zh: 我不太喜欢为了上学早起。

sentences.en: Me neither! Mornings are so hard for me.
sentences.zh: 我也不喜欢！早上对我来说太难熬了。

sentences.en: But I love breakfast. My mum makes great pancakes.
sentences.zh: 不过我喜欢早餐。我妈妈做的煎饼很棒。

sentences.en: Lucky you! I only have time for some milk.
sentences.zh: 你真幸运！我只来得及喝点牛奶。

sentences.en: What about homework? I find it boring.
sentences.zh: 作业呢？我觉得很无聊。

sentences.en: Really? I don't mind it. I like finishing my maths homework.
sentences.zh: 真的吗？我不介意。我喜欢把数学作业做完。

sentences.en: I like evenings because I can finally relax.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢晚上，因为终于能放松了。

sentences.en: I agree. I watch TV or play games after dinner.
sentences.zh: 同意。我晚饭后看电视或玩游戏。

sentences.en: Do you go to bed late?
sentences.zh: 你睡得晚吗？

sentences.en: Not really. I'm always tired, so I sleep early.
sentences.zh: 不算晚。我总是很累，所以睡得早。

scenes.title: 聊聊天气和季节
scenes.subtitle: Weather & seasons
scenes.description: 练一练问今天天气、说说你最喜欢的季节，KET 话题里常聊不同天气穿什么、能做什么活动。
scenes.examTip:
**考法** 天气与季节是 A2 Key / KET 常见生活话题，可能出现在 Part 1 的个人问答中，也可以作为 Part 2 讨论图片或提示时的相关表达。请注意，这段是生活对话拓展，不是真实 Speaking Part 1 考场流程。真实 Part 1 是考官问、考生答，不是两个学生互相聊天。
**掌握** What's the weather like? / It's sunny and warm. / I like spring because... / I can wear... / I love doing... / In summer, I often...
**注意** 回答时用完整短句，比如 "It's raining."，不要只说 "Rain."；可以加一个简单原因，让回答更丰富。

**Part 2** 你和另一位考生看五幅天气图(晴天、雨天、雪天、刮风、多云)。说说你们喜欢或不喜欢哪种天气、为什么,并回应对方 —— **不需要选同一种**。

templates.en: What's the weather like ___?
I like ___ because it's ___ and I can ___.
templates.zh: 说喜欢哪个季节及原因

templates.en: When it's ___, I wear ___.
My favourite season is ___ because I love ___.

sentences.en: What's the weather like today?
sentences.zh: 今天天气怎么样？

sentences.en: It's sunny and warm. Great for a walk!
sentences.zh: 天气晴朗温暖。很适合散步！

sentences.en: Yes, I love sunny days. What's your favourite season?
sentences.zh: 是啊，我喜欢晴天。你最喜欢的季节是什么？

sentences.en: I like spring because flowers are everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢春天，因为到处是花。

sentences.en: Spring is nice! What do you wear in spring?
sentences.zh: 春天很棒！你春天穿什么？

sentences.en: I wear a light jacket and jeans.
sentences.zh: 我穿薄夹克和牛仔裤。

sentences.en: And what do you like doing in spring?
sentences.zh: 那你春天喜欢做什么？

sentences.en: I love flying kites in the park.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢在公园放风筝。

sentences.en: I really like sunny days. What about you?
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢晴天。你呢？

sentences.en: Me too. We can play outside when it's sunny.
sentences.zh: 我也是。晴天可以在外面玩。

sentences.en: What about rain? I don't like it very much.
sentences.zh: 下雨呢？我不太喜欢。

sentences.en: Really? I like rainy days. I can read at home.
sentences.zh: 真的吗？我喜欢雨天。可以在家看书。

sentences.en: I love snow! We can make a snowman.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢雪！可以堆雪人。

sentences.en: Snow is fun, but it's very cold.
sentences.zh: 雪很好玩，但太冷了。

sentences.en: Do you like windy days?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢刮风的日子吗？

sentences.en: Not really. The wind is too strong sometimes. What about cloudy days?
sentences.zh: 不太喜欢。风有时候太大了。多云天呢？

sentences.en: Cloudy days are OK, but sunny days are my favourite. What about you?
sentences.zh: 多云天还行，但晴天是我的最爱。你呢？

sentences.en: I like snow best because winter is my favourite season.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢雪，因为冬天是我最爱的季节。

scenes.title: 聊聊健康吧
scenes.subtitle: Stay healthy
scenes.description: 这段对话练习如何表达身体不舒服、询问情况，以及谈论保持健康的方法，KET 常考健康话题。
scenes.examTip:
**考法** 健康话题在 A2 Key / KET 口语中常出现，比如考官可能会问 "How do you stay healthy?" 或 "What do you do when you're ill?" 这段是生活对话拓展，不是真实 Speaking Part 1 考场流程。真实 Part 1 是考官问、考生答，不是两个学生互相聊天。
**掌握** 核心 A2 句型/词：I've got a… / Do you need to see a doctor? / You should… / What do you do to stay healthy? / I ride my bike… / eat fruit / do exercise / stay healthy
**注意** 回答时尽量用完整短句，比如 "I've got a headache."，不要只说 "Headache."，这样更符合 KET 口语中完整回答的要求。

**Part 2** 你和另一位考生看五幅保持健康的方式图(运动、健康饮食、早睡、喝水、散步)。说说你们喜欢或不喜欢哪些、为什么,并回应对方 —— **不需要选同一种**。

templates.en: I've got a ___.
Do you ___ every day?
templates.zh: 问对方每天做什么保持健康

templates.en: I need to ___ more.
You should ___ and ___.

sentences.en: Hi, how are you feeling today?
sentences.zh: 嗨，你今天感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: Not so good. I've got a headache.
sentences.zh: 不太好。我头疼。

sentences.en: Oh dear. Do you need to see a doctor?
sentences.zh: 哎呀。你需要看医生吗？

sentences.en: I think I'll just rest for now.
sentences.zh: 我想我现在就休息一下。

sentences.en: You should drink some water and lie down.
sentences.zh: 你应该喝点水，躺下。

sentences.en: Thanks. What do you do to stay healthy?
sentences.zh: 谢谢。你做什么来保持健康？

sentences.en: I ride my bike every day and eat fruit.
