sentences.zh: 我每天骑自行车，也吃水果。

sentences.en: That's great. I need to do more exercise too.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。我也需要多锻炼。

sentences.en: I really like doing sport to stay healthy.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢用运动来保持健康。

sentences.en: Me too. I play football twice a week.
sentences.zh: 我也是。我一周踢两次足球。

sentences.en: What about eating vegetables? I don't like them much.
sentences.zh: 吃蔬菜呢？我不太喜欢。

sentences.en: Really? I eat them every day. They're good for you.
sentences.zh: 真的吗？我每天都吃。对身体好。

sentences.en: I try to go to bed early, but it's difficult.
sentences.zh: 我尽量早点睡，但很难做到。

sentences.en: Same here! I often go to bed late because I watch TV.
sentences.zh: 我也是！我常常因为看电视睡得晚。

sentences.en: Do you drink a lot of water?
sentences.zh: 你喝很多水吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I drink a lot of water every day. It's good for me.
sentences.zh: 喝，我每天都喝很多水。对我很好。

sentences.en: What do you think about going for a walk?
sentences.zh: 你觉得散步怎么样？

sentences.en: I like it because it's easy and relaxing.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢，因为简单又放松。

scenes.title: 聊聊我温馨的家
scenes.subtitle: My home
scenes.description: 练习描述住所、房间数量和最喜欢的房间，KET 常考家庭介绍话题。
scenes.examTip:
**考法** KET 口语 Part 1 可能问到关于家的问题，如 Where do you live? How many rooms are there? 这段是生活对话拓展，不是真实 Speaking Part 1 考场流程。真实 Part 1 是考官问、考生答。
**掌握** 核心 A2 句型/词：I live in a… / There are… / My favourite room is… / I’ve got… / because… / flat / house / garden / bedroom / living room / cosy
**注意** 回答用完整短句，别只蹦单词，比如问 Where do you live? 要答 I live in a flat. 而不是只说 Flat。

**Part 2** 你和另一位考生看五幅家里房间的图(卧室、厨房、客厅、花园、书房)。说说你们喜欢或不喜欢哪个房间、为什么,并回应对方 —— **不需要选同一个**。

templates.en: I live in a ___.
templates.zh: 描述住所类型，如公寓或房子

templates.en: There are ___ rooms in my home.
My favourite room is the ___ because ___.
templates.zh: 说明最喜欢的房间及原因

templates.en: I have got a ___ in my room.
templates.zh: 描述自己房间里的物品

sentences.en: Hi, Lily! Where do you live?
sentences.zh: 嗨，莉莉！你住在哪里？

sentences.en: I live in a flat near the park. And you?
sentences.zh: 我住在公园附近的一套公寓里。你呢？

sentences.en: I live in a house with a garden.
sentences.zh: 我住在一栋带花园的房子里。

sentences.en: That's nice! How many rooms are there?
sentences.zh: 真好！有多少个房间？

sentences.en: There are five rooms. My favourite is my bedroom.
sentences.zh: 有五个房间。我最喜欢的是我的卧室。

sentences.en: What's in your bedroom?
sentences.zh: 你的卧室里有什么？

sentences.en: I've got a big desk and some posters on the wall.
sentences.zh: 我有一张大书桌，墙上挂着一些海报。

sentences.en: Cool! I like my living room because it's cosy.
sentences.zh: 酷！我喜欢我家的客厅，因为那里很舒适。

sentences.en: I love my bedroom. It's small but it's all mine.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢我的卧室。虽然小，但完全属于我。

sentences.en: Me too. My bedroom has lots of posters on the wall.
sentences.zh: 我也是。我卧室墙上贴了很多海报。

sentences.en: What about the kitchen? I don't spend much time there.
sentences.zh: 厨房呢？我不怎么待在那儿。

sentences.en: Really? I love the kitchen. I help my dad cook.
sentences.zh: 真的吗？我喜欢厨房。我帮我爸做饭。

sentences.en: The living room is nice for watching films together.
sentences.zh: 客厅很适合一起看电影。

sentences.en: I agree. My family watches TV there every evening.
sentences.zh: 同意。我们家每晚都在那儿看电视。

sentences.en: Do you have a garden?
sentences.zh: 你家有花园吗？

sentences.en: Yes, a small one. I like reading outside when it's sunny.
sentences.zh: 有，一个小花园。天晴时我喜欢在外面看书。

sentences.en: I don't have a study, so I do my homework on my bed!
sentences.zh: 我没有书房，所以只能在床上写作业！

sentences.en: That's funny! A study would be quiet for homework.
sentences.zh: 太好笑了！书房写作业会很安静。

scenes.title: 我的宠物朋友
scenes.subtitle: Furry Friends
scenes.description: 练习谈论有没有宠物、描述宠物外貌和爱好，KET口语动物话题常考内容。
scenes.examTip:
**考法** 在KET口语中，动物与宠物是常考话题。考官可能问“Do you have any pets?”或“What's your favourite animal?”。请注意，这段对话是生活对话拓展，模拟朋友聊天，不是真实Speaking Part 1考场流程。真实Part 1是考官问、考生答。
**掌握** 应重点掌握询问和描述宠物的句型：Do you have...? / I've got... / What does... look like? / ... likes doing...；以及常用形容词：friendly, cute, white, big, small 等。
**注意** 回答时要使用完整短句，如“I have a cat.”，不要只说“cat”。尝试用“because”简单解释原因。

**Part 2** 你和另一位考生看五幅动物图(狗、猫、兔子、鱼、小鸟)。说说你们喜欢或不喜欢养哪种当宠物、为什么,并回应对方 —— **不需要选同一种**。

templates.en: I've got a ___.
My pet's name is ___.
My ___ is ___ and ___.
I don't have a pet, but I love ___.
templates.zh: 说我没有宠物但喜欢什么动物

sentences.en: Do you have any pets?
sentences.zh: 你有宠物吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I have a cat. Her name is Mimi.
sentences.zh: 有，我有一只猫。她叫咪咪。

sentences.en: What does she look like?
sentences.zh: 她长什么样？

sentences.en: She's white with big blue eyes.
sentences.zh: 她是白色的，有一双大大的蓝眼睛。

sentences.en: What does she like doing?
sentences.zh: 她喜欢做什么？

sentences.en: She loves playing with a ball.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢玩球。

sentences.en: I don't have a pet, but I like dogs.
sentences.zh: 我没有宠物，但我喜欢狗。

sentences.en: Dogs are great. They are very friendly.
sentences.zh: 狗很棒。它们非常友好。

sentences.en: I really want a dog. It would be a great pet.
sentences.zh: 我很想养狗。它会是很棒的宠物。

sentences.en: Me too. Dogs are friendly and we can play together.
sentences.zh: 我也是。狗很友好，能一起玩。

sentences.en: What about cats? I don't like them much.
sentences.zh: 猫呢？我不太喜欢。

sentences.en: Really? I love cats. They're quiet and easy to keep.
sentences.zh: 真的吗？我喜欢猫。安静又好养。

sentences.en: A rabbit is cute, but it needs a lot of care.
sentences.zh: 兔子很可爱，但需要很多照顾。

sentences.en: That's true. Fish can be easier to look after because they don't need walks.
sentences.zh: 确实。鱼可能更好照顾，因为不用遛。

sentences.en: Do you like birds?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢小鸟吗？

sentences.en: Not really. They're noisy in the morning.
sentences.zh: 不太喜欢。它们早上很吵。

sentences.en: Dogs are friendly, but they need lots of exercise.
sentences.zh: 狗很友好，但需要很多运动。

sentences.en: That's true. Cats are better for me because my flat is small.
sentences.zh: 确实。猫更适合我，因为我家小。

scenes.title: 假期去哪玩
scenes.subtitle: Holidays and travel
scenes.description: KET 高频话题:聊度假、去过的地方、喜欢海边还是山里。A2 简单对话。
scenes.examTip:
**考法** 假期旅行是 KET 高频话题。考官常问 Do you like...? / Where did you go...? / What did you do...? 回答用一般现在时说喜好、一般过去时说经历,给 1-2 句即可。

**Part 2** 你和另一位考生看五幅度假图(海边、山区、城市、露营、看望亲戚)。说说你们喜欢或不喜欢哪些、为什么,并回应对方 —— **不需要共同选出去哪儿**。

templates.en: I went to ___ last ___.
I prefer ___ because ___.
That sounds ___!

sentences.en: Do you like going on holiday, Lily?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢去度假吗，莉莉？

sentences.en: Yes, I love it! I went to the beach last summer.
sentences.zh: 喜欢！去年夏天我去了海边。

sentences.en: That sounds fun. What did you do there?
sentences.zh: 听起来很好玩。你在那儿做了什么？

sentences.en: I swam in the sea and built sandcastles with my sister.
sentences.zh: 我在海里游泳，还和妹妹堆了沙堡。

sentences.en: Nice! Do you prefer the beach or the mountains?
sentences.zh: 真好！你更喜欢海边还是山里？

sentences.en: The beach, definitely. What about you, Tom?
sentences.zh: 肯定是海边。你呢，汤姆？

sentences.en: I like the mountains. I went skiing there last winter.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢山里。去年冬天我去那儿滑雪了。

sentences.en: Wow, that sounds exciting! I'd love to try skiing.
sentences.zh: 哇，听起来好刺激！我也想试试滑雪。

sentences.en: Do you like these holidays? I love the beach.
sentences.zh: 你喜欢这些度假方式吗？我很喜欢海边。

sentences.en: Me too. I like swimming in the sea.
sentences.zh: 我也是。我喜欢在海里游泳。

sentences.en: What about the mountains? I think they're cooler in summer.
sentences.zh: 山里呢？我觉得夏天山里更凉快。

sentences.en: That's true, but I don't like walking a lot.
sentences.zh: 确实，不过我不喜欢走很多路。

sentences.en: Do you like city holidays?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢去城市度假吗？

sentences.en: Not really. Cities are busy and noisy.
sentences.zh: 不太喜欢。城市又忙又吵。

sentences.en: I like camping because it's fun with friends.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢露营，因为和朋友一起很好玩。

sentences.en: I don't like camping. It's cold at night!
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢露营。晚上很冷！

sentences.en: What about visiting your grandparents?
sentences.zh: 那去看望祖父母呢？

sentences.en: I like that a lot. My grandma cooks great food.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢。我奶奶做的饭很好吃。

sentences.en: The beach is my favourite. I love swimming in the sea.
sentences.zh: 海边是我的最爱。我喜欢在海里游泳。

scenes.title: 怎么去
scenes.subtitle: Getting around
scenes.description: KET 高频话题:聊怎么上学、坐什么车、喜欢的交通方式。A2 简单对话。
scenes.examTip:
**考法** 交通出行是 KET 常考。考官问 How do you get to...? / How long does it take? 回答用 I go by bus / on foot,时间用 It takes about... 简单直接即可。

**Part 2** 你和另一位考生看五幅交通方式图(公交、自行车、地铁、走路、坐车)。说说你们喜欢或不喜欢哪种方式、为什么,并回应对方 —— **不需要选同一种**。

templates.en: I usually go by ___.
It takes about ___ minutes.
I like taking the ___ because ___.

sentences.en: How do you get to school, Lily?
sentences.zh: 你怎么去学校，莉莉？

sentences.en: I usually go by bus. It takes about twenty minutes.
sentences.zh: 我一般坐公交，大概二十分钟。

sentences.en: Do you ever walk or ride a bike?
sentences.zh: 你走路或骑车去过吗？

sentences.en: Sometimes I ride my bike when the weather is nice.
sentences.zh: 天气好的时候我有时会骑自行车。

sentences.en: What's your favourite way to travel?
sentences.zh: 你最喜欢的出行方式是什么？

sentences.en: I love taking the train because I can look out of the window.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢坐火车，因为可以看窗外的风景。

sentences.en: Me too. How do you get to the city centre?
sentences.zh: 我也是。你怎么去市中心？

sentences.en: I take the underground. It's fast and never gets stuck in traffic.
sentences.zh: 我坐地铁。又快，还不会堵车。

sentences.en: I usually go to school by bus. What about you?
sentences.zh: 我一般坐公交上学。你呢？

sentences.en: I ride my bike. It's faster and it's good exercise.
sentences.zh: 我骑自行车。更快，还能锻炼。

sentences.en: Really? I don't like cycling when it rains.
sentences.zh: 真的吗？下雨天我不喜欢骑车。

sentences.en: That's true. Buses are better in bad weather.
sentences.zh: 确实。天气不好时公交更好。

sentences.en: Do you ever take the underground?
sentences.zh: 你坐过地铁吗？

sentences.en: Sometimes I take it when I go to the city centre. It's very quick.
sentences.zh: 有时候去市中心时我会坐。很快。

sentences.en: I like walking when the weather is nice.
sentences.zh: 天气好的时候我喜欢走路。

sentences.en: Me too, but my school is too far to walk.
sentences.zh: 我也是，但我学校太远，走不到。

sentences.en: My mum sometimes drives me by car.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈有时开车送我。

sentences.en: That's comfortable, but there's a lot of traffic.
sentences.zh: 那很舒服，不过路上很堵。

scenes.title: 喜欢的运动
scenes.subtitle: Sports and games
scenes.description: KET 高频话题:聊喜欢的运动、多久做一次、和谁一起。A2 简单对话。
scenes.examTip:
**考法** 运动是 KET 高频话题。考官问 What sports do you like? / How often do you...? 回答用现在时说喜好和频率(once a week / every day),给个理由更好。

**Part 2** 你和另一位考生看五幅运动图(篮球、游泳、跑步、足球、骑车)。说说你们喜欢或不喜欢这些运动、为什么(有趣/容易/难/花钱),并回应对方 —— **不需要约时间一起运动**。

templates.en: My favourite sport is ___.
I play ___ ___ times a week.
I'm not very good at ___, but it's fun.

sentences.en: What sports do you like, Lily?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢什么运动，莉莉？

sentences.en: My favourite sport is swimming. I go to the pool every weekend.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢游泳。我每个周末都去泳池。

sentences.en: That's great. Do you play any team sports?
sentences.zh: 真棒。你玩团队运动吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I play basketball with my friends after school.
sentences.zh: 玩，我放学后和朋友打篮球。

sentences.en: How often do you practise?
sentences.zh: 你多久练一次？

sentences.en: About twice a week. I'm not very good, but it's really fun.
sentences.zh: 大概一周两次。我打得不太好，但很有意思。

sentences.en: Do you like watching sports on TV too?
sentences.zh: 你也喜欢在电视上看比赛吗？

sentences.en: Sometimes. I love watching football with my dad.
sentences.zh: 有时候。我喜欢和爸爸一起看足球。

sentences.en: Do you like these sports? I really like swimming.
sentences.zh: 你喜欢这些运动吗？我很喜欢游泳。

sentences.en: Me too. I go swimming every Sunday.
sentences.zh: 我也是。我每周日都去游泳。

sentences.en: What about basketball? I'm not very good at it.
sentences.zh: 篮球呢？我打得不太好。

sentences.en: Really? I love basketball. I play it with my friends.
sentences.zh: 真的吗？我很喜欢篮球，和朋友一起打。

sentences.en: I like running because it's easy and free.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢跑步，因为简单又免费。

sentences.en: Running is boring for me. Football is more exciting.
sentences.zh: 跑步我觉得无聊。足球更刺激。

sentences.en: Do you like cycling?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢骑车吗？

sentences.en: Yes, but bikes are expensive.
sentences.zh: 喜欢，不过自行车很贵。

sentences.en: That's true, bikes can be expensive. Swimming is still my favourite.
sentences.zh: 确实，自行车挺贵的。我最喜欢的还是游泳。

sentences.en: I'd choose football. What about you?
sentences.zh: 我会选足球。你呢？

scenes.title: 过节啦
scenes.subtitle: Festivals and celebrations
scenes.description: KET 高频话题:聊喜欢的节日、怎么庆祝、和谁一起、吃什么。A2 简单对话。
scenes.examTip:
**考法** 节日庆祝是 KET 常考话题。考官问 What's your favourite festival? / How do you celebrate? 回答用现在时说习俗(we eat.../ we visit...),简单具体即可。

**Part 2** 你和另一位考生看五幅节庆活动图(包饺子、家庭聚餐、看烟花、装饰房间、送礼物)。说说你们喜欢或不喜欢这些活动、为什么,并回应对方 —— **不需要决定把哪些活动都做一遍**。

templates.en: My favourite festival is ___.
We usually ___ together.
It's my favourite because ___.

sentences.en: What's your favourite festival, Lily?
sentences.zh: 你最喜欢的节日是什么，莉莉？

sentences.en: I love Spring Festival. The whole family gets together.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢春节。全家人都会团聚。

sentences.en: That sounds lovely. What do you usually do?
sentences.zh: 听起来真好。你们通常做什么？

sentences.en: We have a big dinner and my grandma gives us red packets.
sentences.zh: 我们吃一顿大餐，奶奶还会给我们红包。

sentences.en: Nice! Do you eat any special food?
sentences.zh: 真好！你们吃什么特别的食物吗？

sentences.en: Yes, we make dumplings together. They're my favourite.
sentences.zh: 会的，我们一起包饺子。那是我的最爱。

sentences.en: Which festival do you like, Tom?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢哪个节日，汤姆？

sentences.en: I like Mid-Autumn Festival. We eat mooncakes and watch the moon.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢中秋节。我们吃月饼，赏月亮。

sentences.en: Do you like these festival activities? I love making dumplings.
sentences.zh: 你喜欢这些过节活动吗？我很喜欢包饺子。

sentences.en: Me too. My grandma makes the best ones.
sentences.zh: 我也是。我奶奶包得最好。

sentences.en: What about watching fireworks? I think they're beautiful.
sentences.zh: 看烟花呢？我觉得很漂亮。

sentences.en: They're nice, but it's very cold outside at night.
sentences.zh: 是挺好，不过晚上外面很冷。

sentences.en: Do you like family dinners?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢家庭聚餐吗？

sentences.en: Yes, because I can see all my cousins.
sentences.zh: 喜欢，因为能见到我所有的表兄弟姐妹。

sentences.en: I don't really like decorating the house. It takes a long time.
sentences.zh: 我不太喜欢装饰房子。太花时间了。

sentences.en: Really? I think it's fun. I do it with my sister.
sentences.zh: 真的吗？我觉得挺好玩。我和我姐一起弄。

sentences.en: Giving presents is my favourite. I like seeing people happy.
sentences.zh: 送礼物是我最喜欢的。我喜欢看别人开心。

sentences.en: Making dumplings is my favourite because my family does it together.
sentences.zh: 包饺子是我的最爱，因为全家一起做。

scenes.title: 我的好朋友
scenes.subtitle: My friends
scenes.description: KET 高频话题:聊好朋友、一起做什么、朋友是什么样的人。A2 简单对话。
scenes.examTip:
**考法** 朋友是 KET 高频话题。考官问 Tell me about your best friend / What do you do together? 回答用现在时描述朋友(She's kind / funny)和一起做的事,给 1-2 句即可。

**Part 2** 你和另一位考生看五幅和朋友一起做的活动图(玩游戏、聊天、运动、看电影、一起学习)。说说你们喜欢或不喜欢和朋友做哪些、为什么,并回应对方 —— **不需要一样**。

templates.en: My best friend is ___.
We like ___ together.
She's really ___ and ___.

sentences.en: Tell me about your best friend, Lily.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说你最好的朋友吧，莉莉。

sentences.en: My best friend is Emma. We've known each other since we were six.
sentences.zh: 我最好的朋友是艾玛。我们六岁就认识了。

sentences.en: What do you like doing together?
sentences.zh: 你们喜欢一起做什么？

sentences.en: We love drawing and watching cartoons at the weekend.
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢周末一起画画、看动画片。

sentences.en: She sounds fun. What's she like?
sentences.zh: 她听起来很有意思。她是什么样的人？

sentences.en: She's really kind and always makes me laugh.
sentences.zh: 她非常善良，总能逗我笑。

sentences.en: How often do you see each other?
sentences.zh: 你们多久见一次？

sentences.en: Almost every day at school. We sit next to each other.
sentences.zh: 几乎每天在学校见。我们坐在一起。

sentences.en: My friends and I love playing games together.
sentences.zh: 我和朋友都很喜欢一起玩游戏。

sentences.en: Me too. We play football after school every day.
sentences.zh: 我也是。我们每天放学后踢球。

sentences.en: I also like just chatting. We talk about everything.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢单纯聊天。我们什么都聊。

sentences.en: Really? I get bored of talking. I prefer doing something.
sentences.zh: 真的吗？我聊天会腻。我更喜欢做点什么。

sentences.en: What about watching films? That's fun at the weekend.
sentences.zh: 看电影呢？周末看很有意思。

sentences.en: I agree. We watch a film at my house sometimes.
sentences.zh: 同意。我们有时在我家看电影。

sentences.en: Do you ever study together?
sentences.zh: 你们会一起学习吗？

sentences.en: Yes, we help each other with homework. It's easier.
sentences.zh: 会，我们互相帮忙写作业。这样更轻松。

sentences.en: I don't like studying with friends. We just play instead!
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢和朋友一起学习。我们最后只会玩！

sentences.en: That's true, it can be hard to study.
sentences.zh: 确实，很难学得进去。

scenes.title: 长大想做什么
scenes.subtitle: Jobs and dreams
scenes.description: KET 高频话题:聊长大想做的工作、为什么、喜欢的科目。A2 简单对话。
scenes.examTip:
**考法** 未来工作是 KET 常考话题。考官问 What do you want to be? / Why? 回答用 I want to be a... because... 说梦想和简单理由,现在时即可。

**Part 2** 你和另一位考生看五幅职业图(老师、医生、厨师、工程师、艺术家)。说说你们长大想不想做这些、为什么,并回应对方 —— **不需要选同一个**。

templates.en: I want to be a ___.
I want to do this because ___.
My favourite subject is ___.

sentences.en: What do you want to be when you grow up, Lily?
sentences.zh: 你长大想做什么，莉莉？

sentences.en: I want to be a doctor. I'd like to help sick people.
sentences.zh: 我想当医生。我想帮助生病的人。

sentences.en: That's a great job. Why do you want to do it?
sentences.zh: 那是个很棒的工作。你为什么想做呢？

sentences.en: Because my mum is a nurse, and I want to help people like her.
sentences.zh: 因为我妈妈是护士，我想像她一样帮助别人。

sentences.en: What's your favourite subject at school?
sentences.zh: 你在学校最喜欢的科目是什么？

sentences.en: I love science. It helps me understand how things work.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢科学。它帮我理解事物是怎么运作的。

sentences.en: What about you, Tom? What do you want to be?
sentences.zh: 你呢，汤姆？你想做什么？

sentences.en: I want to be a pilot. I've always dreamed of flying planes.
sentences.zh: 我想当飞行员。我一直梦想着开飞机。

sentences.en: I want to be a teacher one day.
sentences.zh: 我以后想当老师。

sentences.en: Really? I think teaching is hard work.
sentences.zh: 真的吗？我觉得教书很辛苦。

sentences.en: It is, but I love helping children learn.
sentences.zh: 是辛苦，但我喜欢帮孩子学习。

sentences.en: I want to be a doctor because I want to help sick people.
sentences.zh: 我想当医生，因为我想帮生病的人。

sentences.en: That's a great job, but you have to study for many years.
sentences.zh: 那是个好工作，但要学很多年。

sentences.en: What about a chef? I love cooking.
sentences.zh: 厨师呢？我喜欢做饭。

sentences.en: I'm not good at cooking, so I don't want to be a chef.
sentences.zh: 我做饭不行，所以不想当厨师。

sentences.en: Would you like to be an engineer?
sentences.zh: 你想当工程师吗？

sentences.en: Maybe. It sounds interesting. I'd also like to be an artist because I love drawing.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。听起来有意思。我也想当艺术家，因为我喜欢画画。

sentences.en: Being an artist sounds fun, but I'd still like to be a doctor.
sentences.zh: 当艺术家听起来很有趣，但我还是想当医生。
